jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Agent Systems
jobs.description: **About The Electric Plant Co.** The Electric Plant Co. is building a new category of plant and tree intelligence. Our IoT hardware measures the electrical signals in plants and trees, paired with environmental data, and our foundation model, Bombadil, decodes those signals into real\-time insights about plant health, growth, and stress. We're a small, fast\-moving company in San Francisco working at the intersection of biology, hardware, AI, and IoT. Bombadil can decode a plant’s physiological responses to stress — the layer that turns that into something a grower acts on doesn't exist yet, and that's what this role builds. **The Role** You'll build the application layer that sits between our foundation model and the people who use it: the client's context layer, insight and policy cards, learning loops, agents, and scheduled work. You'll start embedded in the field with our Deployment Lead on our first real customer, shipping things a grower actually uses to run their orchard. From month six onward, you'll convert what worked into the reusable protocols and tools that make every deployment after the first faster to stand up. This is a senior, individually\-contributing role with no direct reports. You'll report to our Director of Engineering, with a direct line to our CEO on what the system could do next. You'll work closely with the engineer who owns our deterministic data plane (ingest, fleet, telemetry), the team that owns our foundation model, and the person who owns the client relationship and translates what growers need into what you build. **What You'll Own** * **Client context layer and retrieval.** Built and measured, not just assumed to work. * **The tool schema** exposing our platform's data and insights, including uncertainty in the return payload. * **The product's agent systems** — skill and instruction files as versioned, testable, reviewable artifacts, and the scheduled/event\-driven work built on them, durable, idempotent, and observable. * **One insight pipeline** rendering to chat, email, PDF, and API. * **The context schema and card structure** that make Platform's multi\-tenant isolation and client IP protections possible — including how clients' data and the insights engineered from it are protected. * **Actuation.** When the system carries a client\-set policy into their systems — an irrigation setpoint, a crew instruction \- you own making sure it executes reliably every time: safe to re\-run, fully trackable, and only after the approvals and deployment steps the client has set up.. * Eval suites, trace capture, drift monitoring, and per\-client cost accounting. **What We're Looking For** * Has built and measured production AI retrieval and context assembly, with quantification of the system’s usefulness, not demo impressions. * Consistently pushes repeatable work into deterministic code and spends model calls only where judgment is genuinely required. * Has shipped multi\-tenant isolation in production: tenant\-scoped data and indexes, per\-client credential scoping, deletion that actually deletes. * Has built a config or skill system that a non\-engineer colleague used daily and modified without you. * Has operated an agent system in production, not a prototype, with a real story about silent drift, a cost blowup, or a cron that double\-fired. * Has built durable, idempotent, observable scheduled or event\-driven agent work. * Has built eval suites, trace capture, or drift monitoring, and can speak to where ground truth came from and how often it arrived. * Likely has a full\-stack or front\-end web/application engineering background who made a deliberate turn toward agentic systems, rather than a long\-tenured backend or data engineer moving into this space for the first time. Total years matter less than this shape. **Strong plus** * Integration grit against client and legacy systems: enterprise APIs, CSV over SFTP, email deliverability. **What This Isn't** This isn't a role for someone who wants a settled spec and a quiet backlog. Requirements will arrive from an orchard, mid\-season, and be wrong. It's also not a research role — you'll consume and expose what the model does, not train it — and not an infrastructure role, since the data plane underneath you is someone else's deterministic domain. If you're excited by the orchestration toolkit itself more than by what it takes to get something working in a grower's hands, this isn't the fit. If you want to build the layer that makes a decoded plant signal into something a business actually acts on, and to do it first in the field and then in code that outlasts the first customer, we'd like to talk. **Compensation \& logistics** * Salary range is $215k\-235k per year, with meaningful early\-stage equity * Standard benefits * Full\-time, in\-person at our Presidio office in San Francisco * Start date: ASAP *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: CONSTRUCTION INSPECTOR
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY**: This position is responsible for performing field inspections of county construction projects.**MAJOR DUTIES*** Performs field inspections on county construction projects, including infrastructure, drainage, asphalt paving, roads, driveways, rights\-of\-way, sidewalks, parking lots, earthwork, concrete placement, asphalt paving, utility installation, etc.; conducts daily on\-site inspections to ensure quality control and design standards are met; interprets and enforces all GDOT and county construction standards and specifications. * Inspects the quality of all materials used on county construction projects to ensure compliance with standards and specifications; performs and observes testing procedures; verifies quality of work to ensure that all means and methods meet construction standards and practices. * Coordinates projects and inspection activities with other departments, engineering and project managers, engineers, contractors, property owners, utility representatives, and external agencies; meets with utility representatives to discuss conflicts and relocations; coordinates road closures with appropriate law enforcement and emergency agencies; notifies neighborhoods of scheduled construction. * Tracks and verifies all payments on construction projects measures and verifies all quantities and records into daily and monthly inspection log. * Maintains detailed field notes, inspection logs, and photographic records; completes inspection reports and documents all project activity; keeps daily and monthly detailed reports on inspections performed, observations made, and corrective actions needed. * Assists in processing and verifying pay applications, monitoring project schedules, and reviewing shop drawings and material submittals; monitors weather conditions and changes to prevent budgetary over runs; prepares punch list of remedial work; reviews construction drawings and engineering plans. * Operates and maintains a variety of equipment and tools associated with inspection activities, including level, transit, laser grade instruments, grading rod, asphalt thermometer, metal locator, engineering scale, etc. * Conducts final inspections for acceptance and approval of county projects and private developments. * Performs related duties. **KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED BY THE POSITION*** Knowledge of construction materials, methods, and procedures. * Knowledge of local, state, and federal codes, standards, and environmental regulations. * Knowledge of construction inspection principles and practices. * Knowledge of computers and job\-related software programs. * Skill in interpreting complex blueprints and specifications to ensure construction compliance. * Skill in the use of tools and equipment associates with the construction inspection process. * Skill in problem solving. * Skill in prioritizing and planning. * Skill in interpersonal relations. * Skill in oral and written communication. **SUPERVISORY CONTROLS** The Field Engineering Division Manager assigns work in terms of very general instructions. The supervisor spot\-checks completed work for compliance with procedures and the nature and propriety of the final results.**GUIDELINES** Guidelines include GDOT manuals, standards, and specifications; Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices guidelines; BGCJWSC standards and details; GSWCC standards and regulations; OSHA regulations; and county and department policies and procedures. These guidelines require judgment, selection, and interpretation in application.**COMPLEXITY/SCOPE OF WORK*** The work consists of varied construction project inspection duties. The unique nature of each construction project contributes to the complexity of the position. * The purpose of this position is to perform construction inspections. Successful performance helps to ensure that construction projects are in compliance with all specifications, standards, codes, and regulations. **CONTACTS*** Contacts are typically with co\-workers, other county staff, contractors, engineers, utility representatives, state inspection staff, representatives of state and federal agencies, and the general public. * Contacts are typically to exchange information, motivate persons, resolve problems, and provide services. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ WORK ENVIRONMENT*** The work is typically performed while intermittently sitting, standing, stooping, bending, crouching, or walking. The employee frequently lifts light and heavy objects, climbs ladders, uses tools or equipment that require a high degree of dexterity, distinguishes between shades of color, and uses the sense of smell. * The work is typically performed in an office and outdoors, occasionally in cold or inclement weather. The employee may be exposed to dust, dirt, grease, and machinery with moving parts. Work requires the use of protective devices such as masks, goggles, gloves, etc. * Knowledge and level of competency commonly associated with the completion of specialized training in the field of work, in addition to basic skills typically associated with a high school education. * Sufficient experience to understand the basic principles relevant to the major duties of the position, usually associated with the completion of an apprenticeship/internship or having had a similar position for one to two years. * Possession of or ability to readily obtain a valid driver’s license issued by the State of Georgia for the type of vehicle or equipment operated. * Possession of or ability to readily obtain the appropriate state certification for the type of inspection(s) conducted. **Benefits:*** Bi\-weekly payroll * 12 hours of PTO per month * 12 paid Holidays * Employee Assistance Program * No\-Cost Employee Health Clinic * Health Care Plan, Life Insurance, and Long\-term Disability * Deferred Compensation, Voluntary Benefits * Retirement \- Defined Contribution Plan

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer

Cloud Solutions owns DevOps, API/Compute/Microservice platforms, Technology Standards, and the engineering behind new capabilities, including AI, cross\-cloud, and emerging service and pattern adoption. This role sits within the new capabilities engineering function, focused on enabling the business directly through technology and partnership, prototyping and piloting new AWS and cross\-cloud capabilities, and working closely with the rest of Cloud Solutions to bring them into production. We currently operate in a hybrid working model, whereby you will be required to work in\-office 4 days per week. Location(s): Milwaukee, WI and Charlotte, NC Responsibilities: * Serve as a hands\-on expert and builder for cloud\-based technologies, with security, performance, operability, and scale in mind. * goals * Design, build, and solutions on AWS to explore new services, patterns, and capabilities ahead of broader adoption * Build and support workloads and integrations across AWS, Azure, Microsoft production * Help develop firm\-wide cloud standards * Maintain clear documentation of solutions, architecture decisions, and lessons learned Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree or higher MIS, CS or other technology related field * 5\+ years of engineering and technology experience, preferably in Financial Services, Technology, or related field * Be able to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment and prioritize duties to meet deadlines with limited supervision * Proven strong verbal and written communication skills * Effective influencing and consensus\-building skills * Strategic focus on problem\-solving * Strong teaching and mentoring skills * Strong presentation and communication skills * Position may require occasional travel outside of primary work location * 3\+ years of AWS or other hyperscale cloud provider implementation experience * Proven experience working effectively in heavily distributed environment * Consulting experience is a plus * Exhibited experience with maintaining strong documentation * Experience with the ability to transfer knowledge to key members of the team and act as a value\-added resource * Ability to interact confidently with counterparts at all levels within the firm * Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills * Demonstrated ability collaborate with teams spanning a range of locations * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross\-functional environment. * Ability to work at a computer and use standard business software for extended periods during the workday. * Communicate effectively with colleagues, clients, and business partners in person and electronically as needed. * Engage in regular in\-person interaction and collaboration with team members and other stakeholders. * Work effectively in a professional office environment with ongoing collaboration, activity, and shifting priorities. * Maintain productivity and focus while balancing multiple tasks and interruptions common in an in\-person business setting. Compensation: Base Pay Range: $120,000 \- $140,000 Actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience, time in role, base salary internal peers, prior performance, business sector, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual discretionary bonus programs, or other annual or non\-annual incentive or sales plans.) \#LI\-JD1 \#LI\-Hybrid Disclosure: We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. jobs.title: Commercial Real Estate Investment Analyst
jobs.description: Please note that this position is a **Direct Hire** opportunity with our company. **No Agencies:** We are managing all recruitment internally and are not partnering with third\-party staffing agencies or search firms for this role. **For fast consideration, please apply directly at** **https://beyondinternational.bamboohr.com/careers/100** **Position Overview** We are seeking a data\-driven and forward\-thinking Commercial Real Estate Investment Analyst to join our team, working full\-time on\-site at our Houston office. This role goes beyond traditional underwriting; we are looking for a professional with 3 to 5 years of experience who is deeply proficient in financial modeling, possesses ground\-up development experience, and actively embraces Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to optimize workflows and predict market trends. A significant focus of this role will involve evaluating development projects, value\-add opportunities, and distressed assets across a diversified asset mix, including multifamily, office, and retail properties. The ideal candidate will combine sharp commercial real estate acumen with cutting\-edge technical capabilities to collaborate directly with our team daily and help drive our investment and development strategies. **Key Responsibilities** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * **Development Underwriting \& Modeling:** Build and maintain sophisticated, dynamic financial models for ground\-up developments and major redevelopments, including construction budgeting, draws, sources and uses, and waterfall distributions. * **Asset\-Specific Analysis:** Perform specialized underwriting across multiple property sectors, including **multifamily** (rent rolls, concessions), **retail** (triple\-net leases, CAM reconciliations), and **office** (tenant improvements, leasing commissions). * **Distressed Asset \& Value\-Add Evaluation:** Perform deep\-dive analysis on distressed assets, non\-performing loans, and value\-add properties, identifying restructuring strategies, capital expenditure (CapEx) requirements, and risk\-mitigated exit plans. * **Complex Problem Solving:** Tackle ambiguous, highly challenging real estate scenarios by identifying financial risk metrics, uncovering hidden values in distressed profiles, and structuring complex capitalization models. * **Project Feasibility \& Due Diligence:** Conduct zoning, land\-use, and feasibility analyses for potential development sites. Coordinate with architects, engineers, and general contractors during the pre\-development phase. * **AI \& Automation Integration:** Leverage advanced AI tools, Large Language Models (LLMs), and automation workflows to streamline market research, parse complex lease agreements, and optimize property underwriting efficiency. * **Market Research \& Negotiation Support:** Conduct rigorous market research on the Houston and regional CRE landscapes to back up commercial negotiations. Assist senior leadership in analyzing tenant terms, loan covenants, and purchase agreements. **Required Qualifications** * **Education:** **Bachelor’s degree** in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Architecture, Civil Engineering, or a related field required. **Master’s degree** (MBA, MS in Real Estate, or MS in Finance) or **CFA designation is highly preferred**. * **Experience:** **3–5 years of professional experience** in commercial real estate investment analysis, development, private equity, or asset management. * **Asset Portfolio Familiarity:** Demonstrated experience evaluating or managing projects within the **multifamily, office, and/or retail** sectors. * **Development \& Distressed Asset Acumen:** Direct exposure to underwriting ground\-up development projects *and* managing or evaluating distressed assets/value\-add turnarounds. * **AI \& Technical Literacy:** Demonstrated experience or high proficiency using AI platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, customized LLM tools) for data analysis, market research, or operational automation. * **Core Competencies:** Advanced proficiency in MS Excel; experience with ARGUS Enterprise is a plus. Exceptionally strong understanding of CRE metrics (IRR, NPV, Yield\-on\-Cost, Equity Multiple, NOI, and Debt Service Coverage). * **Work Arrangement:** Willing and able to work **100% on\-site** out of our **Houston, Texas** office. **Preferred Attributes \& Professional Skills** * **Proven Learning Ability:** A highly adaptive self\-starter who quickly masters new technical tools, changing software platforms, and shifts in target real estate asset classes. * **Advanced Problem Solving:** Exceptional diagnostic skills with a track record of parsing fragmented data points to resolve complicated asset issues or project bottlenecks. * **Negotiation Capability:** Strong analytical foundation to effectively defend investment theses and position the company favorably when navigating lender terms, partnership waterfalls, or vendor contracts. * **Communication:** Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to act as a clear liaison between analytics, development project managers, and executive teams. **Pay Range** * Annual Base Pay: $100k \- $130k DOE **Benefits** * Opportunities for professional development and growth within an inclusive team environment. * Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life coverage for employee and premium allowance/subsidy for employees’ eligible dependents * PTO (vacation and sick) * 401(k) with Enhanced Employer Safe Harbor match * 10 paid holidays a year * Cell phone/technology reimbursement **Note:** Benefits can and may change any time at the management’s discretion and in compliance with applicable State and Federal laws. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States and will not need employment sponsorship in the future, work on a full\-time basis and able to commute to Houston, TX. **NOTE:** The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Beyond International is an equal opportunity employer in every aspect of employment, including but not limited to; selection, training, development and promotion of the most qualified candidates and employees without regard to their race, gender, color, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, citizenship status, veteran status, or any other characteristic prohibited by state or local law. Beyond International is committed to equal employment opportunity in all other privileges, terms and conditions of employment that may not be covered in this statement. Beyond International is an at\-will employer.

jobs.title: Engineer II
jobs.description: **Agency** Dept of Transportation **Division** State Hwy Administrator \- Div of Hwys **Job Classification Title** Engineer II (NS) **Position Number** 60026641 **Grade** NC18 **About Us** It’s the mission of the NC Department of Transportation to connect people, products and places safely and efficiently with customer focus, accountability, and environmental sensitivity to enhance the economy and vitality of North Carolina. We encourage you to consider joining NCDOT where our work not only serves the citizens of North Carolina but has an impact on our world through all modes of transportation. **Description of Work** Please note that all positions close at 12:00 AM on the posted closing date. You must apply by 11:59 PM prior to the posted closing date. The Traffic Safety Project Engineer position is assigned to the Safety Planning Group of the Traffic Safety Systems Section within the Traffic Safety Unit of the Transportation Mobility and Safety Division. The primary purpose of this position is to provide technical leadership, engineering expertise and investigative support for Transportation Improvement Program projects. Significant involvement in the project development process is required including attending project meetings, providing necessary safety data to support projects throughout the project development process, and communicating traffic safety findings and practices. This position will assist in developing alternative analyses for proposed projects based on Highway Safety Manual methodologies and software. This position will assist in the development, research, documentation and continuous quality improvement of the procedures and methodologies used to evaluate and analyze projects from a safety perspective. This position will assist with managing the Fatal Crash Review Program. This position is also responsible for providing crash analyses and crash mapping (collision diagrams and GIS mapping) to internal and external customers. This position will assist with managing the NCDOT ordinance program and route change process. This position requires an understanding of the technical aspects of traffic engineering principles, methods, techniques, and analytical highway safety skills in order to improve the Section’s expertise, efficiency, and production, while maintaining the high engineering standards required by the Department of Transportation. This position must have a basic knowledge of traffic engineering concepts, particularly those pertaining to engineering countermeasures for traffic crash analyses, which includes preparing collision diagrams, GIS mapping, intersection crash analyses, and strip analyses. This position requires good written and oral communication skills in order to handle the task of report writing, correspondence, personnel and public contact. This position is responsible for leading road safety assessment teams across the state, which requires appropriately selecting sites and recognizing correctable patterns, conducting crash analysis, collecting field data, leading a team of peers, and developing and communicating recommendations based on sound traffic engineering principles. The applicant must be passionate about the field of traffic safety and this position’s role in reducing the number of North Carolina traffic\-related fatalities and injuries. The variety of projects and vast amount of research in highway safety require professionals to stay abreast of the advancements in both methodologies and technologies used in analyzing safety projects. This requires the development of information technology and computer applications, use of advanced data collection equipment, use of complex computer software applications and hardware. jobs.title: Founding Inference Engineer
jobs.description: **About us** ============ General Compute is the neocloud for alternative chips. Inference is fragmenting: purpose\-built silicon from SambaNova, Cerebras, Positron, d\-Matrix, and others already beats GPUs on decode, and we productionize that hardware — we buy the racks, find the data center space, and run it for our customers. Each piece of hardware runs the workload it's actually built for: prefill stays on GPUs, decode moves to the chip built for it, and today that means generating tokens 5–7× faster than existing GPU\-based competitors. Our customers are frontier labs, fast\-growing AI application companies, and asset\-light clouds. We closed a $15M seed round in May 2026, and have since closed a $400M debt facility — $100M funded upfront by Upper90, with the balance available for drawdown — collateralized by our inference chips. **About the Role** ------------------ Getting a model correct and fast on our silicon is only half the problem — the other half is serving it. You'll build and own the inference layer that sits between a bought\-up model and a live customer request: request scheduling, batching, KV\-cache management, autoscaling across our ASIC fleet, and the failure modes that only show up at real traffic and real scale. This is a founding role on a small team, which means the scope is wide and the ownership is real: there's no separate SRE org to hand reliability to and no platform team to hand infra to. You'll design the serving architecture, then be the person paged when it breaks. The bet is that a serving stack built specifically for our hardware — not adapted from a GPU\-first framework — is a durable edge, and you're the person who proves that out in production. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * **Own the inference serving stack end\-to\-end.** Design and build the system that takes a bring\-up\-verified model and serves it in production: request routing, batching, scheduling, and autoscaling across our ASIC fleet. * **Push cost\-per\-token down.** Continuously tune batching strategy, KV\-cache handling, and hardware utilization to widen the throughput advantage over GPU\-based serving. * **Build for reliability from day one.** Put in place the monitoring, alerting, and failover that make a fast\-moving inference stack trustworthy under real customer load — and be the one who responds when it isn't. * **Work at the boundary with the compiler and bring\-up team.** Define the interface between "a model is correct and compiled" and "a model is live and fast," and push issues back to the right side of that line. * **Shape the roadmap, not just the backlog.** As a founding engineer, you'll help decide what we build next in serving — multi\-tenant isolation, speculative decoding, new scheduling strategies — not just execute a spec someone else wrote. * **Set the technical bar for the team you're helping build.** Early architecture and code\-quality decisions you make here will shape how the serving team operates as it grows. **What We Need From You:** -------------------------- * 5\+ years building and operating production systems at the infrastructure layer, ideally including a high\-throughput or low\-latency serving system. * Direct experience with LLM inference serving — request batching, KV\-cache management, continuous batching, or similar — in a production environment, not just research code. * Comfortable owning reliability: you've been on call for a system that mattered, and you design for failure rather than reacting to it after the fact. * Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, networking, scheduling — deep enough to reason about performance at the hardware level, not just the application level. * Self\-directed and comfortable with ambiguity. This is a founding role: there's no existing playbook to follow, and you'll help write it. **Nice\-to\-Haves:** -------------------- * Experience serving models on non\-NVIDIA accelerators (TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, Cerebras, or similar). * Familiarity with serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, TensorRT\-LLM, or SGLang, and an opinion on where they fall short. * Experience running infrastructure at a small company or in a founding/early\-engineer capacity before. * Exposure to capacity planning or fleet management for specialized hardware.

You will write code every day, get exposure to AI and agentic solutions, and learn how to take work from an idea to something that holds up in production. If you are looking for a place to build a strong foundation in software engineering while working on meaningful problems in healthcare AI \& automation, this is a good fit. **Key Responsibilities:** * Maintain and improve internal automation tools, ensuring they stay reliable and up to date as the team's needs evolve. * Support the maintenance and ongoing development of the Tarpon website, including updates, bug fixes, and feature additions. * Write, test, and document code for client\-facing AI and automation solutions under the guidance of senior engineers. * Help integrate AI features, including prompts, tool use, and retrieval pipelines, into internal and client workflows. * Build and connect APIs and data pipelines that move information into usable formats for AI systems and downstream applications. * Document your work clearly and communicate progress, blockers, and questions to the team in a timely way. * Collaborate with teammates and, with support, engage with client teams to understand requirements and confirm that solutions meet their needs. * Stay curious about developments in AI, automation, and agentic solutions, and bring that learning into your day\-to\-day work. * Be an internal resource within the Tarpon team as it relates to AI education an building AI excellence within the Tarpon team. **Required Qualifications:** * Engineering degree, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Data Science, or equivalent practical experience. * 1 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience, including internships or significant project work. * Working proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, or C\#. * Familiarity with APIs, data structures, and version control with Git. * Some exposure to or genuine curiosity about AI tools, LLMs, and automation frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience working in or alongside U.S. healthcare, revenue cycle, or with a major EMR system such as Epic, Cerner, or Athenahealth. * Familiarity with web development tools and technologies relevant to website maintenance and updates. * Exposure to agentic solutions, automation platforms, or AI\-assisted development tools. **Note:** This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to meet the needs of the organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. #### **Salary** $60,000 \- $90,000 per year

jobs.title: Lead Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Position summary** Our backend is a Scala / Play Framework platform built on Akka clustering and MongoDB, running real\-time multiplayer casino gameplay, promotions, sweepstakes mechanics, and payment processing across three live products. The Lead Backend Engineer takes ownership of these systems end\-to\-end: the real\-time gameplay layer, the payment and compliance surface, and the backend infrastructure shared across all three products. This is an ownership role, not a maintenance role. The expectation is architectural and operational leadership across a large, mature, multi\-product codebase — not just delivery against a backlog. Concretely: this person is expected to decide what the system should do next and why, not only implement what a backlog already specifies — setting technical direction, making calls that trade off correctness, complexity, and risk in ways no ticket fully captures, and being accountable for the health of the system as a whole, not just the tickets closed against it. **Responsibilities** * System ownership. Hold end\-to\-end technical ownership of the backend across all major service domains: game logic, promotions, payments, sweepstakes, player accounts, admin/backoffice, and analytics. * Real\-time architecture. Lead design and evolution of the WebSocket / Akka\-actor\-based real\-time gameplay layer and the Akka cluster it runs on. * Payments \& compliance. Own integration correctness for Paysafe, WorldPay (including 3DS flows), Apple StoreKit, and Google Play billing, in coordination with legal/compliance on regulatory requirements for sweepstakes\-model gaming. * Shared infrastructure stewardship. Make and review changes to backend infrastructure shared across all three casino gaming products, with awareness of cross\-product impact. * Operational leadership. Own production health for a live, revenue\-generating system: deploys, cluster operations, incident response, and postmortems. * Technical mentorship. Set technical direction, run code review, and raise the engineering judgment bar for the team working in this codebase. * Knowledge continuity. Absorb knowledge transfer from the outgoing lead — primarily through prepared written documentation, with live overlap only to the extent hiring completes before their departure — and become the system's primary technical authority. Required qualifications * 7\+ years professional backend engineering experience, with real ownership (not just contribution) of a production system at meaningful scale. * Strong Scala experience — functional style, not incidental Scala syntax on top of Java habits — ideally with Play Framework or a comparable typed functional web framework. * Production experience with an actor\-model or comparable distributed\-systems framework (Akka, Erlang/OTP, or similar), including cluster operation, not just local single\-node usage. * Experience with async/reactive database access patterns (ReactiveMongo or equivalent reactive\-driver experience). * Demonstrated ownership of at least one payment, billing, or other compliance\-sensitive integration in production. * Strong distributed\-systems judgment: can reason about race conditions, idempotency under retry/duplicate delivery, and compatibility across a rolling deploy without being prompted. Preferred qualifications * Experience in iGaming, sweepstakes, or other regulated real\-money gaming. * Experience with real\-time, low\-latency, or WebSocket\-heavy backend systems. * Experience maintaining and evolving a legacy codebase (10\+ years) without a rewrite. * Experience with MongoDB operations beyond query\-writing — indexing strategy, replica set behavior under load.

jobs.title: Lead, Instrumentation & Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title: Lead, Instrumentation \& Controls Engineer** **Job ID:** **Job Location: Jupiter, FL** **Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off** **Job Description:** We are seeking a Lead, Instrumentation and Controls Engineer to work in a test operations environment supporting production and development rocket engine test programs. Responsibilities emphasize real\-time plant operational support including extensive facility and integrated systems troubleshooting and immediate design correction analysis. Provide technician direction and actively participate with rocket engine test data and controls systems setups, process verifications, instrumentation and pre\-run systems calibrations, data processing and post\-test data validity reviews. Participate in development program budget estimates and provide implementation oversight of facility modification engineering packages using industry standards and specifications. Individual will work closely with multiple engineering organizations to accommodate customer requirements and expectations. **Essential Functions:** Qualified candidates must be knowledgeable of electrical/electronic principles and should have experience with an emphasis on the following: * PC based controls applications, operating systems, and algorithm development * LabVIEW data acquisition and controls programming and associated industrial project applications * Hands\-on development, integration, operation and troubleshooting of instrumentation, controls systems, and controls equipment * HMI Graphical Programming * Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC’s) – Hardware, Software, and programming * Sensor circuits including but not limited to pressure, temperature, flow, vibration, proximity and force measurement **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience **Preferred Additional Skills:** * Computer networking and industrial communication protocols * Pneumatic valves and control hardware, systems, and applications * Instrumentation and acquisition hardware specification and procurement * SQL Database Administration * Familiarity with servo\-hydraulic control systems L3Harris announced on January 5th, that AE Industrial Partners (“AE Industrial”) has agreed to acquire a controlling interest in L3Harris’ Space Propulsion and Power Systems business. This position has been identified as one that will transition to the new standalone company upon closing of the transaction. Until that time, L3Harris will continue its hiring activity within this business. \#LI\-AT4

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to work across the full stack of our surgical robotic platform: the robotics system, the ML platform, and the infrastructure that powers model training. You will build machine learning models to solve problems specific to surgical robotics, many of which do not have existing research or pre\-trained solutions to start from. **What You'll Do** * Train and build machine learning models for real\-world robotic applications. * Work across the robotics stack, the ML platform, and the infrastructure for model training. * Build models from scratch for novel problems where prior research or pre\-trained models do not apply. * Write clean, testable, production\-quality code that integrates with the broader system. * Collaborate closely with robotics, software, and clinical teams to bring new capabilities to the robot. **What We're Looking For** **Machine Learning** * Hands\-on experience training machine learning models, either in graduate studies or professional work. This is a must, not something to learn on the job. * Ability to build models from scratch for problems where existing research does not apply, rather than only fine\-tuning or retraining existing models. * Ability to scope out an ambiguous ML problem and define an approach when there is no established path to follow. **Software Engineering** * Ability to write clean, maintainable, production\-quality code. * Experience writing tests and validating software behavior. Testing is a core part of how we build, not an afterthought. * Comfortable working across multiple parts of the technical stack, from robotics to ML platform to training infrastructure. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills. **Ownership \& Startup Mindset** * Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently drive projects forward. * Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with evolving priorities. * The project needs to be delivered, and you do what it takes to get it there. * Willingness to seek feedback, iterate quickly, and collaborate closely with teammates. **Nice to have** * Experience with computer vision or vision models. * Experience deploying high\-performance ML models in production (for example, converting trained models to ONNX or similar formats for C\+\+ inference). * Experience with C\+\+. * Experience with robotics or hardware\-adjacent systems. * Experience working in startup environments. **Why Join Andromeda?** At Andromeda, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a small, highly technical team tackling some of the hardest problems in robotics, software, and healthcare. Your work will directly impact products that are deployed in real clinical environments and have the potential to improve patient outcomes at scale. **We offer:** * Competitive salary and equity package * Flexible healthcare benefits through an individual coverage reimbursement program * Monthly health and wellness stipend * 401(k) retirement plan * Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates * The opportunity to help build a category\-defining company from an early stage Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Mechatronics Research Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Yadonai AgTech is is an agricultural robotics and automation company. We are building a team of researchers and engineers pushing the boundaries of intelligent, automation\-driven solutions for specialty crop management. As an early\-stage company, we are focused entirely on advancing our core technology, with a recent NSF SBIR Phase I award. Over the next five years, Yadonai aims to become a leader in precision agricultural robotics technologies for high\-value tree crops and forestry applications, advancing sustainability, input efficiency, and labor savings in crop production. Joining Yadonai means playing a foundational role on a mission\-driven team building novel mechatronic systems from the ground up. **Role Description** We are seeking a motivated, hands\-on Mechatronics Research Engineer to serve as a technical contributor on our 12\-month NSF SBIR Phase I project. This role involves designing, building, and installing electromechanical hardware, fluidics, and control systems, as well as conducting field validation experiments. The Mechatronics Research Engineer will document designs, test procedures, and results, and support the transition from lab prototype to pilot deployment. Within our startup environment, one will have the opportunity to grow alongside the company, with the potential to take on greater technical and leadership responsibility as we advance toward Phase II and beyond. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience in Research and Development (R\&D), including experimental design, prototyping, and data\-driven iteration. * 2–5 years of hands\-on electromechanical prototyping experience * Experience with linear actuators or voice coil / Lorentz\-force motors * Demonstrated closed\-loop feedback control design (PID, PD, or equivalent) * Proficiency in LabVIEW or MATLAB/Simulink with real\-time hardware * Experience with NI DAQ hardware (cRIO, myRIO, USB\-DAQ, or equivalent) * Hands\-on electronics skills, including circuit wiring, amplifier interfacing, sensor integration * Proficiency with CAD (Solid Edge, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or equivalent), simulation tools, and electronics design is highly beneficial * FEA of mechanical components * Ability to work independently and manage concurrent tasks * Ability to work on\-site in a lab and field environment, including occasional work outdoors for field testing. * Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate in a small, multidisciplinary team. * Strong foundation in Computer Science and Algorithms for implementing control logic, data processing, and system optimization. * Solid understanding of Physics as applied to mechanical systems, fluid dynamics, and sensor/actuator behavior. * Hands\-on experience with prototyping tools, lab equipment, and testing mechatronic or robotic systems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Mechatronics * Experience with high\-pressure fluid delivery or ballistic actuator systems * Familiarity with experimental design and statistical analysis (ANOVA, regression) * Experience with FEA software (ANSYS, Abaqus, or SolidWorks Simulation) * Prior work in a startup, fast\-paced industry environment, or research lab environment * Knowledge of wood anatomy, plant physiology, or agricultural systems * Experience with embedded microcontroller programming (C/C\+\+, Arduino, or similar) Pay: $65,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: National Account Manager
jobs.description: **About Mojave Energy Systems, Inc.** Mojave is changing the nature of air conditioning. Air conditioning consumes \~9% of total global electricity production and results in the emissions of 1 billion tons of carbon dioxide annually. It is time for a change, and Mojave’s liquid desiccant air conditioning systems are doing just that. If you want to change the world, starting with the world of air conditioning, then you may belong at Mojave. We are looking for purpose\-driven team members who enjoy problem solving, teamwork, and personal growth to join our venture\-backed company. We are seeking a National Account Executive to join the sales organization at Mojave Energy Systems, reporting to our VP of Sales. This remote position is responsible for selling Mojave systems directly to building owners, consulting engineers, and design\-build contractors \- leading with deep expertise and an activatable network in a single vertical (grocery, hospitality, industrial, or education), with national account responsibility for that vertical. The compensation package for this role includes a base salary \& commission structure. **ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY** This is a direct\-selling role. You will carry a number, and you will hit it by finding latent load problems in buildings and applications you already understand and building the case for Mojave's systems as the solution. The successful candidate will "get in at the ground floor" of our business and help establish our first reference installations in their vertical. This is a national role. While Mojave sells into grocery, hospitality, industrial, and education, we expect this hire to lead with deep expertise and an activatable network in one of these verticals, and to own that vertical nationally from day one. We are looking for a technical seller who already knows how buildings in their vertical are designed, bid, and bought — and who is already known and trusted there. In an early market, an established reputation in a vertical is the shortest path to a qualified pipeline. Yours will be put to work immediately. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own direct sales in your assigned vertical end to end: prospecting, qualification, technical development, negotiation, and close. * Sell to end users and their design teams within your vertical — e.g., grocery chains, hotel brands and management companies, industrial plants, or school districts and universities, depending on assignment. * Activate your existing network to generate qualified opportunities in your first 90 days. * Manage a pipeline in CRM software (zoho.com) to achieve assigned sales revenue targets. * Navigate the buying process specific to your vertical: national account programs and construction standards, capital planning and plant engineering, or bond funding, public procurement cycles, and performance\-contracting routes. * Drive Mojave to Basis of Design with consulting engineers, design\-build contractors, and owner engineering standards groups. * Perform load and psychrometric analysis, equipment selection, and energy and life\-cycle cost comparisons against conventional DX, DOAS, and competing desiccant systems. * Assist with estimates, quoting, equipment selections, and submittals as required. * Translate vertical\-specific requirements into a concrete value proposition — e.g., store humidity setpoints and refrigeration case load in grocery, guest comfort and mold risk in hospitality, process humidity control in industrial, or ventilation and shoulder\-season dehumidification in schools. * Coordinate with our Manufacturer's Rep partners where territory and account coverage overlap, and keep the channel aligned rather than in conflict. * Act as Mojave's "Subject Matter Expert" (SME) for your vertical, internally and externally. * Identify product gaps, capture voice of customer, and work with Product Management to prioritize and eliminate identified gaps. * Help identify opportunities in adjacent verticals as we expand, even while your primary focus stays on your assigned vertical. * Partner with Field Support through startup and the first season of operation so that every early account becomes a reference account. * Perform educational presentations as required (lunch \& learns, CEUs, etc.). * Identify and attend appropriate trade shows and vertical industry events. * Ability to travel up to 60% of your time. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related STEM field. * 7\+ years of HVAC sales experience, including 5\+ years selling directly to owners, consulting engineers, and contractors. * Demonstrated technical and application depth across grocery, hospitality, industrial, and/or education buildings — how loads are calculated, how equipment is specified, and how projects are bid in each. * An established network and strong professional reputation in at least one of those four verticals, with relationships you can activate on day one. * Ability to perform psychrometric calculations and equipment selection. * Working command of latent load analysis, dedicated outdoor air systems (DOAS), and dehumidification strategies. * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal; one\-on\-one and in groups. * Highly organized with strong attention to detail, while able to prioritize diverse responsibilities. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Proven history of rapid sales growth with satisfied customers. * Experience selling a new or unproven technology, including pilots, first installations, and the additional work of establishing credibility. * Knowledgeable about Applied HVAC Equipment (Airside). * Experience with liquid or solid desiccant systems, heat recovery, or other latent\-specific equipment. * Thorough understanding of marketplace dynamics including industry trends. * Proven capability to communicate professionally in written and verbal format across a wide audience. * Able to work and communicate with multiple levels of positions within owner organizations and consulting engineering firms while building strong relationships and trust. * Able to work without direct guidance or direction from others. * Team player with strong collaborative abilities across business units. Mojave is a mission\-driven company focused on advancing air conditioning technology. We manufacture our products in the United States at our Anderson, South Carolina facility and our engineering lab is based in Sunnyvale, California. We are committed to a workplace grounded in integrity, excellence, collaboration, and meaningful work. The anticipated compensation range for this position is $140,000 \- $180,000 and an uncapped commission structure with an equity award (4\-year vest) on hire. Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and work location, consistent with applicable law. We offer a benefits package that may include annual bonus eligibility (equity award) health and welfare benefits, paid time off, company holidays, short/long\-term disability and life insurance (subject to plan terms, eligibility requirements and applicable law). Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Pursuit Engineer III
jobs.description: GeoStabilization International (GSI), Access Limited, and RoadGuard together form a leading infrastructure solutions platform dedicated to protecting people and strengthening critical infrastructure across North America and New Zealand. GSI is the premier geohazard mitigation firm specializing in emergency slope stabilization, landslide repair, grouting, and micropiles through innovative design\-build delivery. Access Limited brings over a century of steep\-slope expertise and operates North America's largest fleet of spider excavators, delivering complex rockfall and geotechnical solutions in the most challenging environments. RoadGuard, founded in 2024, unites industry\-leading roadway safety companies providing guardrail, bridge railing, highway signage, fencing, and specialty fabrication services. Across all our businesses, we are driven by innovation, extreme ownership, technical excellence, and a relentless commitment to measurable results that improve safety and infrastructure resilience. **Pursuit Engineer II \- Geotech Construction** =============================================== ### **Location Requirement** Candidates must be based in California. Los Angeles Metro Area or Bay Area preferred. Company\-sponsored travel required: approximately 50% regionally, including customer site visits and industry engagement. ### **Compensation** Targeted annual compensation range for this position in the United States is $126,000 \- $155,000\. ### **The Role** You will work alongside Project Development Engineers to support pursuits for geotechnical projects. This is a development role designed to teach you how GSI pursues work, wins business, and manages client relationships. You will contribute technical analysis, help shape proposals, and build relationships with key players in your market. You will learn pursuit management, develop technical acumen in geotechnical solutions, and gain hands\-on experience in heavy civil and transportation markets. Over time, you will progress toward owning your own accounts and pursuing work independently as a PDE. ### **Key Responsibilities** Support pursuit execution: assist PDEs in developing pursuit strategy, coordinating with estimating and engineering teams, and building technically credible proposals. Technical analysis and proposal support: research geotechnical challenges, evaluate solutions, and contribute technical content to client\-facing materials. Client engagement: participate in client meetings, site visits, and follow\-ups. Build relationships and learn how different stakeholders make decisions. Market research and pipeline support: identify and qualify opportunities in the heavy civil and transportation space. Track market activity and competitive positioning. Industry involvement: attend trade shows, events, and association meetings. Begin building your network in the industry. Administrative and coordination work: manage pursuit timelines, track deliverables, and ensure smooth communication across internal teams. ### **Core Competencies** Technical foundation: understand geotechnical design and construction methods well enough to research solutions and contribute to proposals. Willingness to deepen this knowledge. Relationship building: able to engage professionally with clients and internal teams. Natural at asking good questions and listening to understand needs. Communication: translate technical concepts into clear language. Write and present well enough to support proposals and client interactions. Problem solving: enjoy finding solutions to technical challenges. Comfortable asking for help and learning from more experienced team members. Ownership and initiative: take responsibility for your work. Follow through on commitments and identify what needs to be done without constant direction. Company representation: You consistently exemplify our Core Values: * Put People First * Always Do the Right Thing * Deliver Excellence Every Day * Break New Ground * Win As One ### **Minimum Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering or related Engineering field P.E., P.G., E.I.T., or G.I.T. licensure preferred 4\+ years of experience in engineering, construction, sales, or technical client\-facing roles Familiarity with construction practices and heavy equipment Experience working on proposals, in sales, or in a customer\-facing technical role CRM experience (Salesforce or equivalent) is a plus; B2W estimating software experience is a plus ### **Benefits** Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled Mental health benefits Company Ownership (Equity Stake) 401(k) plan to help save for your future including company match In addition to 7 observed holidays, salaried team members have flexible paid time off Paid parental leave *Soil Nail Holdings and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Robotics Controls Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer to help build the control systems that power our surgical robotic platform. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on developing, testing, and deploying real robotic systems. You will work closely with software, hardware, and product teams to design solutions that operate reliably in real\- world surgical environments. This is not a research\-only role. We are looking for engineers who can bridge controls theory and implementation, write production code, and take ownership of problems from concept to deployment. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and implement control algorithms for robotic systems. * Develop production software in C\+\+ and Python. * Design, test, and deploy robotic features from concept through production. * Build motion control, estimation, and robotic system behaviors. * Write tests and validation as a core part of how you build, not an afterthought. * Debug complex issues across software, controls, and hardware systems. * Work closely with cross\-functional teams to bring new capabilities to the robot. * Participate in real\-world system validation and deployment. ### **What We're Looking For** **Controls \& Robotics** * Strong foundation in robotics and control systems. * Experience implementing control algorithms in real\-world systems. * Understanding of dynamics, state estimation, feedback control, and motion planning. * Ability to reason through system\-level tradeoffs and constraints. **Software Engineering** You must be able to write and ship production code in C\+\+ on your own. They take ownership, work well with uncertainty, and are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. They collaborate effectively across software, hardware, robotics, and clinical teams, seek feedback early, and continuously refine their work. They are excited by challenging problems, move quickly from idea to implementation, and care about building systems that have real\-world impact. Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About The Electric Plant Co.** The Electric Plant Co. is building a new category of plant intelligence. Our Model, Bombadil, decodes those signals into real\-time insights about plant health, growth, and stress. Our IoT hardware measures the hidden electrical signals in plants and trees, paired with environmental data, and our foundation model. We're a small, fast\-moving company working at the intersection of biology, hardware, AI, and IoT. **The Role** You'll join the small team building Bombadil and work directly on training: the data the model learns from, the architecture and training decisions that determine whether a run succeeds, and the evaluation work to measure our progress. This is a small team. You’ll drive machine learning projects from idea to production from end\-to\-end, rather than specializing into one piece of a much larger machine, and you’ll help build systems and practices that scale. This is a senior, individually\-contributing role with no direct reports, reporting to our Head of AI \& ML. **What You'll Own** * **Transformer training.** Model architecture, data curation, training strategies, and the full lifecycle to production. * **Evaluation of the core model.** Building and refining evaluations to measure progress of new model capabilities. * **Model lifecycle practices.** Develop robust, repeatable model lifecycle systems for rapid iteration. **What We're Looking For** * Has built and trained transformer models from scratch, not only fine\-tuned them, and can speak concretely to the data, architecture, and training\-stability decisions involved. * Roughly 3\+ years of hands\-on transformer\-specific experience is ideal, generally within 5\-10 years of overall ML/engineering experience. * Has shipped or maintained ML systems in a practical capacity. * Comfortable driving projects end\-to\-end, from data collection through evaluation, without a large specialized team around you. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: you build and maintain real training and evaluation infrastructure, not just notebooks. * Technical or scientific depth, not necessarily in CS or ML specifically. * Comfortable being one of a very small number of people responsible for a company's core model. **Strong plus** * Experience with biological, environmental, or other scientific data. **What This Isn't** This isn't a role for someone who wants a large ML org's infrastructure and specialization already built around them; on a team this size, you'll cover more of the pipeline yourself. It's also not a pure research role: the work has to end up in a model that ships, not just a result that publishes. If you want to bring new skills to a small team building something new, and to build the practice as much as the model, we'd like to talk. **Compensation \& logistics** * Salary range is $223k \- $253k per year, with meaningful early\-stage equity * Standard benefits * Full\-time, in\-person at our Presidio office in San Francisco * Start date: ASAP *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ GridCARE is a leading venture\-backed startup solving the most critical constraint in AI’s growth trajectory: **immediate access to power.** As demand for computing skyrockets, access to energy has become the defining bottleneck in the AI infrastructure race. While leading tech companies invest billions in speculative, long\-term solutions that may take decades to arrive, GridCARE’s pioneering physics\-based generative AI platform unlocks gigawatts of hidden capacity in today’s electric grid — enabling hyperscalers, data center developers, and utilities to power AI infrastructure years sooner than conventional approaches and without costly upgrades. Founded at Stanford’s Doerr School of Sustainability and backed by leading climate\-tech and deep\-tech investors, GridCARE has assembled a world\-class team spanning power systems, AI, and infrastructure. At GridCARE, you will: Work at the **intersection of AI, energy, and infrastructure** — the foundation of the next industrial revolution. Partner with **hyperscalers, developers, and utilities** on **high\-impact, real\-world deployments.** Help shape a **more abundant, efficient, and resilient energy future** for the digital era. Join a company **defining a new category — capacity acceleration for AI.** Receive **competitive compensation, equity, and benefits** in a fast\-growth, mission\-driven environment. *Learn more about GridCARE:* * TechCrunch: *GridCARE thinks more than 100 GW of data\-center capacity is hiding in the grid* * Utility Dive: *Portland General Electric invests in AI\-powered flexibility to speed data\-center connection* * Data Center Dynamics: *From Years to Months — Creating an AI Fast Lane for Data Centers* * GridCARE Raises $64 Million Series A to Create a New Category: Power Acceleration **Job Description** ------------------- We're looking for a Senior SRE to own the reliability, scalability, and observability of our production systems. You'll work closely with platform and data engineering to keep high\-throughput, data\-intensive services running at the availability our customers (utilities, data center operators) require. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design and operate infrastructure on AWS using Terraform and Kubernetes * Build monitoring, alerting, and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar) with meaningful SLOs/SLIs * Automate away toil — deployment pipelines, capacity management, self\-healing systems * Partner with engineering on architecture reviews to catch reliability and scalability risks before they ship * Manage database and data pipeline reliability for large\-scale, real\-time grid data processing * Drive security and compliance best practices across infrastructure **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** * 5\+ years in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering roles * **Deep experience with Kubernetes, Terraform/IaC, and cloud platforms (AWS Preferred)** * **Strong scripting/programming ability (Python, Bash)** * **Observability Experience (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)** * Track record of running on\-call for production processing systems * Background in energy, climate tech, or critical infrastructure * Experience scaling infrastructure through hypergrowth * On\-Prem Kubernetes Deployment Experience * Windows Server Administration Experience **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity. * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage. * Lunch provided three days a important infrastructure challenges of our time — enabling the energy foundation for the age of AI.**
