jobs.description: **Position Summary** This position supports the execution of construction projects by assisting project managers in overseeing planning, financial tracking, subcontractor management, and quality control efforts to meet business, client, and operational objectives. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Collaborates with preconstruction teams to support project estimating, cost control, and schedule development. * Reviews and coordinates scopes of work, ensuring alignment with drawings, specifications, and project objectives. * Prepares and reviews submittals for accuracy, completeness, and compliance. * Compiles and analyzes pay applications, change requests, and other financial documents related to project progress. * Participates in subcontractor bidding, evaluations, and award recommendations, including the preparation of proposals. * Assists in contract administration, including monitoring deliverables and compliance with contract terms. * Oversees time tracking and reporting in coordination with field supervision and administrative staff to ensure accuracy and adherence to company policy. * Communicates and coordinates with owners, architects, engineers, inspectors, and subcontractors to support project alignment and timely decision\-making. * Organizes and facilitates project meetings to address coordination, material needs, and labor concerns. * Drafts correspondence, reports, meeting minutes, and other project documentation. * Maintains and updates resource data including vendor contacts, material specifications, and regulatory requirements. * Assists with or coordinates material procurement and delivery to ensure field teams have the resources needed. * Performs other related duties as assigned to ensure efficient and effective processes, completion of projects and smooth operation of department. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, or a related field preferred; high school diploma or GED required. * Minimum of 2\+ years of experience in electrical or general construction project coordination or management. * Prior electrical estimating experience is a plus. * Journeyman Electrician’s License is a plus. * Strong computer literacy and comfort working with project management and estimating tools. **Required Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities** * Strong ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced, project\-driven environment. * Excellent organizational, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook), Bluebeam, Accubid, and scheduling software. * Ability to read and interpret construction documents, technical specifications, and schematics. * Proficient in construction takeoffs and basic estimating. * Working knowledge of electrical construction materials and practices. * High attention to detail with the ability to exercise discretion and independent judgment. * Demonstrated leadership capability and a commitment to a safety\-first culture. * Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record. **Work Environment** *The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* This job may work inside or outside with possible exposure to extreme hot or cold temperatures and weather elements in restricted or confined spaces, and on slippery or uneven surfaces. This job may have exposure to working on ladders, scaffolds, aerial lifts, catwalks, and other exposures typical of heavy construction. This job also operates in an office setting. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets. **Physical Demands** *The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* * Must be able to traverse and inspect all areas of jobsite in all types of weather; this may include walking, climbing reaching, bending crawling, standing, or stretching. * The employee must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, lift and /or move up to 50 pounds * Move about on the feet regularly. Sit for extended periods of time. * Requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods of time. * May require travel. * Exposure to characteristic construction site dangers. * Talk and hear, ability to communicate with others both written and orally and by telephone. * Possess good vision, normal or corrected. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision to discern color coded wires, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. * Possesses good hearing, normal or corrected. * Must be able to wear personal protective equipment (hard hat, safety glasses, safety vest), as needed. * Must be able to work 8 hours a day, 40 hours per week, and overtime as required and night shifts, as needed. Must be on\-call to address delays, emergencies, bad weather, and other issues at the jobsite. * Must be able to work in the presence of customers and their representatives with little or no interference or disruption to the customer while maintaining a professional and courteous image. *CEC Companies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to attracting and retaining the best\-qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.*

jobs.title: Vice President of Facility Design
jobs.description: **OVERVIEW:** The VP – Club Expansion is responsible for preparing new Club facilities for opening, coordinating all purchases, equipment and service installations, collaborating with Club4Fitness leadership in identifying improvements and overcoming deficiencies in systems/services, liaising with contractors to prepare new Club facilities while also assisting in refreshing and renovating existing facilities/facility spaces. The VP \- Facility Design provides executive\-level leadership and oversight of all facility design initiatives supporting new club development, major remodels, refresh programs, prototype evolution, and capital improvement projects across CLUB4 Fitness. This role is responsible for establishing and executing the company's facility design strategy, maintaining prototype and brand standards, driving operational excellence, managing architecture, engineering, and construction partnerships, with an eye to ensuring that projects are completed on time, on budget, and in scope. The VP – Facility Design partners cross\-functionally with Finance, Construction, IT Support vendors, Marketing, and Operations to support CLUB4 FITNESS's growth, reinvestment, and long\-term development strategy to develop scalable design processes, governance standards, and quality assurance programs while fostering strong consultant relationships, disciplined financial management, and continuous improvement across all projects. Ultimately, this position is accountable for project outcomes, vendor performance, and successful club openings to consistent member satisfaction allowing CLUB4 Fitness to maintain its competitiveness within each market. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and or ability required. **GENERAL SCOPE OF WORK:** * Oversee all new club design, major remodels, refresh initiatives, and capital improvement projects. * Develop and execute the long\-term Facility design strategy aligned with company growth objectives. * Own and continuously evolve the CLUB4 FITNESS Fitness prototype and design standards. * Serve as an expert in material selection and design expertise in the fitness industry. * Establish scalable design processes, QA/QC standards, SOPs, project stage gates, and performance metrics. * Build and maintain strong partnerships with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, project managers, vendors, and manufacturers. * CLUB4 Fitness subject matter expert and point of contact for all related architectural and engineering consulting agreements, expert selection, and performance as well as contract management. * Oversee architectural design, interior design, branding, equipment planning, signage, and construction documentation. * Provide executive reporting on project performance, consultant performance, budgets, risks, and prototype initiatives. * End\-to\-end oversight and execution of all owner\-direct vendor orders, including scope validation, quotes, purchase orders, production tracking, delivery, installation, commissioning, invoice review, warranties, and closeout. * Direct accountability for the identified equipment, signage, technology, recovery, amenities, retail, and specialty vendors. ON TIME * Ensure on\-time delivery of all design packages supporting new club openings and remodels. * Develop and manage design schedules aligned with development and construction milestones. * Coordinate architectural, engineering, and consultant deliverables to maintain project schedules. * Monitor project progress and proactively mitigate design\-related schedule risks. * Conduct design status reviews and escalate schedule impacts as needed. * Communicate schedule updates and critical milestones with internal stakeholders and project teams. * Support construction and operations by delivering accurate, timely design documentation. * Integrated management of design, procurement, construction milestones, opening readiness, and project closeout. * Defined responsibility for pre\-punch inspections, final punch\-list management, and correction of opening\-critical deficiencies. + Punch\-list closure + RFI and submittal turnaround IN SCOPE * Maintain CLUB4 FITNESS prototype standards and brand consistency across all projects. * Ensure design deliverables support operational readiness and successful club openings. * Oversee timely design reviews, RFIs, submittals, and consultant coordination. * Lead value engineering while preserving design intent and the member experience + Project documentation and closeout + Vendor scorecards and corrective actions ON BUDGET * Maintain accountability for architecture, engineering, and design consultant budgets. * Develop annual budgets, forecasts, and long\-range planning. * Oversee consultant selection, contract negotiations, and fee management. * Review and approve consultant proposals, invoices, and contract amendments. * Monitor project budgets and address scope or cost variances. * Drive value engineering while maintaining prototype standards and design intent. * Optimize consultant performance through strategic partnerships and scope management. * Stronger controls around budgets, change orders, scope gaps, vendor performance, and project risks. + Opening dates achieved + Substantial completion dates achieved + Vendor orders released on schedule + On\-time delivery and installation **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS****:** * 10\+ years of progressive facility design, construction, development, or capital\-project experience, including at least four years leading teams or major portfolios. * Demonstrated success delivering multi\-site retail, fitness, hospitality, or comparable commercial projects from design through opening and closeout. * Hands\-on experience managing owner\-furnished equipment, signage, technology, specialty systems, and vendor\-direct procurement. * Strong command of architectural, engineering, interiors, construction documents, field coordination, QA/QC, and project controls. * Proven ability to manage budgets, forecasts, contracts, purchase orders, invoices, change orders, claims, and vendor performance. * Ability to read plans and specifications, identify scope gaps, challenge assumptions, and drive timely decisions. * Executive\-level communication, negotiation, team leadership, and cross\-functional influence. * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and relevant project systems; experience with platforms such as Bluebeam, Procore, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Asana, or Airtable is preferred. * Demonstrated knowledge of Fitness and Exercise facilities, equipment, services (including electronic and billing systems), programming, etc. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport with vendor representatives, municipal leaders, contractors, and Club4Fitness personnel at all levels of the organization. * Experience cultivating membership bases as well as business vendors within C4F communities. * Ability to be a self\-starter with demonstrated capability to resolve issues ‘in the moment’. * Ability to work successfully in both team environments and autonomously. * Detail orientation and focus with strong problem\-solving skills. * Strong time management skills, ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a rapidly changing environment. * Ability to demonstrate and maintain a friendly and enthusiastic attitude coupled with undeniably strong interpersonal communication skills. * Computer proficiency with strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite as well as fitness and exercise computer\-based programs and related software in use at C4F. * Willingness to accept nearly 100% travel

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Legacy Applications & Modernization
jobs.description: CSC Generation is the AI\-native holding company re\-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B\+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real\-world innovation labs. **Reports to:** \[Reports to: TBD] **Location:** Houston, TX (Hybrid) ### **About the Role** CSC Generation's portfolio runs on a mix of legacy systems spanning .NET, Python, JavaScript, and Java. These applications are critical to daily operations, and they need someone dedicated to keeping them healthy while steadily modernizing how they are built, tested, deployed, and monitored. As **Software Engineer \- Legacy Applications \& Modernization**, you will own the maintenance and incremental improvement of these systems — building CI/CD pipelines, increasing test coverage, containerizing applications, and adding observability so the team can catch problems before customers do. Within your first six months, you will have shipped pipeline and testing improvements that measurably reduce production incidents. This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end\-to\-end responsibility. ### **What You'll Do** * Maintain, debug, and enhance legacy applications written in .NET Framework, Python, JavaScript, and Java * Analyze and resolve production issues with minimal downtime * Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using AWS services, Docker, and Ansible * Containerize legacy applications and orchestrate deployments * Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management with Ansible * Write and optimize SQL queries, administer relational database systems, and implement safe database migrations and schema updates * Develop and integrate automated unit and integration tests, increasing test coverage and establishing test automation frameworks * Implement logging, metrics, and tracing across legacy applications and configure monitoring and alerting systems to detect issues proactively ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or currently enrolled in a 4\-year program pursuing the equivalent, or equivalent professional experience) * Demonstrated experience with at least 2 of the following: .NET Framework, Python, JavaScript, Java * Understanding of legacy application patterns and technical debt * Hands\-on experience with AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFormation, CodePipeline, etc.) * Proficiency with Docker containerization * Experience with Ansible for infrastructure automation * Strong SQL query writing and optimization skills * Experience administering and troubleshooting relational database systems (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) * Experience writing unit tests and integration tests using frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, JUnit, pytest, or Jest * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities * Excellent communication and documentation skills * Version control experience with Git or similar ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working across multiple legacy technology stacks simultaneously * Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, CloudWatch, Datadog, etc.) * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code principles * Background in application modernization or refactoring projects * Familiarity with agile development practices * AWS certifications or other cloud platform certifications ### **Why Join** The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work. * **Meaningful Work from Day One:** You will work on systems that power real brands and real revenue — your fixes and improvements have immediate, visible impact. * **Training \& Development:** Gain hands\-on experience across multiple technology stacks, cloud infrastructure, and modern DevOps practices with direct mentorship from your manager and team. * **Trusted from Day One:** You will own applications end\-to\-end — from debugging production issues to shipping pipeline improvements — with real responsibility, not busywork. * **Competitive Benefits:** Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands. ### **Interview Process** * **Recruiter Screen** \- A 30\-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for. * **Hiring Manager Interview** \- Conversation focused on your experience with legacy systems, DevOps practices, and approach to modernization. * **Technical / Case Discussion** \- A technical conversation covering debugging, CI/CD design, SQL, and testing strategies relevant to the role. * **In\-Person Interview** \- We'd like to meet you at our Houston office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter. * **Reference Checks** \- Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible. * **Offer** \- We move quickly for the right candidate. *Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.* ### **Please Note** * Part of our interview process is a **mandatory in\-person interview** with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in\-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately. * Due to a high volume of fraudulent applications, **you must share a valid LinkedIn profile URL in** **the application questions below to be considered**. If you do not have a LinkedIn profile, you must provide a credible reason in that field and supply alternative evidence of your professional background to verify your identity. CSC Generation will conduct an exhaustive background check including verifying dates of employment directly with your former employer. CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Linux Engineer
jobs.description: **Innovation at its Best: Join our Forward\-Thinking Company** At CableLabs we wake up every day to invent the future. CableLabs is a global, award\-winning innovation and R\&D lab dedicated to keeping people connected by building and orchestrating emergent technology and igniting co\-innovation today for the broadband of tomorrow. The Senior Linux Engineer position is part of the Information Technologies department at CableLabs. The department is responsible for delivering technology services across the organization and overseeing the IT systems, solutions, and resources purchased or developed by the company. Our team plays a critical role in providing reliable, timely, and consistent services while maintaining a strong focus on security. **Why This Role Is Exciting** The position is ideal for an individual who is experienced in implementing and managing several aspects of datacenter infrastructure. The Senior Linux Engineer is responsible for designing, maintaining, securing, and improving CableLabs’ Linux\-based infrastructure across physical, virtual, and cloud\-connected environments, providing technical leadership for systems operations, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, and platform reliability. The role is expected to operate independently, support complex production environments, mentor other IT team members, and drive continuous improvement through automation, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration. You will work closely with the rest of the IT team to establish standards and consistency to help provide the services necessary for not only the CableLabs business partners but for the research and testing teams as well. **What You’ll Do:** * Architect, deploy, maintain, and support Linux\-based infrastructure across bare\-metal, virtual, lab, and cloud\-connected environments, keeping it reliable, secure, patched, monitored, and performant. * Design and enforce Linux hardening standards and security policies; manage vulnerability response (Tenable/Nessus, CVE remediation) and develop infrastructure\-as\-code and automation (Terraform, Ansible) to reduce manual effort and improve reliability. * Manage and maintain critical Linux\-hosted platforms, including GitLab, LibreNMS, Nagios, and Splunk\-related components, keeping them at current security release levels with minimal operational impact. * Design and improve IT monitoring and alerting across systems, storage, services, and SSL certificates; respond to incidents, troubleshoot root causes, and document fixes to prevent recurrence. * Prioritize and complete Linux\-related tickets, maintenance, patching, and lifecycle activities. * Provide Linux technical guidance and mentorship to IT team members and lab or engineering users; maintain documentation, SOPs, and knowledge\-transfer materials, and support relevant license and contract renewals. * Collaborate with development, security, infrastructure, lab, and operations teams to reduce operational risk and support CableLabs initiatives; evaluate and introduce new Linux technologies where appropriate. * Other duties as assigned. **What Is a Must Have:** * 4\+ years of hands\-on Linux systems engineering experience in production, enterprise, lab, or mission\-critical environments, with a strong knowledge of common Linux distributions. * Hands\-on experience with on premise virtualization systems (Vmware, QEMU/KVM). Demonstrated experience with cloud platform deployment and maintenance of Linux systems. * Demonstrated experience administering, patching, securing, and troubleshooting Linux servers at scale, with vulnerability management and solid networking fundamentals. * Strong scripting and automation skills, with experience in infrastructure\-as\-code, source control, and monitoring/alerting tools. * Strong documentation and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work independently and manage multiple systems or projects simultaneously. **What Will Set You Apart:** * Strong knowledge of a major Linux distribution and enterprise licensing and vendor coordination. * Knowledge and experience with IEEE802\.3 (ethernet), 802\.1Q (bridging/lvan) and TCP/IP. Both IPv4 and IPv6 addressing concepts, subnetting, routing and firewall filtering. * Experience with configuration management and infrastructure\-as\-code, virtualization, and containerization. * Experience with backup and recovery platforms, cloud platforms, and CI/CD or DevOps practices. * Experience developing monitoring and reporting automation, supporting SSL certificate lifecycle, lab or research\-oriented infrastructure, and disaster recovery planning. * 7\+ years of Linux systems engineering experience, including prior senior or lead\-level responsibility, is a plus. * Strong technical judgment and ownership mindset, balancing day\-to\-day operational support with long\-term improvements in reliability, security, and automation. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, with the ability to mentor peers, drive technical decisions across teams, and manage competing priorities. **At CableLabs You’ll Enjoy Comprehensive Compensation and Benefits:** **Compensation:** The salary range is $117,910 \- $144,170\. This position is eligible for bonus incentive compensation up to 20% of base salary. **Health Benefits:** Comprehensive healthcare coverage including medical, dental, vision insurance. Access to flexible spending and health savings accounts with employer HSA contribution. **Retirement Benefits:** Competitive 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match up to 6%plus an ADDITIONAL 8% contribution to 401(k) which becomes fully vested after only two years of employment. **Work\-Life Balance:** Flexible work arrangements**,** Unlimited PTO, 11 paid holidays**,** 100% paid family and medical leave. To learn more and discover additional benefits, read our Employee Benefits Guide. **Working conditions and physical requirements:** This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment. * This position will operate in a lab environment; this position requires travel up to 10% of the time * May be required to lift, move and transport related laboratory equipment up to 50lbs. **We understand that the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can make it challenging for exceptional candidates to apply. We encourage you to apply confidently and without hesitation, you may just be the right candidate for this position or similar opportunities.** *CableLabs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at humanresourcesteam@cablelabs.com or 303\-661\-3307\. View our full EEO policy* *here**.*

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - Low Power Verification
jobs.description: **At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Join our team and help build the next generation of low\-power verification software for the Palladium and Protium emulation and prototyping platforms. As a Lead Software Engineer \- Low Power Verification you will be responsible for improving the performance and usability of UPF debug features, adding support for new IEEE 1801 LRM revisions, and rebuilding UPF documentation around end\-to\-end workflows for multi\-billion\-gate low\-power designs. What you will do: * Enhance UPF debug features \- improve performance and usability across the Parallel Partition Compiler (PPC) and Modular Compiler (MC) flows, including Dielet UPF support. * Scale UPF event logging and violation detection – apply new techniques to capture and report more UPF events, with better multi\-billion\-gate low\-power designs. * Rebuild UPF documentation around end\-to\-end debug scenarios and workflows, backed by valid SystemVerilog and UPF examples. * Help develop AI\-assisted UPF debug tools to reduce time\-to\-root\-cause for low\-power design issues. * Work with R\&D, PE and AE teams to deploy UPF solutions across key flows (AVIP, UVMA, MC, and Dielets \- each with UPF in 2\- and 4\-state). * Help consolidate and unify UPF debug across Palladium and Protium. What we are looking for * BS in CS, EE, or a related field with 4\+ years of experience; MS with 2\+ years; PhD with 1\+ year; or equivalent practical experience. * Working knowledge of IEEE 1801 UPF and RTL languages (Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL). * Strong debugging skills — root\-cause analysis from logs, waveforms, traces, testcases, and user reports. * Ability to read, review, and reason about C\+\+ code and object\-oriented designs. * Fluency with AI\-assisted coding tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or equivalent), with critical evaluation of AI output. * Strong communication and technical writing skills — able to turn scattered debug evidence into clear, user\-facing workflows. *The annual salary range for California is $114,800 to $213,200\. You may also be eligible to receive incentive compensation: bonus, equity, and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the salary range is a guideline and compensation may vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies and work location. Our benefits programs include: paid vacation and paid holidays, 401(k) plan with employer match, employee stock purchase plan, a variety of medical, dental and vision plan options, and more.* **We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.** -------------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.title: Automation Scientist
jobs.description: **Automation Scientist** **Caltech** **Job Category:** Fulltime Term **Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Exempt **Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based Caltech is a world\-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community. **About ELECTRA** Caltech has been awarded funding under the National Science Foundation's Programmable Cloud Laboratories (PCL) Test Bed program to establish ELECTRA, a remotely accessible, AI\-enabled automated laboratory for electron diffraction (MicroED) and structural elucidation. ELECTRA is one node in a planned nationwide network of PCL Test Bed facilities that will let researchers anywhere, including at institutions with limited access to advanced instrumentation, submit and run real experiments over the cloud. We are hiring the founding team that will help build and operate the node. The cross\-disciplinary team is composed of scientists and engineers from academia and the private sector. This project will directly impact various scientific fields, including chemistry, biology, and materials science, with applications in tech and medicine. (See https://www.nsf.gov/tip/updates/nsf\-announces\-400m\-investment\-new\-national\-network\-ai.) As Automation Scientist, you will design the scientific logic behind ELECTRA's automated experiments, from electron microscopy and sample\-prep workflows to the acceptance criteria that make a remotely run experiment trustworthy, and support the users who run them. **Job Duties** * Design, build, and validate automated and semi\-autonomous electron microscopy and sample\-preparation workflows, including closed\-loop, active\-learning strategies that improve hit rates with less human intervention. * Express experimental logic as reviewable protocols and machine\-readable specifications, and establish the acceptance criteria, calibration routines, validation standards, and failure/recovery definitions that make a remotely executed experiment trustworthy. * Analyze and interpret experimental datasets, and curate high\-quality datasets, including metadata and failure cases, to inform workflow design and support AI\-driven experiment design and cross\-node standards. * Collaborate with the team to translate experimental logic into instrument\-control routines, scheduling constraints, and user\-facing interfaces, and co\-develop common experimental\-design and laboratory protocols with counterparts at other PCL nodes. * Provide expert technical support to onboarded users, on\-site and remote, helping them translate scientific questions into executable ELECTRA experiments. * Contribute to recruitment and onboarding workshops, user documentation, and facility tours; mentor students and junior staff; and contribute to publications and technical reports. **Minimum Qualifications** * Ph.D. in chemistry, materials science, structural biology, chemical engineering, physics, or a related field plus 1 year of related experience (or Master's Degree with at least 3 years of related experience). * Track record of publishing work. * Hands\-on experience with a structural characterization method. * Experience automating laboratory workflows or running high\-throughput experimentation. * Proficiency in coding and data processing. * Strong collaboration and written communication skills, and genuine interest in supporting users at institutions with fewer resources than ours. **Preferred Qualifications** * Electron diffraction experience, including low\-dose data collection and sample preparation. * Experience with self\-driving labs, materials acceleration platforms, active learning, or Bayesian experimental design. * Fluency with crystallography pipelines (XDS, DIALS, CCP4, PHENIX, SHELX, or equivalents). * Robotic sample handling or liquid\-handling automation. * Experience supporting external users at a shared instrument facility, beamline, or core. **Required Documents** * Resume * Cover letter explaining relevant experience **To be considered for this position please visit our web site and apply on line at the following link:** **https://hr.caltech.edu/work/job\_openings** *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* je\-bff00b6bbe7e47e0ad81a09ec4afcdef

jobs.description: **Career Area:** Technology, Digital and Data**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. **Help Build the Future of Caterpillar** At Caterpillar, technology always has a purpose, which is to solve our customers’ toughest challenges. You’ll build and deploy against one of the most unique data foundations—over 1\.6 million connected assets generating real\-world data daily. These data and platform capabilities are enabling the development of AI models, edge computing architectures, and software systems that scale across fleets, products, and industries. The result will be a new generation of machines that continuously learn, improve, and deliver performance at scale. **Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites** Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality. Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes of high\-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against. If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations. Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar. **Job Summary:** The Portfolio Manager (Autonomy) runs the day\-to\-day Portfolio operating system for Construction Autonomy and the broader CI portfolio. This role integrates roadmap, governance, financial, dependency, partner, and executive\-review inputs into clear decisions, controlled changes, accountable actions, and closure. The Portfolio Manager coordinates the Portfolio team’s operating work across demand, reporting, governance, analysis, and cross\-mission execution. **What You Will Do:** * Run the Portfolio operating and escalate material tradeoffs. * Direct and coordinate Portfolio team work, protect clear accountability, and ensure recurring work transfers from temporary bridges to named owners. **What You Will Have:** * Planning: Tactical and Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and the ability to connect near\-term operating plans, multi\-year roadmaps, resources, dependencies, and business objectives. * Program and Portfolio Management: Knowledge of practices used to organize, govern, monitor, and integrate multiple complex digital programs and interdependent workstreams. * Project Administration: Ability to establish operating discipline, maintain decision and action traceability, resolve conflicts, and ensure work follows defined governance processes. * Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Ability to evaluate incomplete or conflicting information, frame options and consequences, and drive timely, evidence\-based decisions. * Organizational Leadership: Ability to coordinate diverse teams, assign clear ownership, influence across organizational boundaries, and deputize effectively for senior leadership. * Change Control: Knowledge of processes used to identify, evaluate, approve, communicate, monitor, and document material changes to scope, sequence, funding, milestones, and commitments. * Project Control and Reporting: Ability to integrate roadmap, delivery, financial, risk, dependency, and partner information into concise, credible reporting and executive decision support. **Top Candidates Will Have:** * Experience leading portfolio or program controlled changes, escalation, and closure. * Experience integrating technical delivery, roadmap, capacity, financial, procurement, and partner information for senior\-leadership decisions. * Ability to operate at both executive and working\-team altitudes without absorbing accountability that belongs to Product, TPM, Mission Lead, Architecture, Engineering, Finance, or the RTE. * Working knowledge of Azure DevOps, Power BI, or comparable portfolio and work\-management tools, including traceability, dependency, and reporting concepts. * Strong written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and the ability to simplify complex cross\-functional issues into clear options and recommendations. **Additional Details:** * This position requires the candidate to work full\-time onsite jobs.title: Bioinformatics Technologist I/II
jobs.description: Join Cleveland Clinic’s Main Campus where research and surgery are advanced, technology is leading\-edge, patient care is world class and caregivers are family. As a Bioinformatics Technologist I or II, you will develop, maintain and run software systems and bioinformatic pipelines for processing and analyzing next\-generation sequencing data. In this role, you will perform software programming in various languages, including raw data quality control, sequence alignment, variant calling, annotation and reporting. You will provide input to develop software and data analysis solutions, complete department tasks and provide ongoing support for existing databases and software while working collaboratively with software engineers, computational biologists, and clinical and basic research scientists. This role will participate in translational cancer research. The laboratory of Dr. Przybyl develops novel, clinically applicable liquid biopsy testing methods for sarcoma and applies multi\-omic (genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic and methylome) high\-throughput methods to discover new diagnostic markers and therapeutic targets in sarcomas. In this role, you will build bioinformatic pipelines, analyze high\-throughput data and interpret results using statistical techniques. You will also develop and implement data analyses, acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and maintain databases. Develop basic statistical, mathematical and predictive models, build algorithms and perform data analytics. In collaboration with bioinformatics specialists, maintain and run software systems for bioinformatics processing of sequence data, including raw data quality control, sequence alignment, variant calling, annotation and reporting. Develop and implement workflows for data analysis tools in collaboration with research scientists. Build and deploy data analysis support systems for large datasets, including well\-structured flat files, APIs and other types of services. Acquire, clean, structure and manage data from multiple sources to ensure data quality. Utilize process enhancement opportunities to improve the efficiency of data pulling, reporting, programming and operations. Support existing production pipelines Troubleshoot and resolve issues as needed. Identify, evaluate and apply new computational methodologies and emerging technologies to improve existing methods and tools. Analyze genomics data in partnership with experimental and computational team members, industry partners and collaborators. Perform literature reviews to learn about gold standard data analysis methods. Write scripts, run analyses, visualize data and create figures for papers, presentations and posters. Solve problems related to data analysis and troubleshoot and adapt published methodologies. Prepare data for a variety of research projects. Assist lab members, including graduate students and postdoctoral fellows, with training on bioinformatic tools. Supervise and train trainees in their quantitative research projects. Contribute to research protocols and grant proposals. Perform other duties as assigned. Python or Perl Experience with high\-performance computing cluster Experience analyzing high\-throughput genomic, epigenomic and transcriptomic data (e.g., microarray data, next generation sequencing data) supported by published peer\-reviewed studies Knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook) Bioinformatics Technologist II Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include: Bachelor’s degree in computer science/software engineering/bioinformatics or related field and three years of relevant experience OR Master’s degree in a similar field and one year of relevant experience Experience in DNA and RNA\-seq data analysis Solid understanding of all stages of software development cycle Fluency in programming languages (Java, Python, Perl, R), UNIX shell scripts and database management systems (MySQL or PostgreSQL) Experience with common bioinformatics tools (BWA, Bowtie, SAMtools, GATK, MuTect, VarScan, Strelka, STAR) Proficiency with Linux/UNIX tools in high\-performance computing clusters (HPC) environment Excellent presentation and communication skills Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include: Experience with single\-cell RNA sequencing data Familiarity with agile software development approach Experience with Cloud Computing Experience analyzing high\-throughput genomic, epigenomic and transcriptomic data (e.g., microarray data, next generation sequencing data) supported by published peer\-reviewed studies Knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook) **The compensation range provided corresponds to the Bioinformatics Technologist I or Bioinformatics Technologist II position. Ability to travel throughout the hospital system. Ability to operate a computer and other office equipment. Ability to communicate and exchange accurate information. Personal Protective Equipment: Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment. The following qualifications will help you succeed in this role: * Currently enrolled as a junior pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related field * Interested in land development, infrastructure, or site design * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Effective communicator and collaborative team player * Eager to learn in a fast\-paced, multidisciplinary AEC environment **Work Location** This is an onsite position based out of the following Core States Group offices: Kent, WA; Bellevue, WA; Puyallup, WA; Richland, WA; Roseville, CA; Scottsdale, AZ; Frisco, TX; Bentonville, AR; or Philadelphia, PA. **Overview** Core States Group designs, builds, and manages programs and projects across North America and has been recognized on top lists throughout the architecture, engineering, and construction (A/E/C) industry. Responsibilities: **Customer Training Delivery*** Own and deliver instructor\-led and virtual customer training programs on unique Cotiviti Interoperability Smart Trading and Encounter Management products, features, and workflows for enterprise clients to include the following Cotiviti courses: 1\. Interoperability Onboarding 2\. Smart Trading Boot Camp 3\. Edifecs Smart Trading, Spec Builder 4\. Edifecs Smart Trading, Map Builder Fundamentals 5\. Edifecs Smart Trading, Advanced Map Builder 6\. Edifecs Smart Trading Platform 7\. Edifecs Smart Trading, X\-Engine Fundamentals 8\. Edifecs Smart Trading, XEngine Server Fundamentals 9\. Edifecs Smart Trading, Transaction Management 10\. simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos, or lectures to US Healthcare payer leaders and their IT, support, trainers and business operations teams adopting and upgrading Cotiviti Interoperability solutions. * Manage post\-training evaluations, collect feedback, generate learning analytics reports, and share insights with customer success teams. * Serve as the primary training point\-of\-contact for assigned customer accounts, directing the training activity integrated with Cotiviti Delivery excellence Framework (DEF) to build and maintain trusted relationships with client leaders, learners, customer trainers and support teams. **Cotiviti Staff Training Delivery*** Own and deliver instructor\-led and virtual staff training programs on unique Cotiviti Interoperability Smart Trading and Encounter Management products, features, and workflows for enterprise clients, * Onboard new\-hire staff and cross\-train staff with unique Cotiviti Interoperability Smart Trading, and Encounter Management training programs that prepare learners from across the company to perform their roles including Cotiviti Interoperability quarterly Boot Camp. * Conduct training needs assessments with internal stakeholders to design, develop and deliver customized content format and depth such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos, or lectures to US Healthcare payer leaders and their IT, support, trainers and business operations teams adopting and upgrading Cotiviti Interoperability solutions * Manage post\-training evaluations, collect feedback, generate learning analytics reports, and share insights with customer success teams. * Serve as the primary training point\-of\-contact for assigned customer accounts, directing the training activity integrated with Cotiviti Delivery excellence Framework (DEF) to build and maintain trusted relationships with client leaders, learners, customer trainers and support teams. **Cotiviti Product Certifications*** Leverage advanced healthcare payer domain, SaaS technology and product knowledge and skill to design and manage Cotiviti Interoperability product expert certification programs ensuring alignment with product, technology and domain to recognize product knowledge, skill and role\-specific performance standards.* Apply product expertise to assess advanced\-level certification examination results and manually adjudicate certification skill assessment capstone exercises against Cotiviti\-defined performance standards to establish and maintain industry\-standard recognition of customer and Cotiviti product, services competence. **Subject Matter Expertise \& Collaboration*** Build and maintain deep Cotiviti Interoperability product and healthcare interoperability payer domain expertise to deliver credible, authoritative training to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Expertise in Cotiviti’s intellectual property as evidenced in the Cotiviti proprietary software stack, healthcare EDI tr er with Product, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to stay current on product changes, regulatory changes impacting interoperability, Cotiviti implementation methodologies and translate them into training updates. * Provide technical troubleshooting support for Cotiviti Interoperability product adoption during live training sessions to ensure seamless delivery operating within the Cotiviti implementation Delivery Excellence Framework (DEF). * Monitor external trends and best practices in virtual facilitation and technical training. Continuously improve learning facilitation skills to deliver highly effective customer learning experiences. * Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting. * Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned. * Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation. Base compensation ranges from $100,000 to $120,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. jobs.title: Sr. Staff Back-end engineer [Promise Platform]
jobs.description: We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did I ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing retail companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce. We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial, surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world. **Job Overview:** As our Sr. Staff Backend Engineer for the Inventory and Promise Platform team, you will empower Coupang Fulfillment \& Transportation to operate faster, better, and cheaper through modern, reliable, and data\-driven technologies. In this role, you will be a key contributor to an area of the business that is rapidly expanding and is recognized for its Rocket Delivery service. The team already builds services that process thousands of requests per second, generate trillions of won annually in business decisions, and manage business rules that move millions of products. We are responsible for improving order coordination with technology to deliver products to millions of online shoppers. The role will involve technical leadership on rearchitecting and building a brand new Inventory and Promise platform which powers customer's shopping experience by giving inventory visibility to the customer to be able to order and gives out promised delivery dates for their order. Additionally, the platform also powers fulfillment orchestration once an order is placed. **Key Responsibilities:** * Serve as a technical lead on our most demanding, cross\-functional projects involving Inventory and Promise. * Independently come up with quality architecture and design of systems for new microservices and machine learning pipelines. * Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions. * Possess expert knowledge in performance, scalability, enterprise distributed architecture, and engineering best practices. * Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members. * Exert technical influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing your deep knowledge and experience. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math, or a closely related field * 10\+ years of experience in backend software development * Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining highly available, distributed systems **Preferred:** * Experience with scalable distributed systems and understanding of machine learning algorithms. * Strong understanding of backend scalable software architecture, distributed systems, and message\-oriented architecture. * Experience with full\-stack, high\-scale production systems with fault\-tolerance and monitoring. * Experience with building stream\-processing systems, using solutions such as Kafka and Spark\-Streaming. * Data caching and storage techniques and creating distributed software architectures with horizontal scale. * Operationalizing software in a large\-scale environment with high availability requirements. * Experience in the eCommerce domain involved in supply chain systems around Inventory and Promise. * Software development experience with Java, Scala, and Python. * Experience with AWS; Java language would be a plus. **Pay \& Benefits** Our compensation reflects the cost of living across several US geographic markets. At Coupang, your base pay is one part of your total compensation. The base pay for this position ranges from $174,00/year to $299,000/year. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. **General Description of All Benefits** * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life, AD\&D insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) \& Health Savings Account (HSA) * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) program * 401K Plan with Company Match * 18\-21 days of the Paid Time Off (PTO) a year based on the tenure * 12 Public Holidays * Paid Parental leave * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * MTV \- \[Free] Electric Car Charging Station **General Description of Other Compensation** "Other Compensation" includes, but is not limited to, bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation that would be offered to the hired applicant in addition to their established salary range or wage scale. **Recruitment Process** * Application Review \- Phone Interview \- Onsite (or Virtual Onsite) Interview – Offer * The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances. * Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e\-mail address submitted at the application stage. **Details to Consider** * This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled. * Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process. * Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran's benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws. **Privacy Notice** * Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below: https://www.coupang.jobs/privacy\-policy/ Coupang is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, or gender (including pregnancy, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, transgender status), national origin, age, disability, medical condition, HIV/AIDS or Hepatitis C status, marital status, military or veteran status, use of a trained dog guide or service animal, political activities, or affiliations, citizenship, or any other characteristic or class protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you need assistance and/or reasonable accommodation in the recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at usrecruiting@coupang.com. Job Requisition ID: R0078747

jobs.description: Description: Are you looking for a career that combines your passion for your craft with true ownership? jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a talented **Product Engineer** to join our team specializing in **Engineering** in **Columbus, IN.** **In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:** * Drive product quality and reliability by investigating technical issues, identifying root causes, recommending corrective actions, and owning problem resolution through completion. * Support successful product development and support programs by executing key business processes within Product Preceding Technology (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI), and Current Product Support (CPS). * Apply structured engineering methodologies such as ESW, iDFMEA, FIRG, design reviews, and 7\-step problem solving to improve decision\-making and reduce product risk. * Influence quality product decisions by collaborating with technical managers, project leaders, manufacturing engineers, suppliers, and other stakeholders to provide data\-driven recommendations. * Advance projects effectively by using engineering knowledge and sound judgment to make decisions related to testing, analysis, project execution, and cross\-functional coordination. * Take ownership of increasingly complex components, systems, and products, resolving technical challenges while balancing performance, quality, cost, and schedule considerations. * Improve engineering processes and operational effectiveness by independently executing established work systems and contributing ideas that enhance efficiency, consistency, and product outcomes. * Strengthen team performance and technical capability by coordinating technicians and student employees, contributing to team goals, influencing within work groups, and continuously expanding your technical expertise. **To be successful in this role you will need the following:** * Apply strong engineering and systems thinking skills to understand complex product interactions, define requirements, evaluate risks, and make design decisions that optimize overall system performance and reliability. * Use data\-driven decision making by applying statistical methods, design of experiments, regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and other analytical tools to solve problems and guide product development decisions. * Translate customer and stakeholder requirements into effective designs by leading cross\-functional design integration efforts and ensuring solutions meet technical, manufacturing, quality, and business objectives. * Develop expertise in mechanical systems and controls engineering by understanding the interaction between mechanical, hydraulic, electronic, chemical, and software\-controlled systems to deliver robust product performance. * Execute product development activities effectively by planning, coordinating, monitoring, and delivering projects while balancing quality, schedule, resource, and risk considerations throughout the product lifecycle. * Proactively identify and mitigate product risks through failure mode avoidance, interface management, modeling, simulation, verification, validation, and structured problem\-solving methodologies. * Manage product configurations and engineering changes by maintaining accurate specifications, drawings, bills of material, and technical documentation while ensuring product integrity throughout its lifecycle. * Collaborate across functions and build strong partnerships with engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, project teams, and other stakeholders to achieve shared objectives and drive successful outcomes. * Communicate complex technical information clearly through design reviews, technical reports, requirements documentation, and stakeholder presentations that support informed decision\-making. * Deliver results in challenging situations by making timely, high\-quality decisions, prioritizing effectively, and maintaining focus on customer, product, and business needs. * Continuously develop your technical expertise by seeking feedback, expanding your knowledge of products and technologies, and pursuing both formal and informal learning opportunities. * Leverage diverse perspectives and experiences to enhance innovation, strengthen problem\-solving, and improve team and business performance. **Education, Licenses, Certifications:** * College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required. * Post\-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles. * This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations. **Experience:** * Entry level/Early career professional. * Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co\-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. * Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred **Additional Information:** * The Columbus Midrange Engine Plant (CMEP) primarily manufactures the Cummins 6\.7L diesel engine for Ram Truck. The CMEP Product Engineering team is responsible for the design, support, and technical ownership of the product currently being manufactured. The core work of the team is to evaluate, validate, and implement changes for this product as well as identify and mitigate warranty issues. This is a dynamic and fast\-paced environment where you get to see the impact of your work daily. * A successful candidate will work cross\-functionally with customers, plant quality, product quality, manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, materials, operations, and other functions. Provide information on the status of improvement projects to customer. Working as a team, candidate will deliver superior results by finding the optimal solution and bringing it to fruition. **Compensation:** Please note that the salary range provided is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. The final salary offer will be determined after considering relevant factors, including a candidate’s qualifications and experience, where appropriate. **Job** Engineering **Organization** Cummins Inc. **Role Category** On\-site with Flexibility **Job Type** Exempt \- Experienced **ReqID** 2433884 **Relocation Package** Yes **100% On\-Site** No **Cummins and E\-Verify** At Cummins, we are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer dedicated to diversity in the workplace. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, color, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity and/or expression, or other status protected by law. Cummins validates the right to work using E\-Verify and will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), with information from each new employee’s Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. Visit http://EEOC.gov to know your rights on workplace discrimination.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **ABOUT spencer®** Spencer Health Solutions (www.spencerhealthsolutions.com) is transforming healthcare by moving care delivery to the home through the company’s spencer® medication adherence and engagement platform. The spencer FDA Class I technology enables virtual care by connecting patients, clinicians, pharmacists and family members digitally. The Morrisville company offers the right candidate an opportunity to be part of a high\-performing team in the development of cutting\-edge medical technology at the exciting point of market entry through leading health technology distributors in the US, Canada and Europe. **About Custom Health (Parent Owner)** Custom Health provides a comprehensive tech\-enabled med management and managed care solution resulting in 98% medication adherence for our patients across the United States and Canada. Operations are powered by proprietary software which orchestrates fully automated owned and network pharmacies, at\-home medication management solutions, real\-time clinical oversight by 200\+ pharmacist\-lead clinicians and the collection of real\-time, real\-world data and insights. **Overview** We are looking for a **Senior Embedded Software Engineer** with deep expertise in **Embedded Linux** and **Wireless Communications** to join our R\&D team. You will be responsible for developing mission\-critical firmware for next\-generation medical devices. This role requires a hardware mindset, high\-level debugging skills, and a commitment to the rigorous safety standards required in the healthcare industry. **Key Responsibilities** * **Embedded Linux Development:** Design, develop, and maintain custom application and libraries in embedded Linux operating system for SoC architectures. * **Wireless Integration:** Implement and optimize wireless communication protocols, including **Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and Cellular (LTE/5G)**, ensuring robust connectivity in high\-interference environments. * **Hardware:** Work closely with hardware engineers to bring up Operating systems and Applications on new boards; Write low\-level drivers (I2C, SPI, UART, USB) and perform memory mapped I/O operations as necessary. * **Expert Debugging:** Lead complex troubleshooting efforts using **oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and GDB** to resolve race conditions, memory leaks, and hardware\-software timing issues. * **Compliance \& Documentation:** Ensure all code and processes adhere to required standards such **ISO 13485** and **IEC 62304** standard. Participate in risk analysis (FMEA) and maintain meticulous design history files (DHF). * **Documentation**: Write and maintain technical documentation, including software design specifications and test procedures * **Security:** Practical understanding of secure boot, encryption at rest/transit, and certificate management for connected medical devices. Requirements: **Required Experience \& Qualifications** * Embedded Linux: Strong proficiency in kernel\-space and user\-space development, including custom driver development and board support packages (BSP). * Wireless Comms: Proven track record of integrating and certifying wireless stacks for commercial products. * Debugging Prowess: Highly skilled in isolating root causes in complex, concurrent systems where hardware and software intersect. * Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science. **Preferred Experience** * Medical Device Background: Direct experience working under FDA/EMA regulatory frameworks and medical\-grade quality management systems. * ISO Standards: Familiarity with ISO 14971 (Risk Management), IEC 62304 (Medical Device Software), and IEC 60601 (Safety/Essential Performance). * Real\-Time Systems: Experience with RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr) in addition to Linux is a plus.

jobs.title: Staff PlatformOps Engineer (Emerging AI)
jobs.description: **About DAT** DAT Freight \& Analytics is an award\-winning employer of choice and a next\-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million\+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi\-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com **Job Application Deadline:** 10/31/2026 **The Opportunity** As a Staff AI Platform Engineer, you'll build and own the platform that every AI and machine learning workload at DAT runs on. Freight is an uncertain business, and the models we ship reduce that uncertainty: rate forecasts, load\-to\-truck matching, document extraction, fraud signals, and the agentic workflows our brokers and carriers use to move freight faster. None of that reaches a customer without a platform that makes training, serving, evaluating, and monitoring models routine instead of heroic. You'll set the architectural direction for that platform, from the model gateway and inference layer through feature and vector storage, evaluation harnesses, and production observability. This is a highly visible role for an engineer who wants their work multiplied across every AI team in the company. **What You'll Do** * **Platform Ownership:** Design, build, and operate the shared services that engineers and business users use to ship models: a model gateway for LLM access, inference endpoints for real\-time and batch scoring, feature storage, vector search, and a common SDK. * **Technical Leadership:** Lead architecture for large\-scale AI systems, write the design documents, and drive alignment across Product, and Engineering and Business users on how models get built and shipped at DAT. * **Cloud Architecture:** Architect and run scalable, reliable AI infrastructure on AWS, including Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS, Redpanda, MSK (Kafka), Lambda, and S3, all defined in Pulumi.. * **Evaluation and Quality:** Build the offline and online evaluation systems that tell us whether a model or prompt change is an improvement, including regression suites, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, A/B and shadow testing, and drift detection. * **Cost and Performance:** Own inference cost and latency as first\-class metrics. Right\-size GPU and serverless capacity, tune batching, caching, and quantization, and give teams clear visibility into what their workloads cost. * **Safety and Governance:** Implement guardrails, jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.** **As a purpose\-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, Acquisition
jobs.description: Darktrace is a global leader in AI\-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day. Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real\-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Learn Fast **Job D** **escription** **:** As a **Senior** **Solutions Engineer** on the Acquisition Team , you will partner with Account Executives to drive net\-new business and lead the technical sales process from discovery through evaluation, solution design, and business justification. \-impact demos and technical storytelling to SOC teams, leaders, and executives * Translate complex cybersecurity concepts into clear, outcome\-driven narratives for both technical and executive in pre\-sales/solutions engineering in cybersecurity or SaaS with a track record of supporting net\-new business * Strong knowledge of networking, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and security ar chitecture s * jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Infrastructure
jobs.description: RDQ427R198 ### **The Opportunity** Multi\-cloud is core to Databricks product strategy. Compute serves as the layer that abstracts the cloud from the rest of the company. Building unified infrastructure on top of heterogeneous clouds is a challenge that few companies experience. As an engineer on this team, you won’t just manage infrastructure; you will build it as a product. You will tackle the hard problems of distributed systems: sub\-second container/MicroVM startup times, multi\-tenant security isolation, and building a unified orchestration layer that scales across AWS, Azure, and GCP. ### **What You’ll Do** * Design and build the next generation of our Serverless platform, focusing on high availability, low latency, and scale\-to\-zero efficiency. * Build a single compute stack that supports heterogeneous workloads, including GPU instance qualification for AI training and stateful execution for Lakebase. * Solve Multi\-Cloud Complexity: Develop platform\-level abstractions that allow Databricks to run seamlessly across all major cloud providers. * Optimize everything from the API gateway down to the host\-level networking and container orchestration. * Work alongside industry experts who have built world\-class systems like Borg, Kubernetes, and Uber’s infrastructure. ### **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of production\-level experience in one of: Python, Java, Scala, C\+\+, or a similar language * 4\+ years of experience developing large\-scale distributed systems from scratch * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or MicroVM technologies (e.g., Firecracker) and a strong grasp of cloud provider internals (AWS/Azure/GCP). * You aren't just a user of tools; you understand how to build them from the ground up when existing solutions fail at our scale. **Pay Range Transparency** Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Advancing Agent Quality, DeepMind
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * 2 years of experience with agentic AI workflows, frameworks, and approaches. * 1 year of experience with machine learning and deep learning. * Experienece in software engineering and cloud\-based development. * Experience with Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar ML frameworks. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, including supervised learning and reinforcement learning. **About the job** ----------------- At Google, research\-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large\-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real\-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers. The Agent Quality team defines, measures, and advances long\-horizon, tool\-using capabilities for Google’s frontier agents. We build foundational evaluation systems and data flywheels for Gemini Spark—Google’s flagship agent for deep research, multi\-step problem solving, and workspace integration. Our work encompasses pioneering environment creation (including contexts, autoraters, human evaluations), developing advanced diagnostic tools for agent improvement, and harvesting trajectories and reward signals into SFT and RL post\-training to recursively improve core Gemini models. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, build, and scale realistic agent environments and task suites. Research and develop Agentic AutoRaters (AR), calibrate them against human evaluation, and benchmark agent capabilities against industry\-leading frontier models. * Enable agents to automatically generate and iterate on verifiers (such as automated test cases), facilitating effective exploration and iterative problem\-solving. * Develop trajectory analysis frameworks and diagnostic tooling to identify root\-cause agent failure modes (e.g., passivity, hallucination, or brittle tool execution), and automatically optimize agent harnesses to drive continuous self\-improvement. * Harvest complex multi\-turn interaction trajectories into high\-quality datasets and reward signals to power SFT and RL flywheels for frontier Gemini models.
