jobs.title: HVAC Controls Project Manager-Systems Specialist
jobs.description: **About Us:** Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward. **HVAC Controls Project Manager (LSS) 1** ----------------------------------------- **Role Overview** ----------------- As the **on\-site HVAC project leader, you will plan, execute, and complete control systems projects for assigned customers**. You will manage technical execution, customer communication, subcontractor coordination, and project financial performance from kickoff through closeout. Success in this role means delivering projects on schedule, within scope, and with a strong balance between customer satisfaction and financial results. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead assigned control systems projects from planning through closeout, including hardware design, system programming, installation coordination, system and network commissioning, and warranty follow\-up. * Own project financial results by managing costs, billings, collections, and profitability while pursuing change orders to capture approved scope changes. * Coordinate communication with customers throughout all project phases and communicate technical and business issues clearly and professionally. * Direct subcontractors, electrical installers, technicians, designers, and administrative support as needed to keep work moving accurately and efficiently. * Manage material selection, ordering, budget, and delivery schedules for assigned projects. * Secure pricing and availability from vendors and subcontractors, including scope, terms, and conditions, and oversee subcontractor payment and billing processes. * Coordinate jobsite panel and field device locations and ensure installation aligns with Johnson Controls literature and project requirements. * Complete controller loading, device verification, commissioning, as\-built documentation, and system validation to confirm proper operation. * Provide coaching, mentoring, and technical support to System Technicians, Electrical Installers, System Designers, and subcontractors. * Deliver site\-specific training for owners and operators and ensure project closeout documentation, manuals, and warranty communication are completed properly. * Maintain long\-term relationships with contractors, clients, consultants, and subcontractors and participate in job progress meetings as needed. * Report project status to management and provide monthly forecasts for revenue, costs, and gross margin. **How You Will Do It** ---------------------- * Apply established standards to complete installation hardware design and software programming, and translate the design into clear guidance for customers and project partners. * Review contractual scope carefully, identify change\-order opportunities, and respond to client bulletins, field directives, and scheduling changes with sound judgment. * Stay close to the work at the jobsite, remove obstacles quickly, and keep the customer informed with timely, direct communication. * Manage project execution with a strong focus on safety, integrity, and accountability from planning through warranty closeout. * Use disciplined follow\-through to improve every day through candid problem\-solving, accurate documentation, and consistent cost control. * Collaborate with technicians, designers, subcontractors, and project engineers as one team to deliver cost\-effective solutions that meet customer expectations. * Track billing, cash flow, and project cost activity closely so work is completed on time, within budget, and within scope. * Provide practical coaching and technical support that helps others execute delegated work accurately and professionally. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 6 years of related field experience in the HVAC/Controls industry or similar Building Automation Systems, with System Design or System Engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Hands\-on technical experience in systems design and commissioning of digital HVAC controls systems. * Ability to communicate technical material clearly to a non\-technical audience. * Ability to perform work independently and manage priorities with minimal supervision. * Strong personal computer skills. * Knowledge of control theory and HVAC systems. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Technical associate degree. * Knowledge of project accounting, costing principles, and contracting. * Strong leadership skills and the ability to direct the work of others. * Strong communication and customer service skills. **Why Join Us** --------------- * Paid vacation, holidys, and sick time, including **15 days of vacation in the first year**. * Comprehensive benefits package including 401K, medical, dental, and vision care. * Extensive product knowledge and on\-the\-job/cross\-training opportunities. * Encouraging and collaborative team environment. * Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy. If you are ready to lead meaningful control systems projects and deliver results customers can trust, we encourage you to apply. HIRING SALARY RANGE: $75,000\.\-104,000\. (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) **This role also offers a competitive Sales Incentive Plan that will take into account volume and margin on a project, quarterly, and annual basis.** This position includes a competitive benefits package. The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. **However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills andexperiences that exceed the typical profile. If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply.** To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers. For details, please visit the About Us tab on the Johnson Controls Careers site at https://jobs.johnsoncontrols.com/about\-us.

jobs.title: NextGen Hardware Engineer- Controls
jobs.description: Launch your Career with Us! Our 18\-month Engineering Training Program offers 4 rotational assignments across engineering and business functions, providing hands\-on experience, leadership development, and exposure to some of the industry's top talent. At Johnson Controls, our values guide everything we do. We are driven by integrity, teamwork, innovation, and a deep commitment to sustainability. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. As part of our team, you’ll help create smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings and communities\-because at JCI, we believe in building a better tomorrow. **Rotation Location Possibilities** Rotational assignments may be located at one or more of the following Johnson Controls locations: * Milwaukee, WI * Reynosa, Mexico **Why You'll Love it Here** * **Competitive pay starting at $75,000** with **$5,000 sign on bonus** * Benefits that **start Day** 1 (medical, dental, vision, 401k) * Paid vacation/holidays/sick time – **15 days of vacation, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays** * A **mentor** who’s invested in your success, along with a **support network** of peers and leaders **Work Location, Rotations, and Travel** This is a fully on\-site position and is not eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements. Participants are expected to work in person at their assigned Johnson Controls facility five days per week. Rotational assignments are a core part of this program and are not limited to your hiring location. One or more of your rotations may be based at another Johnson Controls facility within the United States and require an extended stay away from your home location, typically lasting several weeks to several months. Company\-supported travel, lodging, and relocation assistance are provided in accordance with company policy. **What You Will Do** * Complete structured rotational assignments across engineering, operations, product development, and other key functions. * Apply technical and business skills to real\-world projects, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to solve complex challenges and drive impact. * Receive mentorship and coaching from senior leaders and technical experts while developing problem\-solving, communication, and leadership capabilities. * Contribute to the successful and timely completion of projects, provide status updates, and deliver a final capstone project. * Work on\-site at your assigned Johnson Controls facility throughout the program and complete rotations that may require extended stays at other U.S. locations. * Travel domestically and occasionally internationally for training, project work, factory or supplier visits, and collaboration with global engineering teams. **What to Expect** * **Hands\-on experience:** Work on meaningful projects that make an impact on the business. * **Broad exposure:** Rotate through engineering, operations, product development, and other key business functions while gaining experience across multiple JCI locations. * **Mentorship and growth:** Learn directly from leaders and experienced engineers while building technical, business, and leadership skills. * **Leadership development:** Graduate from the program with a strong foundation in Johnson Controls Engineering Leadership Competencies. * **Immersive on\-site experience:** Work side\-by\-side with your team and mentors in the lab, on the shop floor, and in office environments. * **Career opportunities:** Upon successful completion of the program, transition into a full\-time role in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Project Management, or Product Management. **What You Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical, or related field); preferred coursework includes Thermodynamics, Machine Design, Fluid Flow, and Introduction to Electrical Engineering. * Flexibility and adaptability to work across multiple functions, teams, and locations, including relocation and rotational assignments throughout the United States. * Passion for learning, growth, and leadership, demonstrated through school, work, community involvement, internships, or co\-op experiences. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and work effectively toward common goals. * Proficiency in organizing and analyzing data to solve multidimensional problems, along with demonstrated proficiency using AI tools and technologies. * Ability to work full\-time on\-site, travel domestically and internationally as required, obtain and maintain valid travel documentation, and possess the **legal right to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the future.**

jobs.title: Security Systems Engineer / Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Security Systems Infrastructure Engineer to join our federal team supporting our Electronic Security Systems (ESS) projects. This is a hybrid role with the ability to come in to our Rockville, MD office and other project sites in the Washington D.C. Metro (DMV) area as needed. At Johnson Controls, we support our nation’s most critical facilities, the people who occupy them, and the missions they enable. Johnson Controls Federal Systems (JCFS) is a specialized team serving as a trusted partner to the federal government. We help modernize U.S. military installations, Department of Defense and other federal agency facilities to be smarter, more resilient, efficient, sustainable, and secure. **Location:** Hybrid role with the ability to come in to our Rockville, MD office as needed, as well as visit local project sites as needed. Must be based in the Washington D.C. Metro / Baltimore area (MD/DC/VA) **Benefits:** Eligible for benefits on first day of employment **Vacation:** 3 weeks of paid vacation, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays, and 10 standard holidays per calendar year **As a Security System Engineer, you will:** * Be responsible for building, configuring, troubleshooting, and supporting Windows servers and network services required to support enterprise electronic security systems. * Work with the installation, configuration, and administration of Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) * Build and configure domain controllers * DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, user/service accounts, permissions, and basic domain administration * Configuration of NTP / network time services and synchronization across servers, workstations, switches, and security appliances * Install and perform basic administration of Microsoft SQL servers * Develop and support Windows server roles, services, firewall rules, certificates, and service dependencies * Basic Hyper\-V / virtual machine configuration and administration * Support Windows security hardening and implementation of secure server configurations * Work with network troubleshooting involving VLANs, IP addressing, gateways, routing, ports, and firewall requirements * Configurate and troubleshoot AAA services used to authenticate network switches and other network devices * Interface with end users, gather requirements, and design and maintain an Active Directory and Network based server environment to manage end\-user access and information for a physical security system. * Provide a physical security network server design and set of requirements that meets user and customer needs * Participate in technical design reviews and recommend solutions and improvements * Develop plans for implementation, prototype testing and verification. * Create detailed networked server documentation, including physical diagrams, logical diagrams, IP address schemes and asset management and database designs * Design, document and implement processes for network server hardware, software and database support. Identify, implement and configure tools to facilitate support processes and provide audit trails of support activities * Other duties as assigned **Required Qualifications:** * Strong technical knowledge with Windows Server administration, network integration, and security system infrastructure. * Ability to take new or partially configured environments and perform the setup, integration, troubleshooting, testing, and documentation necessary to place the system into operation * Experience working with Windows Server 2022 and Windows Server 2025 * Experience working with the installation, configuration, and administration of Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) * Ability to configure and troubleshoot network server, connectivity, and physical security system hardware and software issues, both in person and over the phone * Ability to work with network engineers to configure and validate authentication, authorization, and accounting for managed switches * Ability to troubleshoot communications between servers, network switches, controllers, workstations, and other IP\-based security devices **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with electronic security systems such as Access Control Systems (ACS), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), Video Management Systems (VMS), and IP intercom systems is strongly preferred * Demonstrated knowledge and skills required to configure and manage database systems using SQL Server and Oracle DBMS tools * Experience with RADIUS and/or TACACS\+, including integration of network\-device authentication with Active Directory or another centralized authentication service * Familiarity with Cisco switching environments is preferred **Preferred Education:** * Bachelor’s Degree or Associates Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Networking, or other relevant discipline, or equivalent work experience * Certified System Engineer ICAM PACS (CSEIP) * Security\+ and Network\+ certifications Who We Are **At Johnson Controls (NYSE:** JCI), we are One Team working collaboratively to create purposeful solutions that make a difference in the world. We are a Fortune 500 company with more than 100,000 employees worldwide offering the world's largest portfolio of building technology products, solutions and services. As a member of our Federal Systems team, your work matters. We value and recognize your contributions and want to help you succeed. We invest in our employees, provide opportunities for growth and advancement, and foster a culture of inclusion and respect. To learn more about who we are and what we do, please check out our Take a Journey video. Recently, Johnson Controls has been recognized by several organizations for leadership in Environment, Sustainability and Governance, as well as innovations in smart building platforms: * Named to FORTUNE’s “Most Admired Companies” List * Corporate Knights Global 100 Most Sustainable Corporations in the World * Named to Forbes Net Zero Leaders list * CDP 2023 Climate Change 'A List' * Ranked 67 on the Drucker Institute’s list of best\-managed companies in America * Forbes Best Employers for Diversity list. * Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Diversity * Ethisphere 2024 World's Most Ethical Companies list for the 17th time * Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Women in 2024 * Named to Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Veterans 2024 / 2025 listing * Named to Forbes America’s Best Employers for Veterans 2024 * Named one of the top military friendly employers by military.com Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (hybrid)
jobs.description: **About Johnson Controls** Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward. Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms. **What you will do** Johnson Controls' software touches revenue and production directly. The sales configurator is how orders get quoted, the engineering BOM release is how they get built, and the shop floor systems are how units move down the line. If a deployment goes wrong at the wrong hour, a plant stops. On top of that, we are standing up AI capabilities — document extraction from customer specifications, BOM anomaly detection, labor estimation, assistive tools for sales and application engineers — which brings a new set of infrastructure, cost, and governance problems. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will maintain the platform underneath all of it. Pipelines, environments, infrastructure as code, observability, security posture, and the deployment paths that reach both cloud services and servers sitting inside segmented plant networks. You will also help build the AI platform: the training and inference infrastructure, the evaluation gates in CI, the endpoint and quota management, and the cost controls that keep AI spend visible before it becomes a finance conversation. Join our team in York, Pennsylvania, where you'll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact. Candidates should be located within commuting distance of the facility or be open to relocating, with relocation assistance available. For the right candidate, we are also open to considering a fully remote work arrangement. **How you will do it** **CI/CD and release engineering** * Azure DevOps as a platform — organization and project structure, YAML pipelines, repositories and branch policies, artifact feeds, service connections, environments, and self\-hosted agent pools including agents inside plant and DMZ networks. * Build deployment paths for the systems we actually run. Microservices are the easy case; you will also need controlled, repeatable release processes for integration artifacts, API layers, and configuration for COTS platforms (\[CPQ], \[PLM], \[ERP], \[MES]) that do not deploy like modern applications. * Design approval gates, change records, and audit evidence appropriate to systems that control what gets manufactured and shipped, without turning every deployment into a two\-week ceremony. * Plan and execute deployments around production reality — maintenance windows, shift schedules, quarter\-end order volume, and the fact that the factory does not stop for a release. **Azure platform** * Manage infrastructure as code across all environments. Manual portal changes are a defect, not a workflow. * Manage the estate: Functions, Azure SQL and storage, Service Bus and Event Hubs, API Management, and the data platform * Networking and identity — VNets, private endpoints, hub\-and\-spoke topology, \[ExpressRoute / site\-to\-site VPN] connectivity to plants, Entra ID, managed identities, Key Vault, and RBAC. * Manage hybrid and edge footprint, including \[Azure Arc] for on\-premise servers and \[IoT Edge / IoT Hub] where shop floor systems require local resilience and cannot depend on WAN availability. * Own environment strategy and lifecycle: dev, test, UAT, and production; environment refresh and provisioning; and test data management including masking of customer, pricing, and design data. **Build the AI platform** * Stand up and operate \[Azure Machine Learning / Azure AI Foundry] — workspaces, compute and GPU capacity, model registry, and managed inference endpoints. * Manage Azure OpenAI and model provider access: provisioning, quota and throughput planning, private networking, content filtering configuration, and key and identity management. * Extend CI/CD to AI workloads — versioning for models, prompts, and datasets; automated evaluation as a pipeline gate so a regression blocks a release the same way a failing unit test does; and reliable rollback. * Build observability for AI in production: latency, error and abstention rates, token consumption, drift signals, and per\-feature cost attribution. * Deploy inference where it needs to run, including on\-premise or edge at plants where latency, connectivity, or data policy rules out a cloud round trip. * Own AI cost management. Make spend attributable and forecastable, and raise the tr Reliability and security** * Build monitoring and alerting that reflects business impact rather than resource metrics — a stalled BOM release matters more than CPU utilization. Own SLOs, dashboards, and incident response for production systems. * Drive incident management and blameless postmortems, and convert findings into platform changes. * Own security posture in the pipeline and the estate: secrets management, vulnerability and dependency scanning, container image hygiene, SBOM generation, and patch management coordination — including OT environments where patching windows are constrained. * Partner with IT, OT, and information security on segmentation, access control, and compliance requirements for plant\-connected systems. **Improve how the team ships** * Reduce friction and toil deliberately. Self\-service environments, golden pipeline templates, and good documentation are deliverables, not side effects. * Mentor engineers on deployment, observability, and operational ownership of what they build. **What you will do** **Required** * 5\+ years in DevOps, platform, SRE, or cloud infrastructure engineering. * Hands\-on Azure experience across compute, networking, identity, data services, and monitoring. * Azure DevOps expertise — YAML pipelines, self\-hosted agents, environments and approvals, artifact management, and repository governance. Equivalent depth in GitHub Actions or GitLab CI with demonstrated ability to pick up Azure DevOps is acceptable. * Containerization and orchestration in production (Docker and Kubernetes). * Scripting and automation in Python and PowerShell or Bash. * Experience deploying into hybrid environments, not cloud\-only. Firewalled targets, private connectivity, and on\-premise servers should be familiar territory. * Demonstrated ownership of production systems — on\-call, incident response, and measurable reliability improvement. **Preferred** * MLOps experience: Azure Machine Learning, model registries and inference endpoints, GPU capacity management, or LLMOps including prompt and evaluation versioning and token cost management. * Experience supporting enterprise business systems — ERP, PLM, CPQ, MES, or integration middleware — and realistic expectations about what CI/CD looks like for commercial platforms. * Manufacturing or industrial environment experience, including OT network segmentation and plant cybersecurity practices. * Data platform operations: \[Data Factory / Fabric], warehouse or lakehouse infrastructure, orchestration and pipeline reliability. * FinOps practice — cloud cost visibility, allocation, and optimization. * Azure certifications (AZ\-400, AZ\-104/305, or AI\-102\) and Kubernetes certifications (CKA). * Experience being an early platform hire and establishing standards rather than inheriting them. * Production infrastructure\-as\-code experience with \[Terraform / Bicep], including managing multiple environments and state responsibly. HIRING SALARY RANGE: $120,000 \- 155,000 (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) This role offers a competitive Bonus plan that will take into account individual, group, and corporate performance. This position includes a competitive benefits package. The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills and experiences that exceed the typical profile. If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply. To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers. For details, please visit the About Us tab on the Johnson Controls Careers site at https://jobs.johnsoncontrols.com/about\-us \#LI\-HYBRID \#LI\-REMOTE

jobs.title: Sr Technical Product Marketing Manager, AI Traffic Management & Registry
jobs.description: **Are you ready to unlock intelligence?** If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box \- we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. About the role: Every enterprise deploying AI at scale faces the same challenge: governing an explosion of LLM, MCP, and agent traffic while giving developers a way to discover and consume AI resources safely. This role owns the technical narrative at the heart of that story. As Senior Technical PMM, you'll drive positioning, evangelism, and competitive strategy for Kong's AI traffic management capabilities — the AI gateway and guardrails that secure and control AI traffic in production — as well as our registry and discovery experience spanning AI, MCP, and agent registries. This is a core technical marketing role on the AI team, covering the most contested competitive ground in the market. What you’ll do: * Own positioning and messaging for AI traffic management — define and evolve the technical narrative for Kong's AI gateway and guardrails capabilities, including LLM routing, policy enforcement, content safety, and multi\-agent traffic governance * Drive the registry and discovery story — build positioning for AI, MCP, and agent registries, covering listing, registration, governance, and the developer discovery experience * Lead technical field enablement for your domain — own product enablement within your domain for Kong Solution Engineers, Customer Success Managers, and other technical field roles * Serve as technical evangelist — represent Kong at industry events, analyst briefings, webinars, and customer conversations; produce technical content including demos, blogs, whitepapers, and reference architectures * Produce deep technical content — build demos, reference architectures, technical whitepapers, and documentation\-adjacent content that helps architects and security teams evaluate and adopt Kong's approach * Partner with product on roadmap narrative — work closely with product management to shape how new capabilities are framed, named, and sequenced for maximum market impact * Fuel launches and campaigns — deliver technical positioning, proof points, and demo assets as structured inputs to the AI PMM's launch and campaign motions * Mentor and elevate — as the senior\-most technical PMM on the team, raise the bar for technical storytelling across the AI portfolio Who You Are: * 7\+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, or solutions engineering—ideally at an AI/ML platform company * Genuine hands\-on interest in AI infrastructure: you follow developments in LLM deployment, agentic frameworks, Model Context Protocol, and AI governance; you can speak credibly to AI platform engineers without bluffing * Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into crisp narratives that land with both technical practitioners and C\-suite buyers * Highly collaborative—you thrive working across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Partner teams * Comfortable owning a stage: keynote presentations, analyst briefings, customer roundtables, and demo\-heavy sessions are energizing, not intimidating * Experience in open\-source software, SaaS platforms, and enterprise go\-to\-market motions strongly preferred * Familiarity with the AI connectivity landscape—including awareness of competing and complementary vendors across API gateways, AI observability, vector databases, IPaaS, and agentic orchestration frameworks—is a strong plus **About Kong:** Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500 and AI\-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com. Compensation Range: $153,090 \- $251,505

jobs.title: Data Security (SecuPi) Administrator
jobs.description: **Location:** 4910 Tiedeman Road, Brooklyn Ohio We are seeking a Data **Security (SecuPi) Administrator** to support, operate, and enhance enterprise data security technologies and controls. This role is responsible for protecting sensitive and regulated data across databases, applications, cloud platforms, analytics environments, and emerging AI\-enabled services. The Security Engineer will provide engineering and operational support for data security platforms such as **SecuPi** and other technologies used for data access governance, data masking, encryption, tokenization, database activity monitoring, data discovery and classification, and data loss prevention (DLP). The role will partner with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Cloud, Database, Application Development, Data Governance, Privacy, and Risk teams to implement scalable controls that protect enterprise data while enabling appropriate business access. **Key Responsibilities** * Engineer, configure, administer, and maintain enterprise data security platforms, including SecuPi and comparable technologies. * Implement and maintain policies for data access control, dynamic data masking, encryption, tokenization, filtering, and other data protection mechanisms. * Support security controls across relational and NoSQL databases, data warehouses, cloud data platforms, APIs, applications, and analytics environments. * Integrate data security technologies with enterprise identity and access management (IAM), privileged access management (PAM), SIEM, SOAR, DLP, and security monitoring platforms. * Develop and maintain policies that enforce least\-privilege and role\- or attribute\-based access to sensitive information. * Support discovery and classification of sensitive data, including PII, financial information, credentials, intellectual property, and other regulated or confidential information. * Monitor data access activity and investigate anomalous, unauthorized, or high\-risk access patterns. * Troubleshoot platform, policy, integration, connectivity, and performance issues affecting data security controls. * Assess proposed database, application, cloud, and data\-platform changes for potential security impacts. * Partner with application and database teams to integrate security controls into new and existing solutions. * Support security requirements for AI applications, copilots, and autonomous agents accessing enterprise data. * Help ensure that AI\-enabled services access only data authorized for the requesting user, application, or service identity. * Develop automation and scripts to improve deployment, monitoring, policy management, reporting, and operational efficiency. * Participate in vulnerability management, incident response, security investigations, and remediation activities involving enterprise data. * Maintain security architecture diagrams, configuration standards, operating procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation. * Support internal and external audits by providing evidence of data security controls and their effectiveness. * Evaluate new data security technologies and recommend improvements to the organization’s data protection architecture. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Cyber Security. * 3\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, infrastructure security, database security, or a related technical discipline. * Experience administering or engineering enterprise security technologies. * Working knowledge of database technologies such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar platforms. * Understanding of data security concepts including encryption, tokenization, masking, access control, data classification, and database activity monitoring. * Knowledge of authentication and authorization concepts including IAM, RBAC, ABAC, SSO, service accounts, and privileged access. * Experience troubleshooting complex enterprise technology integrations. * Familiarity with Linux and/or Windows operating environments. * Scripting or automation experience using technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, REST APIs, or similar tools. * Understanding of network security concepts including TCP/IP, TLS, proxies, firewalls, DNS, and secure communications. * Experience securing cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. * Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, APIs, microservices, and modern application architectures. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with **SecuPi** or comparable data security, database security, or data access governance platforms. * Experience with database activity monitoring (DAM), data security posture management (DSPM), DLP, encryption/key management, or data discovery and classification technologies. * Experience securing cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. * Experience securing cloud data platforms, data warehouses, or data lakes. * Experience integrating security technologies with SIEM/SOAR platforms and enterprise monitoring systems. * Experience implementing security controls for generative AI, AI agents, LLM applications, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures. * Understanding of Zero Trust and data\-centric security principles. * Familiarity with regulatory and security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, or similar requirements. * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Security\+, GIAC, cloud security certifications, or vendor\-specific security certifications. **Core Competencies** The successful candidate should demonstrate strong capabilities in **security engineering, data protection, access control, troubleshooting, automation, and technical collaboration**. The individual should be comfortable working across security, infrastructure, database, cloud, application, and data teams to translate security requirements into reliable technical controls. **Success in the Role** Success will be measured by the reliability and effectiveness of enterprise data security controls, reduction of unauthorized data exposure risk, timely resolution of security and platform issues, increased automation of security operations, and successful integration of data protection controls into new applications, cloud services, databases, and AI\-enabled solutions. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $80,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 annually. Placement within the pay range may differ based upon various factors, including but not limited to skills, experience and geographic location. Compensation for this role also includes eligibility for incentive compensation which may include production, commission, and/or discretionary incentives. Please click here for a list of benefits for which this position is eligible. Job Posting Expiration Date: 10/06/2026 KeyCorp is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to sustaining an inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, pregnancy, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Qualified individuals with disabilities or disabled veterans who are unable or limited in their ability to apply on this site may request reasonable accommodations by emailing HR\_Compliance@keybank.com. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Substation Physical Designer
jobs.description: Overview: Kimley\-Horn's Woodstock, Georgia (GA) office is seeking a Substation Physical Designer with 4\+ years of experience to join the Power Delivery team. This is not a remote position. Responsibilities: The successful candidate will support the design, and execution of high\-voltage and medium\-voltage substation projects for utility, renewable energy, and industrial clients. Responsibilities include developing physical layouts, equipment arrangements, grounding systems, lightning protection systems, and construction drawing packages while coordinating closely with protection and control, civil, structural, and electrical disciplines. The ideal candidate is a self\-driven designer with strong technical skills, experience in substation design standards and industry practices, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.* Perform conceptual and detailed HV and MV substation physical/electrical design for utilities and substations, including basic layout, electrical arrangement, one\-line diagrams, three\-line drawings, plan\-section drawings, and grounding. * Perform engineering studies and calculations. * Perform quality control reviews on substation physical design projects. * Assume the role of technical lead on projects with limited guidance. * Create and review bills of materials for substation physical projects. * Develop and review proposals and scopes of work for smaller substation physical projects. * Support the continued professional development of less experienced engineers/designers, including technical guidance and training recommendations. * Communicate effectively with internal teams and clients to meet project objectives \#LI\-AT1 Qualifications: * 4\+ years of relevant experience in substation design. * Preferred (but not required): Associates degree with an engineering or drafting concentration. * Proficiency with industry\-standard design software such as AutoCAD, MicroStation and inventor. * Experience with grounding studies, lightning protection studies, and lighting studies. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Investment Systems New
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW** KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world\-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. **POSITION SUMMARY** ==================== KKR is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to help bring AI into the daily work of teams across the firm. This is a hands\-on engineering role with a builder's mindset: you are an embedded extension of the engineering team that works directly with investment teams to understand how their work gets done, then design, build, and ship production AI systems that improve it. Your “customers” are internal: colleagues across private equity, credit, infrastructure, real estate, insurance and capital markets. You will sit with these teams and observe their workflows firsthand. You will identify where fragmented data, repetitive tasks, and manual handoffs slow high\-value work, and translate ambiguous business challenges into well\-defined technical problems. You will then own the solution end to end, from architecture, code, data integration, to evaluation, deployment, and adoption, in close partnership with your direct engineering teammates, product, AI, data, security, and platform colleagues. The best solutions you build will not stay one\-off. You will convert successful implementations into reusable skills, tools, agents, and workflow components that scale across teams and strengthen the firm’s broader AI platform. If you are an engineer who wants your code to shape how a leading global investment firm works, this role offers rare scope and impact. **RESPONSIBILITIES** ==================== * Engage teams across KKR’s businesses to observe how work is delivered, going beyond documented requirements to understand information flows, decision points, and day\-to\-day realities. * Identify high\-value opportunities where AI can remove bottlenecks, connect fragmented data, eliminate repetitive work, or improve the speed and quality of decisions. * Translate loosely defined business challenges into clear technical problem statements, solution architectures, and delivery plans. * Design, build, and ship production\-grade AI applications, agents, integrations, and workflow automations using modern languages such as Python or TypeScript. * Connect structured and unstructured data across enterprise systems and make it reliably usable by AI\-enabled applications through pipelines, retrieval systems, and well\-designed interfaces. * Create, test, and maintain reusable AI skills, tools, prompts, connectors, evaluation frameworks, and workflow components that can be shared across teams and business units. * Establish rigorous evaluations and success metrics that measure accuracy, reliability, adoption, time saved, decision quality, risk reduction, and business impact. * Move rapidly from discovery to prototype to production while upholding high standards for security, data protection, privacy, compliance, reliability, and maintainability. * Decompose organic, often undocumented workflows into modular capabilities — data, decisions, actions, and controls — and determine where AI, deterministic software, or human judgment is the right tool. * Drive adoption through documentation, training, direct user feedback, and close, ongoing partnership with the teams you serve. * Convert successful high\-touch implementations into repeatable engineering patterns and scalable platform capabilities, feeding insights into the firm’s broader AI roadmap. * Challenge conventional practices constructively, helping teams reimagine workflows rather than simply automating existing steps. **HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH THE BUSINESS AND TECHNOLOGY TEAMS** ========================================================== Forward Deployed Engineers and technology teams own the engineering side of AI enablement for business partners: architecture, integration, data pipelines, security implementation, and production operations. Paired with a business\-embedded AI Solutions counterpart, you will be in the room together from the first discovery conversation, and you will stay engaged together through deployment testing with users, measuring results, and iterating. Your job is to make sure what gets built solves the right problem, fits how people actually work, meets the firm's control requirements, and gets used. Along the way, you will also work with product owners, data teams, information security, an e commercial curiosity and a strong desire to learn KKR’s businesses — how investments are evaluated, how decisions are made, and which outcomes matter. * Comfort operating in ambiguity: the ability to take a vague problem, ask good questions, uncover needs users may not initially articulate, and converge on a concrete solution. * The range to move fluidly between writing code, discussing architecture, observing workflows, and engaging senior business stakeholders. * Act as a conductor across a diverse set of stakeholders — including business teams, business\-aligned product and engineering, AI platform product and engineering, and data operations — to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and drive projects forward to successful delivery. * A commitment to engineering quality — testing, observability, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices — even when moving quickly. * Clear communication and a collaborative, low\-ego working style, with the ability to give and receive direct feedback. * Experience deploying AI or data\-intensive systems in large enterprises or regulated environments. * Exposure to private markets, financial services, or other domains with complex, judgment\-heavy workflows. * Experience partnering directly with senior business stakeholders to shape and deliver technical solutions. * A track record of turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms, frameworks, or internal products. * Experience with evaluation frameworks, observability tooling, or governance practices for LLM applications. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** =========================== * AI solutions you built are running in production and used every day by the teams they were designed for. * Workflows you touched are measurably better — faster cycle times, higher\-quality decisions, less manual effort, or lower operational risk. * Capabilities you created — skills, tools, agents, connectors, and evaluation frameworks — are reused by other teams and business units. * Business partners trust you as someone who understands their work and seek you out with their hardest problems. * The systems you ship are secure, reliable, well\-evaluated, and maintainable long after launch. * Lessons from your deployments visibly shape the firm’s broader AI platform and roadmap. This is the expected annual base salary range for this New York\-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance. Base Salary Range $180,000 \- $200,000 USD KKR is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law. KKR will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. Individuals seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process should email Benefits@kkr.com. Emails sent for unrelated issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access https://www.kkr.com/careers because of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to Benefits@kkr.com. Only emails left for this purpose will be returned. **Massachusetts Applicants:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. This notice applies only to applicants and employees who work or will work in Massachusetts, in accordance with applicable state law.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (B2B Sales)
jobs.description: KoldaTech is a technology solutions company helping businesses turn ideas into powerful digital products and scalable technology solutions. We work with startups, small and medium\-sized businesses, and established organizations across areas including custom software development, web and mobile applications, UI/UX design, branding, digital marketing, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, IT consulting, SaaS, CRM, ERP, AI/ML, and other technology services. As KoldaTech continues to grow, we are looking for an ambitious Business Development Representative (BDR) to help us acquire new customers and expand our client base. The Opportunity This is a new\-business acquisition role. We are looking for someone who enjoys finding opportunities, starting conversations with potential customers, understanding business problems, presenting solutions, and turning prospects into clients. You will not simply wait for leads to arrive. Your job is to actively find businesses that need KoldaTech—and turn those opportunities into revenue. You will become one of the first points of contact between KoldaTech and prospective clients and will play an important role in building our sales pipeline and accelerating company growth. Your Mission Find → Connect → Qualify → Convert → Grow Your primary objective is to consistently generate qualified sales opportunities and new customers for KoldaTech. You will be expected to: * Identify companies that could benefit from KoldaTech’s services. * Find and connect with key decision\-makers. * Start meaningful business conversations. * Understand prospects’ technology and business challenges. * Position KoldaTech as the right solution provider. * Schedule qualified discovery meetings. * Follow up with prospects and proposals. * Help move opportunities through the sales pipeline. * Close new business or work closely with the sales team to close it. * Build relationships that can generate recurring and referral business. Key Responsibilities 1\. Lead Generation \& Prospecting Proactively identify and research potential customers using: * LinkedIn * Email outreach * Cold calling * Business directories * Industry databases * Networking * Referrals * Partnerships * Social media * Industry events * Other legitimate outbound sales channels Build targeted prospect lists based on company size, industry, business needs, technology requirements, and buying potential. 2\. Outbound Sales Develop personalized outreach campaigns to business owners, founders, CEOs, executives, department heads, and other decision\-makers. You will be responsible for: * Writing effective outreach messages. * Making sales calls. * Sending follow\-ups. * Starting conversations with prospects. * Handling objections professionally. * Identifying buying signals. * Moving qualified prospects toward a discovery call. 3\. Needs Discovery Learn how to identify the problems behind a prospect’s request. You should be able to ask questions such as: * What problem is the business trying to solve? * What technology are they currently using? * What is not working? * What are they trying to build or improve? * What is their expected timeline? * Who is involved in the decision? * What is their approximate budget? * What would success look like for them? The objective is not simply to sell a service. The objective is to understand the customer’s problem and connect that problem to the right KoldaTech solution. 4\. Promote KoldaTech Services You will represent and promote KoldaTech’s solutions, including: * Custom Software Development * Web Development * Mobile App Development * UI/UX Design * Brand Identity \& Branding * Digital Marketing * SEO * Social Media Marketing * Cybersecurity \& Compliance * Cloud Solutions * IT Consulting * CRM \& ERP Solutions * SaaS Development * AI \& Machine Learning Solutions * IoT Solutions * IT Maintenance \& Support You are not expected to be a software engineer. However, you should develop enough knowledge of our services to confidently explain their business value and identify when a prospect may need them. 5\. Qualification Not every lead is a good lead. You will qualify prospects based on factors such as: * Business need * Project scope * Budget * Timeline * Decision\-making authority * Company fit * Potential contract value * Probability of conversion High\-quality opportunities should be prioritized over simply generating a large number of unqualified leads. 6\. Sales Pipeline Management Maintain accurate records of all prospects and opportunities. You will be responsible for keeping the CRM updated with: * Company information * Contact information * Lead source * Customer requirements * Communication history * Opportunity stage * Estimated deal value * Follow\-up dates * Proposal status * Closing status * Next steps No qualified opportunity should be lost because of poor follow\-up. 7\. Follow\-Up \& Conversion Consistent follow\-up is a critical part of this role. You will follow up with prospects after: * I ty to handle rejection and continue prospecting. * Basic understanding of business and technology solutions. * Ability to learn KoldaTech’s services and communicate their value. * Familiarity with CRM and sales tools is preferred. Preferred Qualifications The following would be an advantage: * Previous B2B sales experience. * Experience selling IT services or software. * SaaS sales experience. * Digital agency or technology\-company experience. * Experience selling web or mobile development. * Experience selling cybersecurity or cloud solutions. * Experience selling digital marketing services. * Existing business network or professional network. * Experience working with founders, CEOs, or senior executives. * Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding sales targets. Who Will Succeed in This Role? You may be a strong fit if you are: Hungry — You want to build a career in sales and business development. Proactive — You don’t wait for leads. You find them. Persuasive — You know how to communicate value and influence decisions. Resilient — Rejection doesn’t discourage you. Curious — You want to understand businesses and their problems. Organized — You follow up and keep your pipeline under control. Competitive — You enjoy working toward measurable goals. Business\-minded — You understand that successful sales starts with solving a customer’s problem. Who Should Not Apply? This role may not be the right fit if you: * Prefer waiting for inbound leads. * Are uncomfortable with cold outreach. * Avoid making phone calls. * Give up after a few unanswered messages. * Do not enjoy sales conversations. * Need constant supervision to stay productive. * Are uncomfortable working toward measurable targets. * Focus on activity rather than results. * Are not willing to learn about technology and business solutions. Compensation KoldaTech offers a performance\-driven compensation structure designed to reward successful customer acquisition and revenue generation. Compensation may include: * Competitive base compensation, where applicable. * Sales commissions. * Performance\-based incentives. * Additional rewards for exceptional sales performance. Specific compensation will be discussed with qualified candidates based on experience, location, and the agreed compensation structure. Career Growth This position can grow into a larger sales and business\-development role based on performance. High\-performing team members may have opportunities to advance into positions such as: Business Development Executive → Senior Business Development Executive → Business Development Manager → Sales Manager / Business Development Lead Growth at KoldaTech is based on performance, leadership, consistency, and demonstrated business impact. Why Join KoldaTech? You will have the opportunity to work with a growing technology company and sell solutions that address real business needs. You will also gain experience in: * B2B technology sales * SaaS and software sales * Consultative selling * Lead generation * Account development * Digital services * Client relationship management * Proposal development * Business strategy Most importantly, you will have a direct role in growing KoldaTech’s customer base and revenue. How to Apply If you are confident that you can help KoldaTech acquire new customers, we want to hear from you. Please submit your application with: * Your resume/CV * A brief introduction * Relevant sales or business\-development experience * Examples of previous sales results, if available * Your preferred compensation structure Candidates with demonstrated B2B sales performance and experience selling technology services will receive strong consideration. Ready to Grow With KoldaTech? Don’t just look for a sales job. Build a career in business development and help grow a technology company. Apply today and show us what you can bring to KoldaTech. Pay: $68,790\.64 \- $82,844\.64 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Water System Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: * **1 Year contract** * **$85\.83/hr** * **On\-site in Berkeley** ### **Keep a world\-class scientific facility running — one drop at a time** Somewhere behind the walls of a cutting\-edge accelerator facility, an invisible network of pumps, exchangers, and ultra\-pure water loops is quietly doing the hard work: pulling heat away from equipment that pushes the boundaries of physics. That network needs an owner. That's you. We're looking for a Water Systems Engineer to take technical ownership of the cooling and process water infrastructure powering a major scientific research campus including a large\-scale capital upgrade project currently underway. If you love solving real engineering problems with real consequences, and you want your fingerprints on systems that keep world\-class science running 24/7, this is the seat. **Why this role is different** ------------------------------ * **You'll own something real.** Not a slice of a system, the whole thing. Design, operation, reliability, and continuous improvement of cooling water infrastructure are yours to drive. * **High\-stakes, high\-trust work.** These systems support sensitive scientific equipment where downtime isn't an option. Your decisions matter, and you'll be trusted to make them. * **Design** ***and*** **build** ***and*** **run it.** This isn't a design\-only or maintenance\-only role. You'll architect systems, specify equipment, manage installation, and then operate what you built. * **Constant variety.** One day you're deep in hydraulic calculations and P\&IDs; the next you're troubleshooting a resin bed, coordinating a shutdown, or reviewing a contractor's installation work. **What you'll actually do** --------------------------- **Design \& engineer the systems** * Architect cooling water systems from the ground up — P\&IDs, flow diagrams, hydraulic calculations, equipment specs * Analyze heat transfer, fluid flow, pump sizing, pressure drops, thermal stability, and water quality * Specify and oversee procurement of pumps, heat exchangers, filtration, expansion tanks, piping, valves, instrumentation, and treatment systems * Ensure everything meets ASME, ANSI, California code, and lab engineering standards **Run the operation** * Own daily operation of closed\-loop low\-conductivity water (LCW) and deionized (DI) water systems resistivity, dissolved oxygen, pH, the works * Manage chemical dosing, UV sterilizers, mixed\-bed deionizers, and RO systems to fend off biological growth, scaling, and corrosion * Build and run preventive maintenance programs; troubleshoot pump failures, resin degradation, leaks, and everything in between * Plan and commission system expansions and retrofits, choosing the right materials (think PVDF, electropolished stainless) to protect ultra\-pure water quality **Lead the projects** * Take water\-system projects from concept through installation and commissioning * Coordinate contractors, vendors, and installation crews * Build schedules, cost estimates, and technical scopes * Review installation quality against your own specs **Keep it safe and documented** * Participate in hazard analyses and readiness reviews * Maintain clean, accurate engineering documentation and support change control * Support lockout/tagout planning and safety procedures **What you bring** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (or closely related field) * 8\+ years of relevant engineering experience, with substantial time spent designing, operating, or maintaining industrial process or facility water systems * Real, hands\-on knowledge of low\-conductivity and deionized water systems, you know how to protect purity, prevent corrosion, and troubleshoot fast * Experience with closed\-loop cooling systems, process utilities, and industrial piping * Comfort reading and producing engineering drawings and P\&IDs * Working knowledge of pumps, heat exchangers, cooling towers, water treatment, and controls * A troubleshooter's mindset and strong root\-cause analysis instincts * The ability to juggle multiple projects in a complex, live operational environment * Communication skills sharp enough to brief both a technician and a director **Bonus points for** -------------------- * A Professional Engineer (PE) license * Experience with large scientific facilities, accelerators, semiconductor fabs, or other high\-availability technical infrastructure * Exposure to EPICS or industrial controls integration * Experience with vibration\-sensitive or thermally stable cooling systems * Reliability\-centered maintenance know\-how * Background in a national\-laboratory or similarly regulated research environment **The day\-to\-day** -------------------- Expect a mix of office, lab, mechanical room, and construction\-site time. Occasional after\-hours or weekend support may be needed during shutdowns or commissioning events, and some work happens in confined mechanical spaces around industrial equipment. If you'd rather be moving between problems than staring at the same spreadsheet all day, you'll feel right at home. **Why it matters** ------------------ The systems you'll own are the thermal backbone of a facility pushing the edge of scientific discovery. Every degree of temperature stability, every part\-per\-billion of water purity, every minute of uptime you protect translates directly into research that couldn't happen without you. This is engineering with a mission behind it. **Ready to keep the mission running? Apply today.** Vjxi3gIbK9
