jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: Our team is looking to hire a senior level developer to help in our life saving mission of providing training to support to emergency dispatch services across the globe. If you’re ready to take your career to the next level while making a worthwhile impact, consider joining our team! This role is eligible for our full host of benefits such as health, dental, vision, pet, and legal insurance, PTO, company contributions to a 401K and more while working in an award winning workplace culture. Come see why our teams love working here! This role is based in Salt Lake City, UT and has a hybrid work model. **Job Summary:** Provide master level design and development expertise to the creation and maintenance of software products including training/learning platforms, applications, web pages, client portals, databases, reports and queries, and other products as requested. Takes ownership of assigned projects end to end: refining requests into well\-defined problems, setting technical direction toward reusable and maintainable systems, and standing behind the integrity of what ships. Interfaces with clients, customers, and internal users to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deploy solutions. Trains other team members, provides technical leadership, and acts as a final reviewer on code changes. Creates reusable tools and processes that support our development teams and their best practices. This role operates on a hybrid work model. **Major Responsibilities:** * Design and develop efficient software components for complex tasks without supervision. * Take a high\-level idea or business need, identify the underlying problem and the outcome actually wanted, and carry it through to a working, maintainable solution rather than building to the literal request. * Steer technical direction on projects toward reusable, maintainable systems rather than one\-off implementations. * Assist in the design of application architecture, including structure, data models, and integration points, so features can be added without rework as the system grows. * Own the integrity of code shipped on assigned projects, serving as the responsible point of contact if something breaks. * Effectively manage development projects and report on progress. * Effectively troubleshoot and diagnose complex software problems. * Ensure website designs are compliant with the major browsers. * Design intuitive and responsive web\-based user interfaces. * Anticipate, identify, and mitigate problem areas. * Develop prototypes and proofs of concept for end users. * Meet with users to define application requirements. * Provide direction and guidance to less experienced staff. * Conduct thorough, final\-stage code reviews and give approval before changes are merged. * Performs testing of websites. * Other duties as assigned. **Education and/or Experience:** * 5\+ years of relevant software development experience, including 2\+ years owning projects end to end: setting technical direction, refining requirements, and carrying features through launch into continuing maintenance and support. * Able to mentor/train Software Dev I and Dev II employees. * Strong hands\-on experience across the stack: TypeScript and JavaScript with frameworks such as Vue and Nuxt, HTML and CSS screen layouts, server\-side web services and APIs (including WCF), and MS SQL Server (T\-SQL) and MySQL databases. * Real\-world coding experience delivering and maintaining production software, with the depth to work effectively without AI assistance. * Proven experience directing AI development tools to build and ship complex projects, not just isolated snippets or boilerplate: breaking large problems into workable pieces, supplying the right context and specifications, and iterating toward a sound design. * Ability to critically review and validate AI\-generated code, recognizing when output is incorrect, insecure, or poorly structured, and knowing the underlying technology well enough to correct it. * Solid experience with website security and security best practices. * Ability to write flexible, reusable, and documented code. * Strong analytical abilities. * Strong customer service attitude. * Proficiency with Git, including branching and pull request workflows, and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve repository problems such as merge conflicts, bad merges, and damaged history. * Strong understanding of REST architecture, and experience contributing to application\-level design decisions on real projects: data models, service boundaries, and integration points, with attention to performance and long\-term maintainability. * Bonus: Experience with SCORM and developing learning platforms. * Bonus: Experience with Azure (projects, web apps, blob storage, pipelines, releases, permissions). **Physical/Essential Job Functions:** * Ability to resolve technical problems efficiently * Coding, collaborating, developing prototypes and projects from start to final product * Ability to communicate technical concepts to both users and programmers effectively * Ability to resolve technical problems efficiently. * Ability to communicate technical concepts to both users and programmers effectively. * Problem\-solving * Frequent computer and telephone use * Sitting for long periods of time * Concentrating for long periods of time. * Infrequent travel of less than 5% may be required. **Our Company:** As one of Utah's Top Places to work, IAED is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are a small, fast\-growing provider of consulting, training, and software products for the public safety market. IAED is based in the U.S. in downtown Salt Lake City, Utah. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and matching 401(k) programs, etc.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer Lifecycle and MarTech (Remote)
jobs.description: **Progressive Leasing** is a leading provider of in\-store and e\-commerce lease\-to\-own solutions. With more than 20 years in FinTech, we’ve grown from start\-up to industry leader by innovating, simplifying, and valuing people. We are a subsidiary of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with three business segments: Progressive Leasing, Purchasing Power (a leading employee purchase program for consumer products and services using payroll deduction), and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform. Progressive Leasing is a leading provider of in\-store and e\-commerce lease\-to\-own solutions. As an almost 20\+ year old FinTech company that has gone from start\-up to industry leader, we know how to innovate, simplify, and value all people. We are a company founded on our grit and we are constantly looking to the future. As an ever\-evolving group of entrepreneurs and technologists, we strive to do the right thing period in all aspects of our work. We are a subsidiary of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), an exciting FinTech holding company, with three business segments including Progressive, Purchasing Power, and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform. We are currently hiring a **Senior** **Product Manager** to help grow our company and ensure our mission is achieved! This is a remote\-first role that can be performed from anywhere in the continental US or from one of our corporate offices in Utah or Arizona. As a key member of our product organization, you will own the roadmap for data enablement, customer communications, and eMarketing platforms — building the infrastructure that powers marketing, lifecycle, and customer experience at scale. *Employee Value Proposition (EVP): PROG is dedicated to providing people with opportunity; opportunity for inclusive collaboration, opportunity for innovation, and opportunity for development.* **WE ARE:** Prog Tech embodies the modernity and transformational vision that is core to our business evolution. As passionate and hungry technical experts, we join together on the mission of progressing through technology. We believe in taking pride in our engineering, in the relentless pursuit of daily progress, and to bring others with you in your march to the future. We continuously experiment, fail fast, and constantly deliver. **YOU ARE:** A highly skilled technical product manager with a background in data enablement, marketing technology, and customer communications platforms. You have a passion for using data to solve problems: not just analyzing it but building the products and infrastructure that make data actionable for marketing, lifecycle, and customer experience teams. You are a systems thinker who gets excited about making data actionable, communications intelligent, and lifecycle programs run at scale — building the infrastructure that makes the whole machine work. You bring strong foundational product management skills, operate with urgency and ownership, and are a natural communicator who can align engineers, stakeholders, and business partners around a shared roadmap. **YOUR DAY\-TO\-DAY:** * Own the roadmap for data enablement, customer communications platforms, and eMarketing tooling across marketing needs, lifecycle functions, and emerging conversion use cases * Build and evolve lifecycle journeys that personalize at scale — from first\-touch communications through re\-engagement and retention — adjusting as new programs (lease protect, post\-checkout offers, affiliate) come online * Translate complex data needs from marketing and business partners into clear product requirements that engineering can build against * Partner with data engineering and analytics teams to identify gaps in data availability, data quality, and segmentation capability and convert those gaps into backlog items * Define use cases, features, requirements, and acceptance criteria for communications platforms including notifications, content management, and campaign tooling * Lead cross\-functional initiatives that span marketing, technology, and lifecycle teams, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and driving alignment across stakeholders * Establish voice\-of\-customer feedback loops — surfacing consumer insights from communications performance, support signals, and behavioral data back into the product and roadmap * Operate as an AI\-first product builder: leverage AI agents, automations, and workflow tooling as first\-class workers in lifecycle and communications processes, not just as productivity aids * Use sound judgment to assess risks and produce well\-structured, data\-informed written narratives for leadership * Analyze product and platform performance and establish metrics that reflect both technical health and business value * Manage vendor relationships where third\-party platforms such as communications vendors and CMS tools are core to the product surface * Maintain strong communication channels across marketing, engineering, and operations, translating strategy into execution and keeping stakeholders informed on timelines, blockers, and outcomes **YOU'LL BRING:** * 5 to 7 years of experience in software Product Management * Demonstrated experience owning data products or data enablement initiatives, with an understanding of how data flows, how it is consumed, and how to make it more useful to business stakeholders * Experience with marketing technology platforms including customer communications, CMS, campaign management, or notification systems — and direct hands\-on fluency with lifecycle and analytics tooling (e.g., Braze, Iterable, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Amplitude, or equivalents); you've used these platforms to define requirements and govern outcomes, not just observed them from a distance * Demonstrated comfort building with AI\-native tools and workflows — not just using AI for productivity, but designing processes where AI agents, automations, and LLM\-assisted operations are part of how the product surface functions * Ability to move fluently between high\-level strategy and detailed execution, equally comfortable writing a one\-pager for leadership and an acceptance criterion for engineering * Exceptional communication skills: listening, writing, presenting, and collaborating across technical and non\-technical audiences * High integrity and the ambition to relentlessly pursue the best possible product * Demonstrated ability to self\-motivate, self\-direct, and stay flexible in a fast\-paced environment * Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience * AI\-enabled tools are already part of how work gets done jobs.title: Electrical Distribution Associate Graduate Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ HBK Engineering, LLC is a fully licensed, professional engineering design firm headquartered in Chicago, IL with a staff approaching 700 individuals. HBK provides civil, environmental, structural, electrical, subsurface utility, construction support services and permitting facilitation. Since our founding in 1998, we have earned a reputation for delivering outstanding, accurate services in extremely time\-sensitive, multilayered environments. That "industry\-recognized" performance has propelled our expansion and the ability to provide engineering services in all 50 states. With 25 offices nationwide, including concentrations in the Midwest and on the Coasts, HBK brings together a dedicated team whose main focus is the design and protection of utilities and utility networks. We have successfully performed engineering work for a complete spectrum of utility infrastructure projects providing solutions and construction support from Coast to Coast in areas ranging from complex urban city centers, to rural greenfields, to limited access rights\-of\-way. In July 2020, HBK Engineering was acquired by Quanta Services. Quanta Services provides infrastructure services for electric power, pipeline, and communications industries and employees over 50,000 people. Quanta’s focus on the utility industry and HBK’s focus on constructability in our designs has made our integration into the Quanta family of companies seamless. **About this Role** ------------------- The Electrical \& Gas Distribution Associate Graduate Engineer at HBK Engineering is a role designed for recent engineering graduates entering the professional workforce. This entry\-level position involves providing contract engineering resources to a local utility in **Bozeman, Montana**. While the primary focus in this region is electrical distribution, the role will also include supporting gas engineering scope. The position supports the company’s expanding efforts to connect new customers to the local utility grid. Additionally, it provides critical engineering support for existing customers through capacity upgrade projects, system rebuilds, and the relocation of existing utility infrastructure. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design engineering systems in compliance with relevant specifications, codes, and client requirements for overhead/subsurface electrical projects as well as gas distribution infrastructure. * Deploy creative and unique solutions to address a wide variety of complex electrical, gas, structural, civil, and construction\-related challenges. * Own all phases of the design lifecycle from initiation through construction completion and project closeout across electric and gas scope. * Prepare detailed engineering and construction documents using a variety of software tools including DDS (Distribution Design Studio), GIS systems, Trimble surveying equipment, and client\-specific enterprise asset management platforms. * Analyze information from supplementary data sources including topographical surveys, utility atlas information, field sketches, client records, and manufacturer equipment datasheets. * Independently manage time and schedule to achieve project milestones. * Perform field walkdowns with internal staff, clients, customers, governance authorities, and construction partners. * Obtain proper permits and easements as required. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * An ability to work independently and within interdisciplinary electric and gas engineering teams. * Strong technology skills and an understanding of the Office365 suite of tools. * Working knowledge of 2D CADD software (AutoCAD or similar) including its use to generate layout drawings or other project materials. * Understanding of remote communication software. * Ability to come up to speed quickly on in\-process projects and hit the ground running. * Experience collaborating with a team in order to complete a larger project. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * The persistence to see projects through to completion. Adaptable to change in a dynamic team environment. * **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor of Science in Engineering or related degree from an ABET\-accredited program. * EIT Certification. (Preferred) * 0 to 4 years of experience. **What You'll Get** ------------------- * Leadership opportunities through coaching and mentoring responsibilities * Professional growth within the HBK Organization's Design Track * Opportunity to work independently on complex engineering challenges * Collaborative work environment with interdisciplinary teams * Travel opportunities for field work and client engagement * Comprehensive benefits package * Career advancement opportunities with increased responsibilities. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.

APIs and end\-user experiences using Ruby on Rails and React for our patient and provider applications. * Actively contribute to our evolving software development and testing standards to level up technical excellence across the team. * Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to create high\-impact features, balancing great UX with clean code complexity. * All other duties assigned. **What you’ll bring (Qualifications)** * **Education**: Bachelor's degree in IT, MIS, CS or equivalent, or similar experience. * **Experience**: 7\+ years of building and shipping scalable web applications across the full software stack. * Experience with React, TypeScript, and modern UI patterns, with a focus on web performance and responsiveness. * Strong professional experience building backend systems, designing clean APIs (GraphQL/REST), and establishing efficient data\-fetching models. * Proficient in writing SQL for relational databases (PostgreSQL). * Hands\-on experience with automated testing at all layers (RSpec, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright). * Proficiency with modern deployment pipelines (CI/CD, GitHub Actions). * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an iterative Agile environment to deliver continuous business value with minimal direction. * Excellent problem\-solving, and communication skills with ability to articulate complex technical trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Willingness to participate in on\-call rotation to support platform reliability outside of standard working hours. * Commitment to protect user data by following data security, privacy, and ethical technology practices. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent and ongoing future basis without requiring sponsorship. **Preferred Experience****:** * Prior experience leading complex projects, driving architectural choices, and aligning cross\-functional teams. * Experience with modern Ruby on Rails and advanced JavaScript ecosystems. * Experience making large\-scale frontend design decisions or configuring build tooling from scratch. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted coding tools (Copilot, Gemini, Claude). * Prior experience in healthcare and building integrations in the broader US health system. * \- \#LI\-AK1 This is where problem\-solvers, innovators, and big thinkers thrive.** **Quest Defense Systems \& Solutions is seeking a highly skilled and detail\-oriented Senior Embedded Software Engineer r**esponsible for the design, development, and maintenance of C\-based control software for critical power and automation systems. lab.*** **Responsibilities:** * Prepare design specifications, develop embedded software, perform module testing, and conduct integration testing of designs. * Perform code reviews and verifications (HIL) simulation and full end\-to\-end operational testing. * Work with the technical leader to establish effective work plans, including time estimates, schedule estimates, requirements, and work processes. * Apply engineering fundamentals and first\-order engineering principles to establish and/or confirm expected performance. * Provide clear and complete analysis documentation in accordance with customer engineering procedures. * Manage time effectively to deliver quality work within expected project timelines. * Communicate work status clearly and effectively to leadership. * Provide leadership and mentoring to junior staff. * Deliver high\-quality engineering software as the primary output of the role. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Computer, or Software Engineering from an accredited college or university. * Minimum of 10 years of experience in embedded software development, including the C programming language and software development tools (GitLab, Jira, LDRA, Arm Development Studio, Visual Studio, GDB, etc.). * Minimum of 10 years of experience with coding conventions, code review, unit testing, and integration testing of embedded software. * Experience with software development in a safety\-critical environment (DO\-178, ISO 26262\). **Preferred Qualifications:** * Intermediate knowledge of standard programming languages (e.g., Python) * Ability to solve technical challenges by applying common design patterns and selecting appropriate patterns for problem\-solving. * Effective use of data structures and algorithms. * Experience understanding and applying coding standards that deliver desired functionality using project\-selected technologies. * Knowledge of common development paradigms (Agile, Waterfall). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical topics clearly. * Proactively learns new tools, identifies opportunities for improvement, and promotes their adoption. * Experience adopting and/or integrating emerging technologies (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms, digital assistants) into day\-to\-day operations for continuous improvement. **The QDSS Advantage:** At QDSS, our advantage is purpose\-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You'll grow your career while contributing to mission\-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future. Benefits Include * Competitive pay, comprehensive medical/dental/life and disability coverage, 401(k) with employer match, professional development support, and a flexible, friendly workplace. At **Quest Defense Systems and Solutions**, we don't just build technology — we engineer the future. From next\-generation aerospace solutions to cutting\-edge defense systems, we tackle the toughest, mission\-critical challenges that keep people safe and push the boundaries of innovation. This is where problem\-solvers, innovators, and visionary thinkers come together to shape the future. Together, we're not just leading the industry — we're revolutionizing it. jobs.title: Developer - .Net
jobs.description: **Position Summary** R\+L Carriers is seeking an experienced **AI \& .NET Developer** to join our Enterprise EDI team. This role will design, develop, and support applications that improve EDI operations, automate business processes, and leverage Artificial Intelligence to increase efficiency across customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, exception handling, and operational reporting. The ideal candidate has strong Microsoft .NET development experience, understands enterprise integrations, and is excited about applying AI technologies to solve business problems. This position is more than a traditional .NET developer role. It is an opportunity to modernize enterprise EDI by combining software engineering with practical AI capabilities. The successful candidate will help transform how the EDI team supports customers, manages trading partners, resolves production issues, and delivers scalable integration solutions across the organization. **Primary Responsibilities** **Software Development** * Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server. * Develop APIs and services that integrate with internal and external systems. * Create web applications and internal tools supporting EDI operations. * Build dashboards and reporting applications for EDI metrics and performance. * Participate in architecture, design, code reviews, testing, and production deployments. **AI \& Automation** * Develop AI\-powered applications using Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Microsoft Copilot technologies, or similar platforms. * Build internal AI assistants that help analysts troubleshoot EDI issues. * Develop document\-processing and knowledge\-search solutions using Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG). * Implement workflow automation to reduce manual processing. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend practical business applications. **EDI Integration** * Collaborate with EDI analysts to automate trading partner onboarding. * Develop utilities for EDI validation, monitoring, and error detection. * Support ANSI X12 transaction processing and integration with enterprise applications. * Build tools that simplify troubleshooting and improve operational visibility. * Assist in integration projects involving APIs, XML, JSON, FTP/SFTP, and other data exchange technologies. **Collaboration** * Work closely with EDI analysts, software developers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders. * Participate in Agile development processes. * Create technical documentation and knowledge base articles. Mentor team members on modern development practices and AI capabilities. * **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience) * 5\+ years of software development experience * Strong experience with: + C\# + .NET Framework and/or .NET 8\+ + ASP.NET Core + SQL Server + REST APIs + Entity Framework + Git Experience with: * Visual Studio * Azure DevOps * Azure Functions * IIS * JSON/XML * API development * Object\-Oriented Design **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with one or more of the following: **Artificial Intelligence** * Azure OpenAI * OpenAI APIs * Microsoft Copilot Studio * LangChain or Semantic Kernel * Prompt Engineering * Vector databases * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * AI Agent development **Cloud** * Microsoft Azure * Azure App Services * Azure SQL * Azure Storage * Azure AI Services **EDI** * ANSI X12 standards * Transportation transactions (204, 210, 214, 990, 997\) * Trading partner onboarding * EDI mapping concepts * Integration platforms * API/EDI hybrid integrations

jobs.title: Electrical Systems & Automation Design Engineer
jobs.description: Join REEKON Tools as we enable the next generation of construction and home improvement professionals to complete their work quicker, more accurately, and faster than ever before. REEKON Tools is developing and launching innovative, completely new, hardware products at an unprecedented pace across the power and hand tool industry and establishing itself as a leader in professional tools and equipment. We are looking for an **Electrical Systems \& Automation Design Engineer** who bridges the gap between custom hardware design, sensor electronics, and automated manufacturing equipment. This role is built for a physical\-world generalist who thrives on both designing custom circuit boards and building, deploying, and debugging custom automation systems on the factory floor. You will own the board\-level hardware from schematic capture, component sourcing, and layout, while simultaneously building custom automated test fixtures, integrating sensors and actuators, and debugging complex edge\-case failures directly on the production line. **To apply for this role, please email careers@reekon.tools with a note on what project you are most proud to have worked on and apply through the posting here.** ### **Key Responsibilities** ### **Professional Electrical Design \& PCB Layout** * **Production Schematic \& PCB Layout:** Own multi\-layer PCB layout (2 to 6\+ layers) using Altium Designer or KiCad for both product hardware and internal factory automation tooling. * **Signal \& Power Integrity:** Design low\-noise analog front\-ends, high\-speed digital routing, motor drive circuits, power conversion (DC\-DC, LDOs), and power management. * **EMC/EMI Compliance:** Design schematics and board layouts for noise immunity in high\-noise factory environments, incorporating ESD protection, isolation, shielding, and filtering from day one. ### **Component Sourcing \& Supply Chain Architecture** * **Vendor Ecosystem Mastery:** Evaluate components across major vendors (TI, STMicroelectronics, Analog Devices, Microchip, etc.) balancing performance, cost, footprint, and lead times. * **Datasheet Deep Dives:** Analyze complex IC datasheets, register maps, pin constraints, thermal limits, and application circuits before committing to a design. * **BOM Optimization:** Select components with long\-term availability and design for second\-source equivalents to protect both product delivery and factory uptime. ### **Custom Factory Automation \& Line Integration** * **Automated Equipment \& Fixtures:** Architect, build, and deploy custom factory automation rigs, automated test equipment (ATE), and smart assembly fixtures to optimize production yield and throughput. * **Actuation \& Motion Control:** Integrate motor drives, pneumatics, linear actuators, optical sensors, safety interlocks, and industrial communications into unified, rugged automation equipment. * ### **Manufacturing Diagnostics:** Write firmware (C/C\+\+) and automation scripts (Python) to drive test fixtures, interface with line sensors, log metric data, and automate line diagnostics. ### **Hardware Debugging \& Line Troubleshooting** * **Production Line Debugging:** Serve as the primary technical responder for complex hardware bugs on the shop floor, isolating root causes ranging from electrical issues to systems\-level bugs * **Bench \& Shop Floor Mastery:** Utilize oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, bus sniffers, and precision multimeters to diagnose live physical signals on boards and automated rigs. * **Fault\-Path \& Stress Testing:** Inject deliberate faults (brownouts, reversed polarity, shorted sensors, stalled buses, ESD strikes) to ensure production equipment fails safely and recovers gracefully. ### **Rapid Prototyping \& Skunkworks** * Passionate about ideating, architecting, and prototyping electrical systems without a documented playbook (datasheets, design notes, etc) * Can make proof\-of\-concept designs that help the team make decisions about the utility as well as viability of the solution ### **Qualifications** * **Education:** B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or equivalent practical experience. * **Portfolio:** A portfolio highlighting hardware projects you led from concept to completion, with an emphasis on custom electronics. * **EDA Tool Proficiency:** Expert\-level capability in Altium Designer, KiCad, or equivalent professional EDA software. * **Automation \& Mechatronics Experience:** Hands\-on experience developing custom automation systems, automated test fixtures, motor controls, or sensor networks for hardware assembly/testing. * **Component Sourcing Track Record:** Demonstrated experience reviewing IC availability, building production BOMs, and sourcing equivalent multi\-source components. * **Lab \& Field Debugging:** High comfort level working with bench top instruments (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) and diagnosing live hardware on a manufacturing line. * **Embedded \& Automation Software:** Proficiency in C/C\+\+ for hardware bring\-up and microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, etc.), and Python for test automation and data logging. * **The Maker Mindset:** A track record of hands\-on builds custom CNCs, 3D printers, DIY robotics, or automated lab setups demonstrating deep technical curiosity Even if you don’t check every box mentioned above, we still strongly encourage you to apply! At REEKON Tools, diversity is a cornerstone of the business we are building. **We know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful and are committed to building our team that encompasses a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills!** We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. For any questions \- please email us at **careers@reekon.tools**

This position may also provide technical guidance and assign tasks to junior and support staff for project duration, manage discipline and small multidisciplinary teams to ensure company and project contractual compliance, and/or manage a small team of direct reports. If this sounds like the role for you and you're ready to join an amazing team, please apply. ***An Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Sr. Product Mgr Ultrasound AI
jobs.description: Job Description: This role shapes and delivers Ultrasound AI products with clinicians, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and product designers. It scales in\-market thyroid and breast ultrasound AI products, already serving hundreds of thousands of patients a year, toward millions of patients a year, and runs discovery and development for new products. The role turns clinical, customer, commercial, and AI model performance insights into clear priorities and helps the team execute. It operates with high autonomy, allocates attention across multiple products at different levels of maturity, and influences decisions through evidence and clear framing. PLEASE NOTE: **Work Schedule:** This role follows a typical 9\-hour workday and requires flexibility to work later Pacific Time hours to maintain overlap with our Melbourne\-based team. Typical hours are 10:00 AM–7:00 PM PT from April to October and 8:00 AM\-5:00 PM PT from March to November (1 hour allotted for lunch). This provides approximately **2–4 hours of overlap with Melbourne mornings**, depending on daylight\-saving time. **Job requirements** -------------------- * Contribute to product strategy and execution across in\-market scaling products and new ultrasound AI products. * Work with clinicians to understand clinical workflow, and distinguish stated customer requests from actual problems and clinical need. * Decide what to build, defer, or stop, making trade\-offs based on evidence and judgment. * Improve in\-market products using customer feedback and market insights. * Own discovery and validation for new ultrasound opportunities, and lead cross\-functional delivery from discovery through launch and outcomes. * Build a knowledge base stakeholders can use across the product lifecycle. Own the what and why behind product decisions, partner with engineering and design on the how, and communicate decisions clearly across distributed teams with high\-quality asynchronous documentation. * Translate clinical and product problems into actionable work with machine learning engineers, and help set model performance metrics that reflect product value for customers. * Make trade\-offs across model performance metrics (accuracy, sensitivity, specificity), error types (false positive versus false negative), workflow, speed, and cost. * Partner with sales and marketing on customer conversations, positioning, and go\-to\-market execution. Collaborate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to deliver with speed within medical\-device and regulatory constraints. * Build working relationships across engineering, design, clinical, regulatory, and commercial teams. Influence through evidence and framing, mentor others on product practices and decision quality, and manage attention across multiple products with transparent trade\-offs. *PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.* **Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. (Required) * 5\+ years as a product manager, product engineer, designer who led product decisions and execution, or founder leading product. (Required) * Track record of shipping successful software products end to end, with demonstrated measurable post\-launch outcomes. (Required) * Product judgment and experience making evidence\-based decisions, including forming and testing hypotheses when evidence is incomplete. (Required) * Working knowledge of machine learning, including an understanding of asymmetric error costs (for example, the cost of a false positive versus a false negative). (Required) * User research, cross\-functional delivery, and commercial or customer\-facing capability. (Required) * High autonomy, clear communication, and effective asynchronous collaboration across time zones. (Required) * Hands\-on fluency with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT Work, or Claude Cowork, with demonstrated successful use cases in the current role. (Preferred) * Software engineering, hands\-on coding, or design contribution experience. (Preferred) * Regulated\-industry and/or medical\-domain product experience. (Preferred) **Quality Standards** * Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co\-workers, visitors, and vendors. * Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance. * Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment. * Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures. * Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. * Practices universal safety precautions. * Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person. * Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. * Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines. * Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner. **Travel** This position requires domestic and international travel up to 10%. **Working Environment** Remote “The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.” Pay Range: USD $140,000\.00 \- USD $185,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company** --------------------- Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross\-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world. You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1\.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk. **Our Ethos** ------------- We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company. **About the Team** ------------------ We're a small infrastructure team with a huge impact. We’re building the foundation for running all of the products and services at Rain. Our work is highly visible, our input is sought out, and we get to work on real problems that matter across the company and industry. We’re delivering the platform powering real financial products, the security architecture protecting them, and the delivery pipelines to deploy them. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Be a critical part of the technical infrastructure roadmap * Manage our cloud environments across GCP and AWS * Scale our infrastructure to millions of end users globally * Help drive the architectural decisions of a rapidly evolving product * Lead the creation and maintenance of our CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable deployments * Collaborate with the engineering team to improve infrastructure performance * Build infrastructure to interact with millions of smart contracts across dozens of blockchains * Automate security controls and compliance processes to protect sensitive financial data **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3 years of Google Cloud infrastructure work * Ability to write shell scripts, Terraform, GitHub Action Workflows * Containerized service deployment / Docker * Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform, for managing cloud resources at scale * Proven track record designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows * Experience managing production environments in cloud providers * Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools **Bonus Attributes** -------------------- * Kubernetes / GKE / Helm * Cloud Networking / VPC / Firewall / LoadBalancer / SSL\+mTLS * Experience working with PCI / Zero\-trust architectures * Typescript/NodeJS/Golang developer or DevOps experience **Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:** -------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Unlimited time off** Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves. **Flexible working** We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace. **Easy to access benefits** For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company\-subsidized life insurance plan. **Retirement goals** Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match. **Equity plan** Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success. **Health and Wellness** High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture \- whatever recharges you! **In\-office meals** Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit. **Team summits** Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international. Compensation Range: $170K \- $225K

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human\-centred creativity, and AI\-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact\-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. Our \#LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience \#LifeatRealChem. **Real Chemistry Media** Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media’s product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life\-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing. Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self\-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product’s future. We are hiring a **Product Manager** to lead the definition of that product. Reporting to the VP, Product, you will work closely with engineering, design, data science, and customers to turn open\-ended problems into shipped software. You will own what gets built and define the shape of the product as it evolves. The team is small and we’re building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence. **What You'll Do:** * Own product areas on the roadmap end to end, from problem definition through launch and iteration. * Work closely with designers and engineers, holding a high bar for quality and helping the team meet it. * Collaborate across teams to prioritize the backlog against customer impact, technical reality, and business commitments. * Partner with data engineering and data science on the models and recommendation features built on top of them. * Use product analytics, usage data, competitive analysis, and qualitative user feedback to figure out what’s working and what to build next. * Partner with product and engineering leadership to inform the platform vision and product development process as the team scales. * Define product milestones and collaborate with project management to keep engineering, design, and client teams on track to deliver on time. **This position is a perfect fit for you if:** * You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. jobs.title: Global Telco Specialist Solution Architect - Lightwell
jobs.description: **About the role:** The Red Hat Technology Sales team is looking for a Lightwell Specialist Solution Architect (SSA) with Telco experience to join our team. This position assumes a crucial role in providing expert deep technical sales support for the seamless execution of Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategies related to Red Hat Lightwell. Your primary focus will be to remove the organizational, technical, and competitive blockers to adoption of Red Hat Lightwell, making Red Hat the source our customers' applications are built from. You will help customers close the vulnerability gap that sits between their own application code and the platform beneath it so that remediation stops consuming engineering capacity they would rather spend on their business. You will need to confidently articulate our value proposition to developers, build and platform engineers, application development leadership, and the security and compliance organization within the account, changing register as you move between them. This will entail hands\-on work in the customer's own build environment, technical architecture walk\-throughs, business\-value conversations framed in engineering cost, customer\-facing technical workshops, and implementation of best practices in dependency management, artifact signing, attestation, and pipeline enforcement. Adoption is ultimately a developer decision, and proving it in their build is the most persuasive conversation you will have. You will work closely with the Lightwell business unit and engineering, helping to test, document, and demonstrate cutting\-edge features, and carrying coverage gaps, ecosystem requests, and competitive intelligence back to the business unit as a defined part of the role. You will also work in close collaboration with Red Hat sales, Customer Success, Consulting Services, and partner teams to ensure a highly positive customer experience. **What you will do:** * Deploy into requested engagements as Red Hat's technical lead for trusted software supply chain, partnering with the Account Solution Architect and Account Executive to drive Red Hat Lightwell within new and existing customer accounts * Lead the technical conversation across three distinct audiences: developers and build engineers, application development and platform engineering leadership, and the security and compliance organization, adapting depth and framing to each. * Articulate and defend Red Hat's differentiating position against alternative approaches in the market. * Position the software supply chain offerings within the broader Red Hat portfolio, including hardened container images, artifact signing, attestation, SBOM generation, pipeline policy enforcement, and runtime security. * Prove the offering in the customer's environment, configuring their build to resolve against Lightwell repositories, executing their build, and troubleshooting the result alongside their engineers. * Facilitate pre, and post\-sales activities when needed, including technical deep dives, proofs of concept, “bake\-offs,” internal sprints and hackathons, and development of partner vertical\-specific solutions to drive adoption of Red Hat Lightwell. * Identify and partner with customer stakeholders, acting as an advocate within both their line\-of\-business and internal customer teams. * Advise on integration with the customer's existing artifact management, mirroring, and pipeline estate, including disconnected and air\-gapped environments. * Work closely with the Lightwell business unit and engineering teams, providing a market feedback loop on the product and solutions. * Execute community outreach and customer advocacy activities including conference speaking, blog posts, etc. * Deliver enablement and mentoring to the Red Hat Technical Sales community to raise baseline capability on software supply chain security. **What you will bring:** * 6\+ years in a combination of software engineering, build/release engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, or technical sales, including direct responsibility for software that carried real dependency and upgrade obligations. Telco experience needed. * Demonstrated ability to work hands\-on in a customer or production build environment. **Application development and build systems** * Working command of at least two of Maven, pip, and npm, including dependency resolution, transitive dependency behavior, lockfiles, and version constraint semantics. * Practical understanding of how enterprise builds are configured, where registry and repository settings are applied, and how enterprises currently proxy and mirror public package registries. * Hands\-on experience with enterprise artifact repositories and internal mirrors. * Ability to work directly in a customer's build environment, configuring, executing, and troubleshooting builds alongside their engineers. * Understanding of build reproducibility, disconnected and air\-gapped delivery, and multi\-language codebases. **Software supply chai ompliance regimes relevant to the geography's key accounts, and with control automation as the durable answer to audit obligation. The salary range for this position is $197,860\.00 \- $316,600\.00 (inclusive of base pay \+ target incentive compensation). Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. **Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)** Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Product Manager **Technology \| Business Purpose Lending** **Position Summary** ==================== The Product Manager translates business priorities into a clear, actionable product backlog for Redwood Trust's Business Purpose Lending technology portfolio. The role owns product requirements from discovery through release, aligns business and technology teams on intended outcomes, and confirms that delivered capabilities solve the underlying business need. This position works closely with lending operations, originations, underwriting, closing, asset management, capital markets, accounting, technology, data, quality assurance, and external delivery partners. The Product Manager is accountable for backlog quality, priority decisions, acceptance criteria, stakeholder readiness, and product adoption across platforms that may include Salesforce, enterprise data services, integrations, document generation, pricing, portals, and finance systems. **Primary Responsibilities** ============================ * Own and maintain a prioritized product backlog that reflects business value, operational risk, regulatory requirements, dependencies, and available delivery capacity. * Lead discovery with business stakeholders to define the problem, affected users, current process, desired outcome, scope, assumptions, constraints, and measurable success criteria. * Write clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and supporting requirements that developers and quality assurance analysts can execute without avoidable rework. * Make day\-to\-day scope and priority decisions within the approved roadmap, and escalate decisions that affect funding, controls, policy, staffing, or committed delivery dates. * Partner with solution architects, developers, administrators, data engineers, integration teams, and vendors to evaluate options and confirm that proposed designs meet business and control requirements. * Plan releases with project and engineering leads by sequencing work, identifying dependencies, confirming readiness criteria, and communicating impacts to affected teams. * Review completed work throughout the sprint, answer questions promptly, accept or reject stories against agreed criteria, and prevent incomplete work from moving forward. * Coordinate business testing by identifying testers, preparing scenarios and expected results, tracking defects, collecting evidence, and obtaining documented approval before production release. * Monitor product performance after release using defects, adoption, cycle time, user feedback, data quality, control performance, and other relevant measures; convert findings into backlog decisions. * Maintain product documentation, decision history, release notes, process changes, training needs, and traceability from business request through deployed outcome. * Support incident and production issue triage by clarifying business impact, helping establish priority, validating corrective action, and communicating status to stakeholders. * Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, stakeholder reviews, and other product forums with clear decisions, owners, and follow\-up actions. * Manage vendor\-delivered product work by confirming requirements, reviewing deliverables, tracking commitments, and escalating performance or dependency concerns. * Promote consistent product and delivery standards across teams, including clear definitions of ready and done, practical acceptance criteria, and disciplined change control. Page Break**Product Ownership Expectations** ================================== **Accountability** **Expected Practice** **Business value** Connect each priority to a defined business, customer, risk, compliance, or operational outcome. **Backlog readiness** Keep near\-term work sufficiently refined, estimated, sequenced, and supported by testable acceptance criteria. **Decision speed** Resolve routine product questions quickly and bring material tradeoffs to the correct decision\-makers with a recommendation. **Delivery quality** Confirm that releases meet agreed requirements, controls, data standards, and user needs before acceptance. **Transparency** Provide concise reporting on scope, progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected delivery dates. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. * Five or more years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, technology delivery, or a closely related role. * Demonstrated experience owning a backlog and translating business processes into clear, testable requirements and acceptance criteria. * Experience working with Agile delivery teams through discovery, refinement, development, testing, release, and post\-production support. * Strong facilitation and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues, document decisions, and align stakeholders w uct documentation in a regulated environment. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with mortgage banking, business purpose lending, specialty finance, financial services, or another regulated industry. * Hands\-on experience with Salesforce or another enterprise CRM platform, including workflows, permissions, integrations, reporting, and release processes. * Experience with Jira and Confluence, product roadmaps, API\-enabled products, data platforms, document generation, pricing engines, portals, or finance\-system integrations. * Product Owner, Scrum, Agile, Salesforce, or business analysis certification. * Experience coordinating internal teams and third\-party implementation partners across multiple locations and time zones. **Core Competencies** ===================== **Competency** **What It Looks Like** **Product judgment** Balances business value, user impact, risk, effort, and technical constraints when setting priorities. **Ownership** Takes responsibility for decisions, follow\-through, and the quality of information provided to the delivery team. **Communication** Writes clearly, facilitates productive discussions, and adapts detail to business, technical, and executive audiences. **Collaboration** Builds effective working relationships across functions while preserving clear accountability for decisions. **Analytical thinking** Uses process evidence, data, defects, and user feedback to define problems and assess outcomes. **Control awareness** Incorporates security, privacy, audit, compliance, and separation\-of\-duties requirements into product work. **About Redwood Trust** ======================= Redwood Trust is a specialty financial services firm focused on housing credit. Through its operating platforms, including CoreVest, Redwood provides liquidity to segments of the U.S. housing market and supports its mission to make quality housing, whether rented or owned, accessible to American households. ***A reasonable estimate of the base compensation range for this role is $130,000\-$150,000\. The actual salary offer to the successful candidate will be based on job\-related education, geographic location, training, licensure and certification, and other factors. Redwood also offers a competitive benefit package including discretionary corporate bonus program, multiple health plans, STD and LTD options, company sponsored life insurance, fitness reimbursement, paid parental leave, time to volunteer, Paid Time off, ESPP, and 401K matching.*** ***At Redwood Trust, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued, and everyone has the opportunity thrive. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.***

With this goal in mind, we develop scalable tools, processes, hardware, and software solutions deployed for characterization, validation, and manufacturing. In this role, you will be a key individual contributor driving both design review and hardware characterization for vehicle electronics, with a particular focus onInfotainment \& Connectivity (InfoConn) ECUs. You are not just assessing finished boards—you will actively review schematics alongside the EE design team early in the cycle, providing critical feedback to optimize the design and architect best\-in\-class verification methods. These ECUs are defined by SoC\-class silicon, dense multi\-rail power delivery, high\-speed serial interfaces, and integrated wireless radios, so characterizing them means working across power integrity, signal integrity, RF performance, and thermal behavior on the same board. You'll work cross functionally to ensure that our electronics are designed to meet module\-level requirements. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Develop detailed design verification and characterization test plans and test requirements for all phases of ECU programs, with input from reliability, design, RF, and firmware teams. * Execute characterization testing plans according to project milestones. * Own test coverage reports and analysis. * Perform bench\-level characterization at IC and PCBA levels, including multi\-rail power sequencing and PMIC behavior, rail transient response and ripple, load step response, inrush, power\-state transitions (sleep/suspend/wake), quiescent and standby current, brownout and power\-interrupt thresholds, and thermal throttling behavior. * Characterize high\-speed interfaces at the ECU connector: camera and display serdes links (GMSL, FPD\-Link), USB, PCIe, Automotive Ethernet (100BASE\-T1/1000BASE\-T1/multi\-gig), and debug interfaces — including eye diagrams, jitter, BER, link margin, and link training behavior over voltage and temperature. * Characterize the conducted RF performance of integrated radios — Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, cellular (LTE/5G), UWB, NFC, and GNSS — covering TX power and spectral quality, RX sensitivity, spurious emissions, and desense/coexistence between radios and against on\-board digital and switching noise sources. * Lead the power integrity and coexistence/desense characterization efforts for InfoConn ECUs, including correlation of measured behavior back to design intent and layout. * Characterize protection and fault behavior: over\-voltage and under\-voltage, reverse polarity, load dump, interface short and disconnect conditions, storage and memory stress, and verification that the ECU reports the correct diagnostics and recovers as designed. * Provide early feedback to design engineers regarding design decisions, testability, test point access, and instrumentation hooks needed for characterization. * Support creation and present Design for Testability (DFT) reports for ECU designs. * Follow characterization schedules and communicate status with upper management and cross\-functional teams. * Write automation scripts and instrumentation drivers to speed up characterization testing using Python, using AI coding agents to accelerate development while owning code jobs.description: **Job Summary** =============== The Automation Engineer is responsible for supporting the setup, transfer, optimization, and maintenance of automation and non\-automation equipment used in manufacturing operations. The Automation Engineer plays a key role in improving equipment efficiency, supporting equipment validation, and providing technical training to manufacturing teams. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Support equipment transfers and ensure smooth equipment operation prior to trial production. * Collaborate with internal departments and external suppliers to review design plans for new automation equipment, ensuring feasibility, compatibility, and proper documentation for materials and layouts. * Evaluate, verify, and accept new automation equipment, assessing safety, operability, stability, and maintainability. * Compile and organize operating and maintenance manuals for new equipment and maintain internal records for preventive maintenance schedules. * Analyze equipment issues and implement corrective solutions to ensure stable production operations. * Provide technical support for complex equipment issues beyond the resolution capability of production teams. * Facilitate training for manufacturing engineering (ME) staff on equipment operation, maintenance, and repair, and monitor training effectiveness. * Assist with troubleshooting and optimization of non\-automation equipment, including signal transmission issues and PLC programming adjustments. * Collaborate with Process/Industrial Engineering (PIE) teams to improve **UPH (Units Per Hour)** and enhance equipment efficiency. * Conduct audits related to equipment project standards, focusing on completion rates, compliance, and quality requirements. * Support training initiatives for technicians, operators, and quality personnel on **Total Productive Maintenance (TPM)** principles to reduce equipment downtime. * Adapt work responsibilities as needed based on production requirements, equipment changes, and workload distribution. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor’s degree in **Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field**. * Minimum **3 years of experience in equipment engineering or automation management within a manufacturing environment**. * Strong troubleshooting skills manage multiple projects and maintain documentation. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience using **CAD or equipment layout design software**. * Familiarity with **quality standards and safety regulations in manufacturing environments**. * Experience working in **electronics manufacturing or high\-volume production environments**. **Key Competencies** engineering, production, and supplier teams. * Strong communication and training skills. * Continuous improvement mindset. **Work Environment and Physical Requirements** jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Software Engineer** ===================== **Department:** Product Development \& Data Frontiers **Location:** Tallmadge, OH / Hybrid Remote Eligible **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Classification:** Exempt **Build Technology That Makes a Difference** -------------------------------------------- At **SDMyers**, technology is more than code — it is a tool for helping customers make better decisions about their electrical equipment and power systems. As a **Software Engineer**, you’ll help build and improve the software systems behind SDMyers’ digital strategy. You’ll work across customer\-facing platforms, internal applications, field tools, data systems, APIs, integrations, and emerging AI\-enabled workflows. This is a great opportunity for a software engineer who enjoys **variety, problem\-solving, ownership, and seeing their work turn into real products and solutions.** You’ll work closely with Product Development, Data, IT, analysts, field services, operations, and customer\-facing teams to turn ideas into reliable, maintainable, and scalable technology. **About SDMyers** ----------------- SDMyers is a Good Place company focused on earning the **undying loyalty of electric power system owners** by providing safe, practical solutions that help build reliable, low\-cost electric systems. Our Product Development team transforms ideas into **extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences.** We believe every employee plays an important role in advancing our purpose, vision, and values. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ ### **Software Development** * Build, improve, and maintain software for customer\-facing platforms, field applications, digital products, and internal business applications. * Develop across the full technology stack, including backend services, frontend interfaces, databases, APIs, integrations, and automation workflows. * Translate product strategies and business requirements into technical plans, development tasks, and working software. * Design and develop reliable, maintainable, and scalable applications. ### **APIs, Data \& Integrations** * Develop and maintain APIs, application services, data pipelines, and system integrations supporting mySDMyers, field applications, internal systems, and customer data\-delivery capabilities. * Build integrations between SDMyers systems, third\-party services, Microsoft ecosystem tools, operational databases, and customer\-facing data channels. * Work with relational databases and data structures to ensure information moves reliably between systems. * Help identify data dependencies, data\-quality issues, system boundaries, and source\-of\-truth considerations. ### **Architecture \& Technical Infrastructure** * Help steward SDMyers’ digital infrastructure alongside software vendors, IT partners, and internal technical teams. * Help identify and prioritize technical debt, system improvements, platform decisions, and long\-term technology needs. * Evaluate technical solutions while balancing customer needs, commercial considerations, security, maintainability, and scalability. * Help understand and manage the system\-wide impact of software changes across applications, databases, field tools, reports, analytics, and customer platforms. ### **Development Practices** * Help establish and improve developer tooling, documentation, templates, testing practices, release processes, and CI/CD workflows. * Participate in code reviews and collaborate with technical partners on architecture, debugging, data structures, system dependencies, and technical planning. * Troubleshoot complex software issues and perform root\-cause analysis. * Continuously learn and evaluate new technologies that can improve SDMyers’ digital capabilities. ### **AI \& Emerging Technology** * Contribute to AI\-enabled workflows and digital products where they provide meaningful value. * Help ensure software, data, and AI functionality are developed responsibly and align with SDMyers’ values, customer trust, security, and responsible\-use principles. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Required** **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field. **Software Engineering** * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including: + Clean and maintainable code + Software architecture + Testing + Debugging + Version control + Secure development practices * Working knowledge of backend application development. * Experience with RESTful API design, authentication/authorization, middleware, asynchronous processing, and service integration. * Experience with modern frontend development, including component\-based interfaces, state management, forms, validation, accessibility, and responsive design. * Strong understanding of relational database design, schema modeling, queries, migrations, constraints, indexing, and performance. **Technology** Experience or familiarity with technologies such as: * TypeScript * JavaScript * SQL * Node.js * React * Angular * Python * Django, Flask, or FastAPI *Our technology stack will continue to evolve as SDMyers’ product architecture develops, so we value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies.* **Experience** * 3–7 years of professional software development experience preferred. * Experience building, deploying, and maintaining production software. * Experience working across backend, frontend, database, and integration technologies. * Experience supporting software throughout its lifecycle, from development through deployment and maintenance. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with APIs, ETL/ELT, event\-driven systems, file\-based data exchange, or third\-party system connectors. * Experience with cloud or hybrid environments. * Familiarity with Microsoft and Azure technologies, including: + Azure + Azure ML + Power BI + SQL Server / SSMS + GitHub + Visual Studio * Experience working with real\-world operational data systems. * Experience integrating multiple business applications or third\-party platforms. **The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here** ------------------------------------------- We’re looking for someone who: * Takes ownership and follows problems through to a solution. * Is naturally curious and enjoys learning. * Can work independently while also collaborating with a variety of teams. * Is comfortable working through ambiguity and figuring things out. * Thinks beyond individual pieces of code and understands how systems work together. * Communicates technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical partners. * Cares about building software that is useful, reliable, secure, and maintainable. * Wants to see their work have a real impact on customers and the organization. * Believes technology should support SDMyers’ purpose, values, customer trust, and long\-term goals. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- Your work will directly contribute to SDMyers’ digital transformation. You’ll have the opportunity to work on **customer\-facing products, internal applications, data systems, APIs, integrations, field technology, and emerging AI capabilities** rather than being limited to one small area of development. You’ll help shape how SDMyers builds software and uses technology to create better experiences and better outcomes for customers. **Work Environment** -------------------- * Professional office environment. * Hybrid Remote work eligible. * Regular use of computers, phones, video conferencing, and collaboration software. * Primarily sedentary office work. * Regular communication through speaking and listening. * **No travel requirements for this position.** **Join SDMyers** ---------------- If you’re a software engineer who enjoys solving real\-world problems, working across different technologies, and building products that people actually use, we’d like to hear from you. **Come help us turn ideas into extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences.**

jobs.title: Industry Principal
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ **Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.** **Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. This is a senior practitioner role for industry experts with deep operational experience who are capable of engaging C\-suite buyers and driving end\-to\-end commercial cycles. You lead executive discovery, scope and price engagements, and secure customer commitment.
