Communicates effectively across all organizational levels, leading presentations, discussions, negotiations, and strategic engagements. * Strategic \& Commercial Acumen: Aligns technology solutions with customer objectives and business priorities while applying strong business and financial insight to evaluate opportunities, pricing strategies, and growth potential. * Customer Focus \& Relationship Building: Develops trusted partnerships with customers, executives, partners, and internal stakeholders. Anticipates customer needs, delivers business value, and drives long\-term customer satisfaction and growth. * Collaboration \& Leadership: Leads strategic initiatives, influences stakeholders without direct authority, mentors team members, and partners effectively across cross\-functional teams to achieve shared objectives. * Analytical Thinking \& Problem Solving: Evaluates complex business and technical challenges, identifies key insights, and develops actionable recommendations that support customer and organizational goals. * Process Improvement \& Execution: Creates scalable processes, frameworks, and best practices while effectively managing priorities, driving initiatives, and delivering high\-quality results. * Adaptability \& Results Orientation: Thrives in changing business environments, embraces innovation, and consistently delivers measurable outcomes aligned to business, customer, and revenue objectives. **Skill Level Requirements:** * Industry \& Business Expertise: Deep knowledge of assigned industry verticals (e.g., Healthcare, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance), including business operations, market trends, competitive landscapes, regulatory considerations, and customer priorities. Applies this expertise to strategic recommendations and solution development. \- Expert * Consultative Sales, Executive Engagement \& Commercial Acumen: Engages executive stakeholders, understands complex business challenges, develops tailored solutions, evaluates opportunities, influences buying decisions, and leads engagements from qualification through contract execution. \- Expert * Engagement \& Project Leadership: Leads complex customer engagements, coordinates cross\-functional teams, manages resources, and ensures successful delivery aligned with business objectives and customer outcomes. \- Expert * Technical Business Literacy: Understands systems integration, data flows, platform capabilities, solution architectures, and technology\-enabled business transformation initiatives. Programming or software development experience is not required. \- Expert * Data Privacy \& Governance: Ensures the secure handling of sensitive customer and business information while maintaining compliance with applicable privacy, security, and governance requirements. \- Expert **Other Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s or equivalent advanced degree preferred * Experience in one of the target verticals (Healthcare, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or Finance) * Demonstrated experience building or delivering AI/agentic solutions * Willingness to travel 30–40% during active engagements, decreasing to 20% between engagements * Commitment to completing Palantir platform immersion and Ontologize Certification within the first 90 days The estimated annual pay range for this position is $200,000 \- $300,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Technician
jobs.description: Standex International is a global industrial growth company operating through our market\-leading brands in electronics, cutting\-edge forming technologies, engraving, and scientific refrigeration. We work with our customers to advance progress through innovation. From inventing and producing parts for next\-generation space vehicles to evolving vaccine refrigeration, designing functional textures for everyday products, improving renewable energy technology, and much more, we are focused on making what’s next possible. The Manufacturing Engineering Technician supports engineering and production operations by troubleshooting equipment, maintaining test systems, executing special projects, and providing technical documentation. This role ensures manufacturing processes run safely, efficiently, and consistently while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. What You’ll Do * Perform production machine troubleshooting, repairs, and preventative maintenance to minimize downtime. * Troubleshoot and maintain test systems, fixtures, and automated testing equipment. * Perform soldering tasks and follow industry standard soldering practices; maintain solder certification and assist in training others. * Support manufacturing engineers with process improvement activities, equipment validations, and production trials. * Assist with special projects involving new equipment, process upgrades, automation, and prototype builds. * Produce clear, accurate technical documentation, including work instructions, test procedures, and engineering reports. * Collaborate with engineers and production teams to solve daily operational issues. * Collect production and test data to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities. * Adhere to safety policies, quality standards, and manufacturing best practices. * Participate in 5S, lean manufacturing, and continuous improvement initiatives. What You’ll Bring * Associate degree in robotics, electronics, manufacturing technology, or related technical field preferred. * Industry solder certification or willingness to obtain certification. * Hands\-on experience with troubleshooting production machinery, automation systems, or test equipment. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documents. * Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude with problem solving skills. * Experience with technical writing or documentation creation. * Proficiency with basic measurement tools, diagnostic equipment, and standard office software. * Ability to work both independently and in cross\-functional teams. Physical Requirements * Ability to stand, walk, and work on manufacturing floors for extended periods. * Lift up to 40 lbs as needed. * Use PPE as required. Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Operations
jobs.description: **Manager, Product Operations** **SaiSystems Health \| Product Organization \| Reports to CPO** **What You'll Do** * Own the strategy, roadmap, and continuous improvement of the tools and workflows that power the Product team's experience — including Aha!, Confluence, and Pendo — and partner with Engineering on how those tools connect to Jira and release infrastructure. * Build and manage the product analytics stack, ensuring Product Managers have reliable access to usage data, feature adoption metrics, and customer behavior insights through Pendo and related tools. * Develop and run enablement programs for the Product team — onboarding new PMs, rolling out new tools and methodologies, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. * Define and track product\-team operational health metrics (process adoption, time\-to\-insight, PM ramp time, roadmap\-to\-delivery traceability) and use them to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities. * Partner with Engineering leadership and the Release Manager on delivery standards, tooling investments, and how release readiness and cadence decisions surface to the Product team. * Evaluate and recommend new tools, integrations, and AI\-assisted workflows that increase Product team productivity and decision\-making quality. * Directly manage the APM team — providing coaching, performance feedback, and career development support, and coordinating their work to drive consistency across product delivery. **What You Bring** * 3\-5 years of experience in product operations, product management, program management, or a related role in a software or healthcare IT organization. * Working knowledge of Jira from a Product Manager's/reporting perspective (boards, filters, dashboards); deep administrative configuration is not required. * Experience with product analytics platforms (Pendo, Amplitude, or similar) and a strong understanding of how to interpret usage data. * Proven ability to design and implement scalable processes that work across multiple product lines. * Strong communication and facilitation skills — able to drive alignment across PMs, engineers, and leadership. * Comfort with AI\-assisted tooling and a forward\-looking perspective on how AI can improve product team workflows. * Experience in healthcare IT is a plus but not required. **How You Lead** * You are a systems thinker who sees the connections between tools, processes, and team performance. * You lead by making others more effective — your success is measured by how well the Product team operates. * You are data\-driven and operationally rigorous, but you balance process with pragmatism. * You are a builder, not just a maintainer — you proactively design new workflows and systems rather than waiting for requests. * You mentor and develop your team, treating operational excellence as a craft worth investing in. **Why This Role Matters** Product Operations ensures every PM and designer at SaiSystems Health has the tools, data, and processes they need to do their best work, and that the Product team's practices scale as the organization grows.

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering - Cloud Atlas
jobs.description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category Software Engineering Job Details **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. jobs.description: **Job title:** Head of Agentic Biology * **Location:** Cambridge, MA **About the job** The Computational and AI Strategy – R\&D (CompAI) is a new function within Sanofi that brings together a multidisciplinary team of "bilinguals" — scientists and engineers with deep domain expertise and AI skills — across verticals including computational biology, molecular design, molecular engineering, safety, and manufacturing. CompAI is at the forefront of Sanofi's ambition to become the most AI\-powered biopharma in the world, embedding cutting\-edge computational capabilities directly into the heart of drug discovery and development. We are seeking a visionary, highly collaborative, and deeply technical leader to step into the role of **Head of Agentic Biology** within the Computational Biology group at CompAI. In an era where biology is rapidly becoming an information science, this forward\-thinking role is designed to transform early discovery research using an AI\-first mindset. Moving beyond traditional, reactive data analysis, the Head of Agentic Biology will collaboratively build an enterprise\-scale computational ecosystem that accelerates end\-to\-end therapeutic area (TA) programs using an agentic approach. By closing the loop between automated wet\-lab data capture and cutting\-edge predictive modeling — including statistical methods, classical ML, language technologies, biological foundation models, and emerging agentic AI capabilities — this role will provide quantifiable insights that empower critical go/no\-go portfolio decisions. A primary goal is advancing the discovery of novel targets with a high degree of success and extendable therapeutic opportunities, based on the analysis of large volumes of multi\-modal disease data — including genetics, genomics, cellular, clinical, and pathological data — in close collaboration with Sanofi's therapeutic areas: immunology and inflammation, oncology, neuroscience, rare diseases, and ophthalmology, and in integration with CompAI verticals. Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI\-powered research. In R\&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions. **About Sanofi** We’re an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. **Main Responsibilities:** **Acceleration of Discovery using Agentic Biology** * Lead the design and deployment of first\-generation agentic bioinformatics workflows that automate end\-to\-end data capture, analysis, and insight generation across therapeutic programs. * Drive the transition from reactive data analysis to proactive, predictive, and autonomous biological reasoning systems. * Advance novel target discovery using multi\-modal disease data including genetics, genomics, single\-cell, proteomics, imaging, and clinical datasets. **Leadership \& Portfolio Impact** * Serve as a leader in bioinformatics, providing strategic direction aligned with Sanofi's R\&D priorities across immunology, inflammation, oncology, neuroscience, rare diseases, and ophthalmology leveraging agentic technologies. * Deliver quantifiable computational insights that directly inform go/no\-go portfolio decisions and accelerate target validation. * Translate computational discoveries into experimental target validation strategies with a focus on target biology, drug repurposing, and indication expansion. * jobs.description: **Department: Engineering** **Reports To: Senior Electrical Design Engineer** **Employment Type: Full\-Time** **Location: Summerville, SC** **Industry: Marine / Boat Manufacturing** **Position Summary** We are seeking an Entry\-Level Electrical Design Engineer to join our engineering team and support the design, documentation, testing, and production of electrical systems for boats. Working under the direction of the Senior Electrical Design Engineer, this position will provide an opportunity to develop practical experience in marine electrical system design, wiring harness development, electrical documentation, component selection, and production support. The ideal candidate is an organized, detail\-oriented engineer who enjoys solving problems, learning how products are built, and working closely with both engineering and manufacturing teams. The successful candidate will develop their technical skills while contributing to the design and improvement of production boats. **Key Responsibilities** **Electrical Design \& Engineering Support** * Assist the Senior Electrical Design Engineer with the development of electrical systems for new and existing boat models. * Create and update electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, harness drawings, and related documentation under engineering direction. * Assist with electrical system layouts, wire routing, component locations, and electrical architecture. * Perform basic electrical calculations, including wire sizing, voltage drop, circuit loading, and circuit protection. * Assist with the selection and specification of electrical components. * Develop and maintain electrical bills of materials, wire lists, component lists, and other engineering documentation. * Assist with engineering changes and updates to existing boat models. * Assist in design of different enclosures for electrical components. * Participate in design reviews and engineering meetings. * Maintain accurate revision control of electrical drawings and documentation. **Standards \& Compliance** * Learn and apply applicable marine electrical standards and company engineering requirements. * Develop familiarity with ABYC, USCG, NMMA, and other applicable standards. * Assist in reviewing designs for compliance under the direction of the Senior Electrical Design Engineer. * Maintain awareness of electrical safety requirements and company design practices. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a related field. Industry experience can be considered in place of degree. * 0–2 years of professional engineering experience; recent graduates are encouraged to apply. * Basic understanding of electrical circuits and DC electrical systems. * Ability to read and understand electrical schematics. * Basic understanding of wire sizing, voltage drop, circuit protection, and electrical loads. * Familiarity with CAD software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, SolidWorks Electrical, EPLAN, or similar. * Strong computer skills and willingness to learn engineering software and company systems. * Strong attention to detail. * Good organizational and documentation skills. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, production personnel, and other departments. * Willingness to learn and work in a hands\-on manufacturing environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * The following are helpful but not required: * Internship or co\-op experience in electrical engineering or manufacturing. * Exposure to marine, automotive, recreational vehicle, aerospace, powersports, or other vehicle electrical systems. * Familiarity with electrical connectors, terminals, wire harnesses, and circuit protection. * Basic knowledge of NMEA 2000 marine network. * Experience using a multimeter or other electrical test equipment. * Hands\-on experience building or troubleshooting electrical systems. * Personal or academic projects involving electrical systems, controls, robotics, vehicles, boats, or similar products. **Relationship with Senior Electrical Design Engineer** * The Senior Electrical Design Engineer will provide technical direction, mentoring, design review, and approval for the Electrical Design Engineer I. * The Electrical Design Engineer I will be expected to: * Seek guidance when encountering unfamiliar or complex electrical design issues. * Prepare preliminary designs and documentation for review. * Incorporate feedback from design reviews. * Learn and follow established company electrical design standards. * Gradually assume responsibility for increasingly complex engineering tasks. * Develop the knowledge and judgment necessary to eventually manage electrical design projects with greater independence. * This structure provides the opportunity for the engineer to gain hands\-on experience while maintaining appropriate technical oversight for production boat electrical systems.

jobs.description: **Pioneering in America, from the first mile to the last. This is what drives us.** *We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® certified—a reflection of our commitment to creating an environment where innovation thrives, and every voice matters. Apply today and be part of shaping the future with us!* **Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here:** **https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html** **Position Overview:** Our continued growth has created an exciting opportunity for a Production Supervisor at our manufacturing facility. In this pivotal role, you’ll make a significant impact on our high\-performing production organization by leading and mentoring a talented, diverse team of assemblers. We’re looking for someone who thrives on the production floor—someone who leads by example, inspires collaboration, and fosters an environment where every team member can succeed. If you’re passionate about driving results, building strong teams, and creating a culture of excellence, this is the role for you! **What you will be doing:** * Plan production operations, define workflows, establish priorities, and sequence production activities to meet project objectives and interdepartmental requirements while achieving safety, quality, schedule, and labor\-hour targets. * Establish, monitor, and adjust manpower, including hiring and promotions, as well as equipment planning and work\-order sequencing to meet evolving production demands. * Foster open and consistent communication across the team regarding work status, department performance, process improvements, company policies, and operational expectations. * Lead employee development through performance management, including bi\-annual reviews, training plans, coaching, and ongoing development of manufacturing personnel. * Drive production readiness and continuous improvement by ensuring vehicles are prepared for internal and external inspections, minimizing defects through root cause elimination, and maintaining readiness for on\-time vehicle shipment. **This posting outlines the primary responsibilities of the role, but is not all\-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned in alignment with business needs.** **What you will need to be successful:** * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Manufacturing, or Engineering or a combination of experience and education. * 5\+ years of experience in planning and launching new production lines in low\-speed environments such as rail, aviation/aerospace, naval, and heavy equipment. * We would be impressed if you have proven experience in the rail industry, with a focus on light or heavy rail production. * Proficient in SAP or similar MRP/ERP systems. * Possession of relevant certifications such as Six Sigma Black Belt, Lean Certification, OSHA Safety, Certified Manufacturing Engineer, Supply Management, EIT, or Professional Engineering License. * Hands\-on experience in customer service, maintenance, or aftermarket businesses within the rail industry. * Expertise in lean methods and tools, including 5S, 7 Types of Waste, root cause analysis, Yamazumi Methods, Kanban, Value Stream Mapping, ABC\-XYZ Analysis, and Lean Shop Floor Management. * Experience in developing technology roadmaps for automation. jobs.title: Protection & Automation Electrical Engineering Internship (Spring 2027)
jobs.description: Here at **Siemens**, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? **Transform the everyday with us!** **Siemens Smart Infrastructure** is looking for interns for our **Electrification and Automation division** to support our portfolio of protection and automation products and solutions. A variety of opportunities are available across the business supporting project design tasks, operations, product development, special projects and process improvements. **We are seeking qualified candidates for our Protection \& Automation Engineering Internship beginning in January 2027\. This position is based at our Denver, Colorado office location.** **What you'll do:*** Rotate through PPA teams (typically each summer, fall, and spring) such as Solutions Engineering, Solutions Offers, and Global Customer Care (GCC), with exposure to other departments across PPA. Learn each team’s day\-to\-day role while gaining a deeper understanding of the full project lifecycle. * In Solutions Engineering, assist with configuring protective relays, RTUs, and HMIs, support system testing and troubleshooting, and gain practical experience with AC/DC schematics, wiring diagrams, communication diagrams, and logic diagrams. * In Solutions Offers, learn how technical scope is translated into engineering hours, costs, and customer proposals. In Global Customer Care (GCC), see how projects are supported after delivery, including warranty, issue resolution, and customer case management. * **Throughout the program, you’ll gain exposure to both:*** Protection – designing and implementing relay\-based systems that safeguard transformers, motors, and substations. * Automation – configuring RTUs, HMIs, relays, and communication networks to ensure smooth operation and reliable data exchange. Successful interns may transition into the full\-time Protection \& Automation Engineering Development Program (PA EDP), where they can later specialize in either Protection or Automation. **You’ll make an impact by:*** Assisting with and completing development work on protection and automation projects to improve engineering productivity. * Learning how to configure and test Siemens' comprehensive energy automation systems, including Remote Terminal Units (RTU's), protection relays, and Human Machine Interfaces (HMIs). * Supporting engineering design process by working with AC/DC schematic drawings, single line drawings, logic diagrams, signal lists, and communication network diagrams. * Using digital twin technology to simulate and test protection relay signals in a digital environment. * Contributing to exciting projects, such as Microgrids and renewable technologies including photovoltaic panels and battery storage systems. * Gaining practical experience in testing Automation panels, conducting Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) with customers, and working in the Power \& Automation laboratory. * Gaining hands\-on experience with Siemens electrical equipment, including switchgears, motor control centers, breakers, transformers, and more, through direct exposure wand practical application. Based on your progress and learning path, you may also have an opportunity to accompany senior engineers to customer sites for on\-site, real\-world experiences. * **You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:*** Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related field. * Ability to work part\-time (up to 29 hours per week) for the duration of the spring semester. On\-site requirement will vary based on team placement, as will expected working hours. * Eligible candidates must be located within 50 miles of Denver, CO, as this role does not provide relocation support. * Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship. * This internship is a structured experiential learning program for individuals currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program who will continue their studies following the assignment. Current and continuing enrollment is a condition of participation. Applicants who have completed or expect to complete their educational program before or during the assignment period are encouraged to explore our Early Career Development Program opportunities. As part of the application, you will be asked to confirm your enrollment status. If your application includes uploaded documents (resume, transcript, or other materials), you may redact any information identifying your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. Redacting this information will not affect your candidacy. **About Siemens:** We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource\-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here. **Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:** We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. \#URDP \#SIEA $25\.00 $25\.50

jobs.title: Systems Engineer II
jobs.description: **Sierra Space Careers:** ========================= At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth. Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond. Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission\-ready throughout space. We are mission\-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team. **About the Role** ================== The Systems Engineer II contributes to the development and implementation of advanced system solutions by providing alignment, connection and direction to the technical team throughout the product development lifecycle. The Systems Engineer II represents the viewpoint of the integrated whole during system development and works to glue segments and subsystems together via top\-down decomposition of stakeholder requirements, traceability through development artifacts, and bottom\-up validation and verification of the system. They help to shepherd the team through technical development milestones, track performance measures and identify technical risks to arrive at a compliant and cohesive system solution. The Systems Engineer II should have a firm grasp on Systems Engineering principles as they build expertise on specific systems engineering skills such as requirements management, system architecture development, concept of operation definition, system integration and system verification. In this role, you will specify, architect, and integrate complex system solutions while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to understand project requirements and objectives. You will derive, decompose, allocate, trace, and manage system requirements and architectures, as well as define and document system concepts of operation. Supporting development milestone reviews by creating artifacts and deliverables will be a key responsibility, alongside participating in system integration and verification activities to ensure system functionality and performance. You will identify and manage technical risks, develop mitigation strategies, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying areas for enhancement. Adhering to established engineering processes and standards will be essential, and you will communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders to ensure project alignment and successful execution.**About You** ============= Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space\-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission. We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. **Minimum Qualifications:** --------------------------- * Requires Bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree). * Typically 2\+ years of related experience. * Practical understanding of Systems Engineering principles and practices, including a basic understanding of the systems development lifecycle. * Conceptual knowledge of requirements management, functional requirements parsing, derivation, and allocation. * Conceptual knowledge of systems architecture, systems integration, and Verification and Validation (V\&V) principles. * Clear verbal and written communication of technical concepts and information. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related field. * Experience with Requirements Management and Model Based Systems Engineering tools and frameworks, such as DOORS, CAMEO EA, Rhapsody, Matlab, and SysML. * Basic understanding of spacecraft systems, including hardware and software subsystems and components. * Familiarity with project management methodologies including risk management and technical performance tracking. * Familiarity with technical baseline and configuration management. * Experience or certification in INCOSE standards. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Ability to adapt to a fast\-paced and dynamic work environment. * Participated in 2026 SS Intern Academy. **Compensation****:** --------------------- Pay Range: $94,090\.00 \- $129,394\.75 Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis and may vary based on job\-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness. **Elevate Your Career** ======================= At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations. We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more. Sierra Space is an industry\-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission\-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space\-based assets and enable space exploration. *Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is* *identified.* ***Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.*** Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us. ### **About Us** **About Sierra Space** ====================== Headquartered in Colorado, Sierra Space is a mission\-proven Defense Tech company delivering satellite platforms, critical subsystems, reusable spaceplanes, hypersonic technologies, propulsion systems, and infrastructure for the nation’s most critical missions. With more than three decades of heritage and a record of flight\-proven success in space, Sierra Space is trusted by U.S. National Security, Civil customers, and global allies. Our technologies safeguard our nation, sustain human exploration in space, and ensure the freedom of operations beyond Earth. Sierra Space is defining the new era of Space Defense, strengthening deterrence today and preserving freedom of action for generations to come.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low\-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting\-edge technology into the world’s most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over 16 countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in the smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at www.silabs.com. **Meet the Team** You’ll join Silicon Labs’ **RAIL team**, which develops the Radio Abstraction Interface Layer (RAIL)—the embedded software that enables developers to configure, control, and optimize wireless radios across Silicon Labs’ IoT products. The team works closely with radio, firmware, SDK, validation, and applications engineering teams to deliver reliable, high\-performance wireless capabilities for technologies such as Bluetooth Low Energy, proprietary wireless, and multiprotocol IoT solutions. **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain embedded software features for Silicon Labs wireless radio platforms. * Design, implement, test, and debug firmware in C/C\+\+ for resource\-constrained microcontrollers. * Support radio\-control capabilities, including transmit, receive, power management, timing, and diagnostic features. * Collaborate with hardware, radio design, SDK, validation, and applications teams to bring new wireless products and features to market. * Investigate software and hardware integration issues using debuggers, logic analyzers, and other lab tools. * Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, automated testing, and continuous improvement of development processes. **Skills You Need** **Minimum Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. * Strong interest in embedded software, wireless communications, and low\-level system development. * Academic or project experience in embedded software development using C or C\+\+. * Understanding of fundamental wireless communication concepts, including RF, modulation, packet\-based communication, or digital signal processing. * Familiarity with microcontrollers, embedded peripherals, interrupts, memory\-constrained systems, and real\-time software concepts. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and debugging skills. * Ability to use development and debugging tools such as JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or protocol analyzers. * Ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment and communicate technical concepts clearly. * Ability to learn complex technical systems, analyze issues, and turn requirements into well\-tested software. * Clear communication and a collaborative approach to solving engineering challenges. *The following skills will be considered a plus:* * Internship, co\-op, research, or project experience related to embedded firmware, wireless systems, or IoT devices. * Experience with bare\-metal embedded software development, including low\-level programming without an RTOS. * Exposure to Bluetooth Low Energy, Zigbee, Thread, Wi\-Fi, proprietary wireless protocols, or multiprotocol systems. * Experience with Python or other scripting languages for test automation, data analysis, or development tooling. * Knowledge of RTOS concepts, device drivers, bootloaders, power optimization, or embedded security. * Exposure to Git, CI/CD workflows, unit testing, and automated hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing. * Participation in engineering competitions, technical organizations, research publications, or relevant student leadership activities. **Benefits \& Perks** *You can look forward to the following benefits:* * Great medical (Choice of PPO or Consumer Driven Health Plan with HSA), dental and vision plans * Highly competitive salary * 401k plan with match and Roth plan option * Equity rewards (RSUs) * Life/AD\&D and disability coverage * Flexible spending accounts * Adoption assistance * Back\-Up childcare * Additional benefit options (Commuter benefits, Legal benefits, Pet insurance) * Flexible PTO schedule * 3 paid volunteer days per year * Tuition reimbursement * Free downtown parking * Onsite gym * Monthly wellness offerings * Free snacks * Monthly company updates with our CEO \#LI\-MA1 \#LI\-Hybrid The annualized base pay range for this role is expected to be between $78,750 \- $146,250 USD. Actual base pay could vary based on factors including but not limited to experience, geographic location where work will be performed and applicant’s skill set. The base pay is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include an annual cash bonus, equity package and a comprehensive benefits package.*Silicon Labs is an equal opportunity employer and values the diversity of our employees. Employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications and job\-related criteria without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Job title \- Principal Full Stack Engineer** Employment type \- Full\-time employee (FTE) Work location \- 100% remote Travel \- Minimal \- occasional team and conference travel Base salary band $125,000 \- $185,000 (Band B5\) Target start date Before the end of October 2026 **About Slater Certified®** Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. It delivers self\-paced training that prepares professionals for licensure and continuing education, built around G.A.I.L. (Generative Artificial Intelligence Learning) \- an interactive tutor that gives real\-time feedback, personalized explanations and adaptive support, so someone studying on demand still gets guidance. The flagship course is a 40\-hour Wastewater Class 3 Operator Training recognized by the Georgia Secretary of State, alongside a 24\-hour continuing education course and an industrial wastewater program. Organizations can run a customized version, Powered by Slater Certified®, against their own workforce. Slater Certified, LLC is the workforce development arm of Slater Infrastructure Group, LLC \- an Alpharetta, Georgia infrastructure services firm founded in 1997, working across operations and maintenance, construction engineering and inspection, and environmental services for public and private clients. Slater Certified launched in July 2025 and is licensed in Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia and Mississippi. The team is small and moves fast. Technology choices are modern and made by the people who have to live with them, so the distance between an idea and a decision is short, and the distance between a decision and shipping it is shorter. Work is remote and the schedule is flexible. Ownership sits with the person doing the work, and there is real room to shape how things get built rather than inheriting someone else's process. **Position summary** Slater Certified® runs a React front end and an Express back end on Vercel, with Firestore behind it and G.A.I.L., our generative AI tutor, at the center of the learning experience. The platform is live, it carries real learners against state\-approved curricula, and it is about to be asked to do considerably more than it was originally built for. This is a 100% hands\-on coding position. The person in this seat writes production code every day and builds the hardest parts of the platform personally. Architectural direction is set by the Chief Technology \& Business Officer; you are the senior engineering voice feeding into those decisions and the person who turns them into working software. It is a small team, so what you build reaches learners quickly and there is nowhere to hide. **What this role owns in the first 12 months** * Is shipping production code across the front end, API and data layer inside the first month, and keeps doing it for the life of the role. * Is the CTBO's working partner on architecture \- bringing options, trade\-offs and a recommendation rather than waiting to be told. * Sets the engineering standards that stick: testing, code review, what “done” means, and the release path from TEST to production. * Removes the top three scaling or reliability risks in the platform \- identified inside the first 60 days, closed by month twelve. * Raises the technical level of the team around them, measurably, in code review and in what others are able to ship unaided. * Is the person the CTBO can hand a hard technical problem to and not follow up on. **Key responsibilities** Hands\-on engineering \- 100% of this role * Write production code every day. This is not a role that stops coding, and it is not a step toward management. * Build the hardest parts of the platform personally. * Design and build the APIs and services the rest of the platform depends on. * Work across React, Express, Firestore and the Vercel deployment path. **Architecture and technical input** * Architectural direction is set by the CTBO. You are the senior engineering voice in those decisions. * Bring options, trade\-offs and a recommendation \- not just an implementation once the decision has been made. * Document how the platform actually fits together, and keep that picture current. * Weigh what ships this quarter against what the platform will need in two years. AI and the product * Build and extend the platform on top of G.A.I.L., our generative AI tutor. * Advise on where generative AI genuinely improves the learning product and where it does not. Engineering excellence * Set and hold coding standards, review practice and the definition of done. * Mentor engineers directly, in code review and in design. * Improve the release path so that deploying is routine rather than an event. * Support hiring \- interview, calibrate, and help build the team. Security, compliance and reliability * Build authentication and authorization correctly. * Build to FERPA expectations for learner data and to the standards our state approvals depend on. * Instrument the platform so failures surface before a learner reports them. **Must have** * 10\+ years building production software, several of them at principal, staff or equivalent technical\-lead level. * Has been accountable for the architecture of a production system, and lived with the consequences of those decisions. * Deep JavaScript and TypeScript, with real depth in React on the front end and Node / Express on the back end. * Production experience with a cloud\-hosted document database \- Firestore, MongoDB, DynamoDB or similar. * Has raised the technical level of a team through review, mentoring and standards, without formal authority to do it. * Has shipped production features built on generative AI APIs, with hands\-on experience using Claude. * Has been the most senior engineer in the room, and been right often enough that people stopped checking. * Wants a hands\-on coding role. This is not a route into engineering management. **Nice to have** * Experience with other generative AI APIs alongside Claude \- Gemini, OpenAI or similar. * Vercel, serverless or edge deployment experience. * EdTech, LMS, credentialing or regulated\-training background. * Infrastructure as code, and ownership of a CI/CD pipeline. * Accessibility standards (WCAG) applied in practice rather than in theory. **Compensation and benefits** Base salary band $125,000 \- $185,000, based on experience Variable compensation \- Eligible for participation in annual company bonus pool Health, dental, vision \- Employer provided / supplemented Retirement \- 401(k) \- up to 5% matched Paid time off \- Earned over time: generous and flexible policy **Work environment** **100% remote** Slater Certified® is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Engineering Associate
jobs.description: **Position Summary** Smartcon Solutions is seeking an Engineering Associate to join our growing engineering team in Glastonbury, CT. This is an entry\-level engineering position providing an opportunity to develop practical experience in applications engineering, building automation, energy management, and smart building technologies.The Engineering Associate will support the design, documentation, configuration, and implementation of technology solutions that integrate building systems such as HVAC, lighting, controls, monitoring, and IoT technologies. The ideal candidate is technically curious, organized, detail\-oriented, and interested in learning how engineering solutions are applied in real\-world commercial and hospitality environments.This position will work closely with experienced engineers, project managers, sales professionals, field personnel, contractors, and customers. Some travel to customer and project sites may be required. **Key Responsibilities** * Assist with the engineering and application of building automation, energy management, HVAC controls, lighting, and related smart\-building systems. * Support the development of system designs, schematics, control sequences, network diagrams, equipment selections, and other engineering documentation. * Assist with preparing bills of materials (BOMs), submittal packages, project documentation, and installation information. * Review project requirements, drawings, specifications, and other technical information to help develop appropriate solutions. * Assist with selecting and configuring controllers, sensors, gateways, relays, and other system components. * Support integration of building systems and technologies from multiple manufacturers. * Assist with system configuration, testing, troubleshooting, commissioning, and startup activities. * Work with project managers, sales engineers, field engineers, contractors, and other team members to help ensure projects meet design requirements and customer expectations. * Participate in customer and project meetings as appropriate and develop an understanding of customer needs and project requirements. * Assist with investigating technical issues and developing practical solutions under the guidance of experienced engineers. * Maintain accurate project documentation and communicate project status, issues, and technical information effectively. * Travel to customer and project locations as needed to support site surveys, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, or other project activities. * Develop knowledge of Smartcon's products, technologies, engineering processes, and industry standards. * Perform other engineering and project\-related duties as assigned. **QualificationsRequired** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field; Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, Automation, or similar disciplines preferred. * 0–2 years of engineering experience; new graduates are encouraged to apply. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills. * Ability to read and understand technical drawings, specifications, and documentation. * Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word. * Ability and willingness to work onsite in Glastonbury, CT on a full\-time basis. * Ability to travel to customer and project sites as needed. **Preferred / Helpful** * Internship, co\-op, academic, or project experience involving controls, automation, HVAC, electrical systems, building systems, IoT, or energy management. * Familiarity with electrical or controls drawings and basic engineering documentation. * Familiarity with building automation systems (BAS/BMS) or building controls. * Exposure to communication protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, or similar technologies. * Experience with CAD, electrical design, programming, PLCs, or controls software. * Familiarity with HVAC, lighting controls, networking, or other building technologies. * Interest in energy efficiency, sustainability, smart buildings, and connected technologies. **Skills \& Attributes**The successful candidate will be: * **Curious and eager to learn** – interested in developing technical expertise across multiple building technologies. * **Hands\-on and practical** – comfortable connecting engineering concepts to real\-world applications. * **Detail\-oriented** – takes ownership of accurate drawings, documentation, configurations, and project information. * **Collaborative** – works effectively with engineering, sales, project management, field personnel, contractors, and customers. * **Analytical** – able to break down technical problems and work toward practical solutions. * **Adaptable** – comfortable learning new technologies, manufacturers' products, and software platforms. * **Customer\-focused** – understands that engineering solutions must ultimately support the customer's operational and business objectives. **Work Environment** This is a full\-time, onsite position based in Smartcon's Glastonbury, Connecticut office. The role may require occasional travel to customer locations, construction sites, hotels, commercial properties, and other project locations.The position may involve a combination of office\-based engineering work and field\-based activities, including site surveys, system testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting.About Smartcon SolutionsSmartcon Solutions is a building technology and energy\-management systems integrator focused on creating smarter, more efficient buildings. The company works primarily with hospitality, multifamily, and commercial properties, integrating technologies such as HVAC controls, lighting, energy management, IoT, monitoring, and other building systems.Smartcon's approach spans the project lifecycle—from discovery and design through implementation, ongoing support, and optimization—with an emphasis on measurable energy savings, operational efficiency, sustainability, and improved building performance. Pay: $51,731\.49 \- $62,300\.29 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Join the fast\-paced manufacturing environment at the Algona Snap\-on Plant, solving problems and supporting all departments within the facility. Work with state\-of\-the\-art automation while enjoying a balance of computer/office work and hands\-on work. Be challenged working on cross functional teams to improve processes, or while working independently on projects to reduce cost of operations, increase capacity, and reduce waste. Make a lasting difference by contributing to both the short\-term \& long\-term facility plans. Responsibilities: * Troubleshooting: Daily support of all manufacturing departments to prevent/minimize equipment downtime * Analyze and specify new processes and equipment necessary to accommodate the manufacture of all new and existing products * Coordinate outside vendor contract work to ensure outcomes satisfy project goals and budget (supplement in\-house machine and process build efforts) * Provide financial justification and timelines for new project implementation * Lead travel groups of Snap\-on employees to observe other facilities and processes – also arrange off\-site meetings and equipment runoffs * Complete required safety signoffs \& ensure proper guarding on new equipment – also provide associate training for new equipment in regard to machine operation, maintenance, and safety * Ensure the continued effectiveness of existing assets through preventative maintenance programs and spare parts inventory (work in conjunction with maintenance department) * Work closely with Tool \& Die department to design and/or purchase tooling and fixtures used to generate production parts * Other duties as assigned by the Eng. Manager Qualifications: * Engineering degree (BSME preferred) * Proficient in computer applications: Microsoft Office, 2D AutoCAD, 3D modeling software (Catia and Autodesk Inventor preferred) * Proficient in verbal and written technical communications **PREFERENCES** * Manufacturing plant experience * Knowledge of basic sheet metal fabrication techniques and equipment * Experience with PLC’s (Programmable Logic Controllers), CNC equipment, powder paint, vision systems, welding, robotics, \& other automation * Desired characteristics: Integrity, problem solving skills, conscientious, innovative, independent thinker, team player, positive attitude, hard worker

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Developer
jobs.description: **Build Software That Matters—From a 400\-Acre Horse Ranch** **Senior Full\-Stack Software Developer \| AI\-First** **Gainesville, Texas** Full\-Time **Hybrid** Premium Housing Available Tired of corporate red tape, endless meetings, and jumping through hoops to get a good idea into production? Picture spending your on\-site workdays at a beautiful, 400\-acre ranch, working directly with an involved founder in the equine business. You can talk through an idea, see the operation it supports, and build something that makes someone’s day easier. If you’re looking for a change of pace and environment—with meaningful technical challenges and room to take ownership—this could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for. We’re hiring an experienced, AI\-first software developer to maintain and improve multiple applications supporting our equine, agricultural, and veterinary businesses, including our Spade AI assistant. **THE OPPORTUNITY** You’ll work directly with the founder as our primary developer, with a clear connection between what you build and the people who use it. We need someone who enjoys solving problems, moves quickly, and can take an idea from conversation through launch. You should be comfortable maintaining existing applications, improving what’s already working, and making sound technical decisions independently. Personality matters here. You must be friendly, approachable, collaborative, and ready to tackle new challenges. You’ll work with people who know their businesses deeply and need a developer who listens, asks thoughtful questions, and enjoys finding solutions together. Learning the equine and veterinary world can feel like learning a new language. There are specialized terms, complex workflows, and important details behind everyday decisions. You don’t need to arrive knowing everything, but you do need the curiosity, patience, and willingness to learn. **WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON** * Maintain and improve multiple business applications. * Build features supporting ranch, equine, and veterinary operations. * Develop and improve Spade AI and other AI\-powered features. * Connect applications with payment, accounting, and other business systems. * Troubleshoot issues across interfaces, backend services, databases, and integrations. * Own implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. * Work with the founder to prioritize improvements with the greatest practical impact. * Keep systems secure, reliable, and documented. **AI SKILLS WE NEED** AI should already be central to how you work. You should use tools such as Codex, Claude Code, or similar platforms to accelerate development—and have the experience to review, test, and stand behind the results. You must also understand how to build and improve AI features inside an application. We’re looking for experience with: * Integrating large language models through APIs. * Designing effective prompts, instructions, and structured outputs. * Connecting AI to relevant business records, terminology, and knowledge. * Building feedback and memory systems that improve future responses. * Creating realistic evaluation examples and measuring accuracy. * Understanding model training and fine\-tuning, including when they are appropriate. * Protecting sensitive information and keeping human review in workflows where mistakes have meaningful consequences. You’ll help Spade better understand our terminology, workflows, and user preferences, and turn that understanding into useful, dependable assistance. **OUR TECHNOLOGY STACKS** * Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. * Solo Equine backend: Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Prisma, with Redis and BullMQ. * Veterinary application: Next.js with Supabase/PostgreSQL and NextAuth. * Mobile: React Native and Expo. * Development and quality: GitHub, automated deployment workflows, Playwright, Vitest, Jest, and Sentry. You should have strong full\-stack experience and be comfortable learning your way around existing codebases. **INTEGRATION EXPERIENCE IS ESSENTIAL** A strong working understanding of Stripe and QuickBooks Online integrations is required, ideally with experience building and maintaining them in production. * Stripe: Card and ACH payments, refunds, webhooks, and accurate payment\-status handling. * QuickBooks Online: OAuth connections, customer and invoice mapping, payments, credits, and accounting synchronization. * Reliable integrations: API limits, secure credentials, retries, duplicate prevention, error recovery, and resolving discrepancies between systems. We value speed and sound judgment. These systems handle real money and business records, so accuracy matters. **WHO WILL THRIVE HERE** * You’ve independently shipped and maintained production software. * You’re comfortable being the primary developer alongside a hands\-on founder. * You’re friendly, dependable, and willing to work through unfamiliar challenges. * You have some familiarity with agriculture, ranching, livestock, or the equine industry. * You’re enthusiastic about learning the language and details of equine and veterinary operations. * You can turn a business conversation into a practical technical solution. * You communicate clearly, follow through, and take ownership. * You enjoy seeing firsthand how people use what you build. **LOCATION, SCHEDULE \& WHAT WE OFFER** * A beautiful workplace: On\-site work at a 400\-acre ranch in Gainesville, Texas. * Hybrid flexibility: Full\-time position with at least three days per week on\-site and remote work available on the remaining days. * Direct founder access: Work closely with the person making business decisions. * Meaningful ownership: Help shape applications that people rely on every day. * Compensation based on experience and demonstrated ability. * Benefits: 401(k), health insurance, paid vacation, and paid sick days. * Premium housing available for qualified candidates: A one\-bedroom/one\-bathroom or two\-bedroom/two\-bathroom apartment. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship. **INTERESTED? SHOW US WHAT YOU’VE BUILT.** Send your résumé or LinkedIn profile and a brief introduction covering: * Software you’ve built and maintained, and what you personally owned. * How you use AI in your development workflow. * AI features or assistants you’ve built and how you evaluated their performance. * Your experience with Stripe and QuickBooks Online. * Your connection to agriculture or the equine industry. * Your availability to work in Gainesville and whether you’re interested in housing. Bring your technical skills, a friendly attitude, and a willingness to learn. Help us build the software behind a business you can experience firsthand. Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Paid sick time * Paid time off * Work from home Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gainesville, TX 76240

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/legal/website\-privacy\-statement/applicant\-privacy/ applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. **Job Description:** Senior Software Development Engineer **3M** **H** **ealth** **C** **are is now** **S** **olventum** **At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.** **We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.** **The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** **Build the Fabric that enables the next generation of intelligent healthcare applications at Solventum \- Health Information Systems (HIS).** We are building a modern AI Fabric to accelerate how AI capabilities are developed, deployed, governed, and operated across our products and platforms globally. We are looking for a Senior Development Engineer with 5\-10 years of production software engineering experience.This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with a strong passion for AI platforms, cloud\-native systems, LLMs, and distributed architecture. In this role, you will help make AI a reusable enterprise capability. Your work will enable engineering, sciences, and product teams to move from experimentation to secure, reliable, observable, and scalable production AI faster. A software\-engineering\-first mindset is critical for this role. In this role, the engineer will. * Design, develop, test, and operate code services and capabilities of the Solventum\-HIS AI Fabric. * Build scalable platform capabilities for AI inferencing, Infrastructure for lightweight Agentic AI workflows, and lifecycle management. * Develop frameworks and services supporting LLMs, SLMs, MCP, AI agents, tool integration and orchestration, and agentic workflows specific to multi\-modal medical documentation and medical coding. * Build APIs, SDKs, reusable services, and developer tooling that makes it easier for other product teams to safely integrate AI into applications. * Engineer highly scalable, available, distributed systems using cloud\-native architectures, Kube containers, and microservices. * Develop production\-grade capabilities with model registry, agentic state management, observability, lineage deployment and infra\-automation, and CI/CD. * Implement AI platform capabilities with security, privacy, data protection, reliability, and operational readiness by design, particularly for regulated healthcare environments. * Collaborate across Engineering, Sciences, Product teams, Architects, and security teams. * Participate in architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, and continuous improvement. * Be the bar raiser through strong design and SDLC practices. **Your Skills and Expertise** To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications. * Bachelor’s Degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) AND Five (5\)\-(10\) years experience in computer science or software development experience, including experience building and operating production software. web, mobile, PC, and connected devices. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services using Java and modern frameworks such as Spring Boot. * Build and enhance APIs, microservices, and platform components that support PlayStation Network and related digital services. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver features for commerce, subscriptions, identity, content, gaming, media, or partner integrations. * Write clean, secure, maintainable, and well\-tested code. * Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and event\-driven services. * Create and execute unit, integration, and automated tests using tools such as JUnit, Mockito, Test containers, or similar frameworks. * Work with relational and NoSQL databases, including writing efficient queries and understanding schema design. * Participate in code reviews, design discussions, sprint planning, and technical documentation. * Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve production and pre\-production issues. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. * Support cloud\-native applications running in environments such as AWS, containers, and Kubernetes\-based platforms. * Use monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting tools to improve service reliability and * Help refactor legacy systems and migrate services toward modern architectures where appropriate. * Follow secure development practices, including data protection, authentication, authorization, and dependency management. * Communicate technical status, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly to teammates and stakeholders. * Continuously improve engineering standards, development workflows, and operational practices. **Required Qualifications** * 4\+ years of professional software development experience with Java\-based backend systems. * Strong experience with Java 17\+; Java 21 experience is a plus. * Experience building backend applications or services using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, or related Java frameworks. * Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. * Familiarity with object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and software design principles. * Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, or Oracle. * Ability to write SQL queries and understand database performance considerations. * Experience with automated testing using JUnit or similar testing frameworks. * Experience using Git or other source control systems. * Familiarity with Linux or Unix\-based development environments. * Understanding of Agile/Scrum software development practices. * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently with guidance. * Excellent communication skills with both technical and non\-technical partners. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems. * Experience deploying or operating applications in AWS or another major cloud platform. * Familiarity with containers and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo CD, or * Experience with messaging or streaming platforms such as Kafka, SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ, or similar. * Experience with NoSQL or caching technologies such as DynamoDB, Redis, Cassandra, or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. * Familiarity with observability tools such as Datadog, Splunk, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or ELK. * Experience with API gateways, authentication, authorization, OAuth2, OIDC, or identity platforms. * Exposure to secure coding practices and application security testing. * Experience modernizing legacy Java applications. * Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React, TypeScript, or modern web frameworks is a plus, but not required. * Interest in gaming, entertainment, commerce, media streaming, or large\-scale consumer platforms. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to improve productivity, code quality, testing, or documentation. **Technology Environment** * Java 17 / Java 21 * Spring Boot / Spring Framework * REST APIs and event\-driven services * PostgreSQL, MySQL/Aurora, Oracle, DynamoDB, Redis * AWS cloud services * Docker and Kubernetes * Kafka or cloud messaging systems * JUnit, Mockito, Test containers * Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment tools * Observability and monitoring platforms * Secure software development practices **What You'll Help Build** * PlayStation Network services * Digital game and content commerce * Subscriptions and membership platforms * Player identity, account, and entitlement systems * Media, entertainment, and partner integrations * Internal enterprise tools used across Sony Interactive Entertainment * Global\-scale services for console, web, mobile, PC, and connected\-device experiences **About You** You are a backend engineer who enjoys building reliable services, learning new technologies, and working with teammates to deliver high\-quality software. You care about code quality, testing, scalability, and maintainability. You are comfortable asking questions, sharing ideas, and taking ownership of features from design through production support. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

Applicants will be asked to provide verifiable proof of speciality\-specific qualifications. * **Creative Fiction Writing:** At least two of the following: (1\) verified novel publishing deals with major houses (e.g., Big Five); (2\) novel sales \>50,000 units (excluding free promotions); (3\) 10\+ short stories in major outlets (e.g., The New Yorker, Clarkesworld); (4\) major awards recognition (e.g., Hugo, Nebula finalist or comparable); (5\) critical acclaim (e.g., starred reviews in Kirkus, Publishers Weekly, features in Library Journal or NY Times Book Review). * **Game Writing:** All of the following: (1\) 5\+ years of professional game writing experience; (2\) public portfolio showcasing branching narratives, character development, dialogue trees, and measurable player impact (e.g., reviews or engagement metrics); (3\) published credits in notable games, demonstrating expertise in narrative design, lore creation, and integration with gameplay mechanics. * **Technical Writing:** All of the following: (1\) 5\+ years in technical writing, focusing on user manuals, API documentation, software guides, or technical reports for tech, engineering, or scientific fields; (2\) public portfolio of high\-impact examples (e.g., docs that reduced support tickets by 20%\+, improved user adoption metrics, enhanced compliance rates); (3\) Certifications from Society for Technical Communication (STC) Certified Professional Technical Communicator (CPTC), or equivalent; (4\) Bachelor's degree or higher in Technical Communication, English, Computer Science, or related field. * **Nonfiction Writing:** All of the following: (1\) 5\+ years in non\-fiction writing (memoirs, biographies, historical accounts), with 3\+ published books showing commercial and/or critical success; (2\) public portfolio of samples/manuscripts demonstrating structure, prose, and non\-fiction standards; (3\) awards, funding success, or memberships in orgs like BIO/ASJA. Bachelor's degree or higher in English, History, or Journalism highly preferred. * **Journalistic Writing:** All of the following: (1\) 5\+ years of professional experience in journalism, reporting for reputable outlets; (2\) expertise in investigative journalism, feature writing, or specialized beats; (3\) public portfolio of published work with bylines in major outlets (e.g., NYT, BBC), with awards, citations, or engagement metrics; (4\) Bachelor's degree or higher in Journalism, Communications, English, or related field. * **Copywriting:** All of the following: (1\) 5\+ years in copywriting or marketing writing, with  rant Writing:** All of the following: (1\) 5\+ years of grant writing with proven record of securing funding in excess of $1M across multiple grants and a win rate of 50% or higher; (2\) expertise in researching funding opportunities and understanding grant guidelines from various sources; (3\) samples of narratives, budgets, and evaluation plans that showcase persuasive writing, logical structure, and alignment with funder priorities; (4\) Bachelor's degree or higher in Communications, Public Policy, Nonprofit Management, or related. * **Academic Writing:** All of the following: (1\) 5\+ years in academic writing, with extensive experience in peer\-reviewed publications, theses, dissertations, or scholarly books for academic fields; (2\) authored articles in top\-tier journals, books with reputable presses, citations exceeding 500\+ via Google Scholar, or an h\-index of 10 or higher; (3\) public portfolio of samples, including abstracts, full papers, or proposals demonstrating rigorous argumentation, citation styles (APA, MLA, Chicago), and original contributions; (4\) PhD in relevant field. Postdoctoral experience or fellowships (e.g., Fulbright) preferred. * **Poetry Writing:** All of the following: (1\) advanced degree in creative writing, literature, poetry, or related; (2\) publications in reputable literary journals, anthologies, or poetry collections that demonstrate mastery of a wide range of traditional forms, from haiku to sonnet to villanelle; (3\) history of awards, fellowships, or residencies from recognized organizations; (4\) one or more of the following: (a) published collections with major presses, (b) poems in outlets like Poetry Magazine, (c) awards like National Book Award for Poetry, (d) fellowships from NEA or Guggenheim.
