On average most projects may involve at least 10 hours per week to achieve deliverables effectively though this is not a fixed commitment and depends on the scope of work. Contractors have full flexibility to set their own hours and determine the exact amount of time needed to complete deliverables. * Tutor roles may be performed remotely from any location worldwide, subject to legal eligibility, time\-zone compatibility, and role specific needs. * For US based candidates, please note we are unable to hire in the states of Wyoming and Illinois at this time. * We are unable to provide visa sponsorship. * For those who will be working from a personal device, your computer must be a Chromebook, Mac with MacOS 11\.0 or later, or Windows 10 or later. **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** US based candidates: $35/hour \- $75/hour depending on factors including subspecialty applied for, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process. Benefits vary based on employment type, location and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible U.S. based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role specific information will be provided to you during the interview process. *SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Architecture, SVP
jobs.description: **Who we are looking for** The Head of Enterprise Architecture owns the **target\-state design of the technology estate** and the standards, patterns and governance through which it is realised . This is the architectural blueprint that determines how every platform, application and integration in the firm is built, connected, secured and retired. The mandate is to **reduce complexity while increasing optionality** — cutting technical debt, rationalising a fragmented estate, and establishing the reusable architectural foundations that let engineering teams move faster within known\-good boundaries. Success is measured not in documents published but in estate outcomes: fewer bespoke solutions, faster architectural decisions, demonstrably lower run cost, and an architecture capable of absorbing the pace of change that Frontier AI and post\-quantum cryptography will impose. A central element of this mandate is establishing the **architecture that makes the firm AI\-forward** — the compute, serving, integration and control foundations on which AI becomes a governed production capability rather than a portfolio of experiments. This is delivered in deliberate partnership with the Head of Data \& AI, who owns model strategy, data products and AI delivery. This is a **deeply technical leadership role** . The successful candidate is a credible principal\-level architect who has personally designed systems at scale, and who will lead through technical authority rather than positional mandate — equally effective authoring a reference architecture, defending a standard to a skeptical business\-unit CIO, and presenting an estate rationalization case to the Senior Leadership. **Why this role is Important to us** * **Architecture is an enabling layer, not a gate.** Governance exists to accelerate good decisions, not to inspect bad ones after the fact. If review is the bottleneck, the pattern library has failed. * **Patterns over permissions.** The fastest, cheapest, pre\-approved way to build is to use an existing pattern. Teams may deviate through a time\-boxed, registered exception — and inherit the support and compliance burden of doing so. * **Reduce before you add.** Every new pattern admitted to the library should retire something. Complexity is the primary long\-term cost driver of the estate. * **Serve the whole estate.** Mainframe, vendor\-package, analytics and quant populations receive proportionate patterns and standards. An architecture that governs only greenfield services has failed. * **Cost is an architectural property.** Spend, unit economics and run cost are designed in, not discovered in the invoice — including the economics of accelerated compute and inference. * **Complementary, not overlapping.** Where a peer function owns a domain — Data \& AI, Cyber, Developer Platforms — EA owns the interfaces, standards and cross\-domain coherence, not the delivery. **What you will be responsible for** **Architecture strategy \& governance** * Own the enterprise technology blueprint across infrastructure, cloud, security, data and application domains; maintain a coherent target state aligned to long\-term business strategy. * Chair the **Technology Standards Board** and own the EARB / SARB review mechanisms — running governance through decision logs, fitness functions and time\-boxed exception processes that operate at delivery speed. * Partner with business\-unit technology leaders to prevent domain\-level decisions creating enterprise\-wide integration debt; clearly delineate architecture accountability from engineering execution. **Pattern portfolio \& technology standards** * Define, curate and govern the enterprise pattern library across infrastructure, cloud, integration, security and AI/ML domains, with a formal maturity model (Emerging / Validated / Strategic / Deprecated). * Drive active extraction of patterns from production systems — converting institutional knowledge into documented, reusable assets rather than commissioning them in the abstract. * Publish a quarterly **Technology Radar** translating market signal into firm guidance on adopt, trial, assess and hold positions, with named executive accountability for retiring end\-of\-life technologies. **AI\-enabling architecture** * Define the AI **infrastructure** reference architecture — accelerated compute, model serving, inference optimisation , AI gateway and access\-governance patterns — providing the substrate on which the Data \& AI organisation delivers models and AI products. * Establish enterprise architectural standards for agentic systems: orchestration topology, tool\-use patterns, human\-in\-the\-loop escalation, and audit\-trail requirements for AI\-assisted decisions in regulated workflows. * Own the architectural control framework for AI — risk tiering, explainability requirements by use case, data provenance controls and output governance — ensuring deployments satisfy SR 11\-7, EU AI Act and emerging supervisory expectations, join onsibility for target\-state definition and its realisation . * Deep expertise across cloud\-native architecture, Kubernetes, distributed systems, event streaming, API and integration patterns, infrastructure\-as\-code and zero\-trust security architecture. * Demonstrable depth in **AI infrastructure architecture** — model serving and inference optimisation , accelerated\-compute cluster design, vector store selection and design, retrieval patterns and AI observability — sufficient to set standards and evaluate engineering decisions credibly. * Working knowledge of AI governance architecture: model risk tiering, explainability tooling, data provenance controls and audit\-trail design for AI\-assisted decisions. * A track record of earning architectural adoption through influence and demonstrated value across a large, federated, sometimes skeptical organisation . * Executive presence: able to defend standards alongside senior engineers, and investment and rationalisation cases to senior leadership audiences, with equal authority. **Highly desirable** * Financial\-services or comparably regulated experience, with working knowledge of SR 11\-7, DORA, time\-to\-architectural\-decision. * Experience defining an AI reference architecture adopted across multiple product teams, moving AI from isolated proofs of concept to governed production jobs.title: Senior AI Developer
jobs.description: Overview: We are looking for a highly skilled **Senior AI Developer** to design, build, and optimize advanced AI solutions across predictive, generative, and autonomous system domains. This role requires strong hands\-on engineering capabilities, deep familiarity with modern AI architectures, and the ability to translate mission needs into robust, production\-ready AI capabilities. The Senior AI Developer will work across the full stack of AI development, from data ingestion and model experimentation to application integration, orchestration, and deployment, and will collaborate closely with product teams, LLMOps engineers, designers, and mission stakeholders. Contributions: * Develop end\-to\-end AI solutions including LLM\-powered applications, predictive ML models, multi\-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, and specialized AI microservices. * Implement reusable AI components, libraries, and APIs that streamline application development and accelerate delivery across programs. * Integrate AI models with enterprise systems, APIs, data platforms, vector databases, and cloud\-native services to deliver scalable mission capabilities. * Drive iterative experimentation, prototyping, and model improvement cycles in collaboration with Data Scientists and AI Evaluation Scientists. * Design and implement advanced prompt strategies, context management layers, retrieval systems, and LLM orchestration logic. * Build scalable inference services, optimize model performance, and collaborate with LLMOps to enable robust deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. * Translate user needs and mission workflows into intuitive, reliable AI\-powered features through active partnership with designers and product teams. * Implement secure\-by\-design and trustworthy AI practices, including safety guardrails, input sanitization, content filtering, and integration of evaluation metrics. * Contribute to internal AI frameworks, code patterns, and shared accelerators that raise delivery quality across the AI \& Data Exploitation Practice. * Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and support engineering excellence across multi\-disciplinary AI delivery teams. * Stay current with emerging AI techniques, libraries, foundation models, and agent frameworks, evaluating their applicability to client missions. * You will contribute to the growth of our AI \& Data Exploitation Practice! Qualifications: * Ability to hold a position of public trust with the U.S. government. * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with at least 2\+ years focused on AI/ML, generative AI, or LLM\-driven application development. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar. * Demonstrated ability to design and develop production\-grade AI applications, including APIs, back\-end services, orchestration logic, and front\-end integrations (when needed). * Experience implementing RAG architectures, embeddings, vector stores, and context retrieval patterns. * Familiarity with multi\-agent orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering strategies, and advanced LLM interaction design. * Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including compute, serverless services, and security fundamentals for AI workloads. * Working knowledge of containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines for AI\-based systems. * Experience with structured and unstructured data, document processing, and application integration with existing enterprise systems. * Understanding of responsible AI principles including safety, fairness, privacy, and model risk mitigation. * Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across engineering, design, and mission domains. * Proven experience mentoring teammates and raising the technical bar of development teams. * Local to the Washington, DC metro area preferred. About **steampunk**: Steampunk relies on several factors to determine salary, including but not limited to geographic location, contractual requirements, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $140,000 to $190,000\. The estimate displayed represents a typical annual salary range for this position. Annual salary is just one aspect of Steampunk’s total compensation package for employees. Learn more about additional Steampunk benefits here. **Identity Statement** As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. Steampunk is a Change Agent in the Federal contracting industry, bringing new thinking to clients in the Homeland, Federal Civilian, Health and DoD sectors. Through our Human\-Centered delivery methodology, we are fundamentally changing the expectations our Federal clients have for true shared accountability in solving their toughest mission challenges. If you want to learn more about our story, visit http://www.steampunk.com. *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Steampunk participates in the E\-Verify program.*

jobs.description: ### **Why join Stryker?** Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture. We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description** We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.**What you will do:** As our Senior Manager, EDT Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), you will lead the end\-to\-end platform ownership and delivery of Stryker's Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS) environment, which powers Stryker.com and 50\+ country sites globally as the foundation of Stryker's Digital Marketing Program. built\-in generative AI capabilities (content creation, asset tagging, experimentation) in alignment with Stryker's AI Operating Committee (AIOC) governance and residual\-risk approvals. * Ensure transitions of completed projects and stable production support operations. **What you need:** **Required:** * Bachelor's Degree from an accredited university, preferably in Computer Science, MSM/translation strategies, DAM architecture, component\-based design, and Adobe WebSDK integrations. * 2\+ years of experience with track record managing global system integrators and hybrid onshore/offshore delivery models. * 2\+ years of experience with the broader Adobe Experience Cloud (Analytics, Target, Real\-Time CDP, Commerce) preferred. * 5\+ years of experience with SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and IT QMS/regulatory compliance (SOX, privacy, consent). **Preferred:** * Master's degree or MBA preferred. * Adobe Certified Expert / Master (AEM Sites, AEM Assets, or AEM Architect) strongly preferred. * PMP, SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification preferred. * Prior experience in medical device, life sciences, or another regulated industry preferred. jobs.title: Manager, Application Development
jobs.description: **Purpose:** The Manager, Application Development provides strategic and tactical leadership for the design, development, implementation, and support of application development, and integration solutions for Vanscoy Rare Pharmacy (VRP). Reporting directly to the Director of IT, this role serves as a technical leader responsible for application development and management, managing application integrations, supporting business intelligence initiatives, and overseeing development environments across the organization. The Manager works closely with pharmacy operations, leadership, manufacturers, technology partners, and third\-party vendors to design and implement solutions that improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, workflow automation, and regulatory compliance. This position serves as the primary technical liaison between the company and it’s Managed Service Provider (MSP) for proprietary software systems workflow development initiatives while maintaining responsibility for all VRP\-specific proprietary software development, configuration, enhancements, and support activities. jobs.title: Software Development, Staff
jobs.description: ### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You graduated recently or finished an internship where you got your hands on real data, maybe built a dashboard that someone actually used, or experimented with ChatGPT API calls in a side project and thought "I could build something useful with this." You are drawn to the question of how AI can make boring work disappear, not in a theoretical way, but in a "can we automate this contract search so Legal stops spending three hours digging through folders" kind of way. SQL does not scare you. Neither does opening a Python notebook and figuring out why a script broke. You have probably built something with Generative AI already, even if it was just for a class or a hackathon, and you are curious about RAG, prompt engineering, and how these tools actually get deployed inside a company with 30,000 people. You are comfortable asking questions when requirements are unclear and you learn fast. At Synopsys, you will work on AI and automation projects that touch Legal, Procurement, and Operations teams, and the solutions you help build will change how people find contracts, generate reports, and make decisions every day. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Build and test AI\-powered assistants for contract search and document management using Generative AI tools and RAG frameworks * Write SQL queries in Snowflake to pull contract data, generate reports, and support analytics requests from Legal, Procurement, and Operations teams * Create dashboards and visualizations in Power BI or Tableau that make contract and business data accessible and actionable * Support contract lifecycle management processes including metadata tagging, document intake, compliance tracking, and reporting workflows * Automate repetitive reporting and business processes using Python, workflow tools, and AI integrations * Participate in cross\-functional project meetings with Legal, Procurement, Finance, and IT to gather requirements, test solutions, and document workflows * Document AI solutions, user guides, and business requirements so others can understand and maintain what you build * Support and Enhance Contracts Lifecycle management system. * Familiar with SAP HANA and other SAP systems. * Develop APIs in Python and other scripting languages. ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Legal and Procurement teams will find contracts in seconds instead of hours because the AI search tools you built actually work * Business stakeholders will make faster decisions using the dashboards and reports you create in Power BI and Snowflake * Repetitive manual processes will disappear as the automation workflows you help deploy take over contract data extraction and reporting tasks * AI solutions you test and refine will scale across the organization, changing how thousands of employees interact with contracts and business data * Data quality and reporting accuracy will improve because you caught gaps and fixed them before they became downstream problems * Cross\-functional teams will move faster on AI and analytics projects because you documented requirements clearly and kept everyone aligned * The CLM platform will become more intelligent and useful as the AI features you help build get adopted by users across the company ### **What You'll Need** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field * 5\+ years of experience, internships, academic projects, or personal work that involved building something real with data or code * Working knowledge of SQL for querying databases and generating reports * Basic Python skills for scripting, automation, or data analysis * Familiarity with Generative AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot, even if just through coursework or side projects * Experience with Snowflake, Power BI, Tableau, or similar data platforms is a strong plus * Exposure to RAG concepts, prompt engineering, or workflow automation tools will set you apart ### **Who You Are** * You can look at a messy dataset, write a SQL query that makes sense of it, and explain what you found to someone who does not write code * When something breaks or does not work as expected, you dig in and figure it out instead of waiting for someone else to fix it * You are comfortable working with business teams who may not speak in technical terms, and you can translate their needs into something you can actually build * Learning new tools and technologies does not intimidate you, whether it is a new AI framework, a reporting platform, or a workflow automation system * You ask clarifying questions when requirements are vague because you would rather get it right than guess and rebuild later * You document your work clearly so the next person, or future you, can pick it up and understand what you built and why ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer — T. Rowe Price Lab (NY or MD)
jobs.description: At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi\-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident. We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity. Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you. **Role Summary** Positions are available in our New York City office or with our AI Engineering squad in Harbor Point, Baltimore, MD. In either location, you will join a collaborative team of engineers, product owners, and business partners building high\-impact AI products with leverage across the firm. As a Senior Software Engineer on T. Rowe Price Labs' AI Engineering team, you will independently design, build, and scale production\-grade AI agents and intelligent systems that solve complex business problems. You will lead technical workstreams, incubate new AI products, experiment with emerging technologies and innovative ideas, and partner with business\-aligned technology teams to enable broader adoption at scale. This is a hands\-on role for an experienced engineer with strong software fundamentals, practical AI engineering experience, and a product mindset. You will take ownership of complex and ambiguous problems, mentor other engineers, and contribute to the patterns and practices that shape AI engineering at T. Rowe Price. **Responsibilities** * Own the end\-to\-end design and delivery of production\-grade AI agents and intelligent systems, including architecture, implementation, testing, evaluation, deployment, observability, and production support. * Design agentic workflows using orchestration, tool integration, retrieval\-based systems, structured outputs, context management, and appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to take control of complex or ambiguous problems, evaluate alternative approaches, and translate needs into scalable AI solutions. * Lead technical workstreams from rapid experimentation and validation through production adoption. * Establish evaluation and testing approaches for non\-deterministic AI systems, including quality metrics, regression testing, failure analysis, and production monitoring. * Make informed engineering trade\-offs across models, prompts, context, tools, latency, cost, reliability, security, and maintainability. * Contribute to reusable AI capabilities and shared engineering patterns that improve speed, quality, and consistency across teams. * Lead code and design reviews, mentor less\-experienced engineers, and help others solve complex technical problems. * Own technical debt and continuously improve the quality, reliability, and maintainability of the systems you build. * Rapidly evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine when and how they can be applied to deliver meaningful business value. * Support the Build\-Operate\-Transfer model by preparing successful AI solutions for long\-term ownership and scale by business\-aligned technology teams. **Business Knowledge** * Work directly with business stakeholders and product owners to understand priorities, shape solution direction, and deliver measurable outcomes. * Translate complex business needs into effective technology solutions and clearly communicate technical trade\-offs. * Balance innovation, business value, scalability, risk, fiscal responsibility, and long\-term maintainability when making technical decisions. **Qualifications** **Required:** * BS or MS in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience, with 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong hands\-on development experience in object\-oriented languages such as Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript. * Hands\-on experience building AI\-enabled applications, intelligent workflows, or agentic systems using modern LLMs and AI development frameworks. * Practical experience with modern AI engineering patterns such as agent orchestration, tool/function calling, retrieval\-based systems, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, evaluation, observability, or guardrails. * Experience taking AI\-enabled systems beyond prototypes toward production, including testing, mon Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical workstreams. * Understanding of financial markets, asset management, or financial instruments. **FINRA Requirements** FINRA licenses are not required and will not be supported for this role. **Work Flexibility** This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home. **WHAT TO EXPECT AFTER APPLYING** 1\. You will receive an email and text message to answer a few questions to verify your eligibility. If you apply for multiple jobs, you will receive separate invitations for each role and will need to respond to each. **Estimated Time Commitment: 3\-5 minutes** 2\. If you are eligible, you will be asked to record video responses to introductory questions with our vendor partner, HireVue. Take time to read all instructions carefully before responding. Some questions may require you to respond within a set time limit, or with limited retakes. You can use this opportunity to tell us more about your background and interest than we can learn from a resume alone. **Estimated Time Commitment: 20\-30 minutes** **Base Salary Ranges** Please review the job posting for the location of this specific opportunity. $121,000\.00 \- $206,000\.00 for the location of: Maryland, Colorado, Washington and remote workers $133,000\.00 \- $227,000\.00 for the location of: Washington, D.C. $151,000\.00 \- $258,000\.00 for the location of: New York, California Placement within the range provided above is based on the individual’s relevant experience and skills for the role. Base salary is only one component of our total compensation package. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, which is determined upon company and individual performance. **Commitment to Diversity, Equity,** **and** **Inclusion** At T. Rowe Price, our associates are our greatest asset. We thrive because our company culture is built on inclusion and because we sustain a work environment where associates can bring their best selves to work every day. The backgrounds, talents, and experiences of our global associates allow us to embrace new ideas and perspectives that move our business priorities forward and enable us to deliver strong client outcomes. Here, you can expect equal opportunity and fair and consistent treatment for all. **Benefits** We value your goals and needs, at work and in life. As an associate, you’ll be supported with resources, benefits, and work\-life balance so you can thrive in ways that matter to you. Featured employee benefits to enrich your life: * Competitive compensation * Annual bonus eligibility * A generous retirement plan * Hybrid work schedule * Health and wellness benefits, including online therapy * Paid time off for vacation, illness, medical appointments, and volunteering days * Family care resources, including fertility and adoption benefits Learn more about our benefits. **T. Rowe Price is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity of thought, gender, and race. We believe our continued success depends upon the equal treatment of all associates and applicants for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, sex, gender, age, mental or physical disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, or any other classification protected by country, federal, state, or local law.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The engineer will also collaborate with existing Java\-based applications, contribute to modern software development practices, and leverage AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity. * **Role:** Golang Engineer * **Experience:** 6 \- 9 Years * **Work Location:** Phoenix, AZ (100% onsite). scalable, and maintainable solutions using Go\-based frameworks, libraries, and development tools. * Analyze existing Java applications and contribute to troubleshooting, enhancements, and integration commonly used development practices. * Practical experience developing production\-grade applications and backend services using Golang. * Working knowledge of Java with the ability to navigate, applications. * Strong experience creating and supporting REST\-based APIs and distributed backend services. * Understanding of API design principles, request/response handling, service integration, code reviews and working within established engineering standards. * Ability to work effectively with existing applications and understand unfamiliar codebases. * Familiarity with AI\-powered development assistants, particularly GitHub Copilot, and practical experience incorporating such tools into software development activities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working with distributed systems and highly available backend architectures. * Knowledge of Cassandra performance optimization, partition strategies, replication, consistency models, and cluster\-oriented application design. * Experience migrating, modernizing, or integrating Java\-based applications with Go services. * Familiarity with microservices architecture and service\-oriented backend Familiarity with observability practices, including application logging, metrics, tracing, and production monitoring. * Experience working in Agile or other iterative software development environments. * Exposure to additional AI\-assisted programming and developer productivity tools. * Understanding of secure software development practices and common backend application security considerations. jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description: About TRIBUS Group Founded in 2009, TRIBUS Group serves as one the largest provider of software to real estate MLSs and associations in the US. More than 500,000 agents login to our platforms each day. We're rapidly expanding our team in our Denver, CO office. \#\# About the Role We're looking for a Product Owner who lives at the intersection of design and product strategy. This role owns the design\-driven product backlog for our website and platform experiences — translating vision and user needs into polished, well\-specified work using \*\*Figma\*\* and \*\*Claude Design\*\*. You'll be the bridge between business strategy, customer needs, and the development team, ensuring every shipped experience is not just functional, but genuinely well\-designed. This is a hands\-on role: you won't just write requirements, you'll actively prototype, critique, and refine designs in Figma \& Claude Design alongside designers and engineers, then own the backlog that turns those designs into shipped product. \#\# I. Vision \& Strategy \- Define and evangelize the product's design vision — the "why" behind the experience, its long\-term direction, and how it aligns with company strategy. Communicate this clearly to stakeholders and the development team. \- Develop and maintain a design\-forward product roadmap, sequencing key features, releases, and design initiatives based on market trends, user needs, and business objectives. \- Conduct market and competitive research, with a specific eye on design trends, interaction patterns, and emerging tools in the web/UX landscape. \- Deeply understand target users — their workflows, pain points, goals, and expectations for a well\-designed digital experience. \#\# II. Design \& Backlog Ownership \- Own the CMS/product backlog, including design\-related work: mockups, prototypes, design specs, and UI/UX tickets — ensuring it's the single source of truth for design and development work. \- Build and iterate on prototypes and mockups directly in \*\*Figma\*\* and \*\*Claude Design\*\*, translating high\-level concepts into concrete, testable design artifacts. \- Create and refine user stories with clear acceptance criteria, including visual/interaction specifications derived from Figma files, so design intent survives the handoff to engineering. \- Prioritize backlog items based on business value, design quality, technical feasibility, risk, and dependencies. \- Ensure design and backlog items are "ready" — sufficiently detailed, reviewed, and approved before entering a sprint. \- Manage design dependencies across teams (design system, front\-end, other product squads) to minimize roadblocks. \#\# III. Stakeholder Communication \& Collaboration \- Serve as the primary point of contact for design\- and product\-related inquiries from internal (sales, marketing, support, leadership) and external (customers, partners) stakeholders. \- Present design concepts, prototypes, and progress — using Figma and Claude Design artifacts — to communicate direction clearly to non\-design audiences. \- Gather and synthesize feedback from customer support, sales, user testing, and analytics to inform design and product decisions. \- Facilitate design workshops and critique sessions to gather requirements, validate concepts, and align stakeholders around a direction. \- Manage competing priorities and expectations among stakeholders, balancing design quality against timeline and scope. \#\# IV. Development Team Collaboration \- Act as the voice of the customer and the champion of design quality throughout the development lifecycle. \- Be available to the development team to clarify design intent, answer questions, and make timely decisions on backlog items. \- Actively participate in refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. \- Review completed work against both functional acceptance criteria and design fidelity (comparing shipped work to the Figma/Claude Design source of truth) before accepting. \- Foster a collaborative environment between design, product, and engineering. \#\# V. Product \& Design Performance \- Define and track KPIs relevant to design quality and product success — engagement, conversion, usability metrics, load speed, accessibility compliance, and SEO performance. \- Analyze usage data and A/B test results to identify where design changes could improve outcomes. \- Monitor user feedback and support tickets for recurring usability or design issues. \- Continuously identify opportunities to improve usability, visual quality, and overall experience. \- Support product launches and post\-launch design iteration in partnership with marketing and sales. \#\# VI. Domain Expertise \- \*\*Hands\-on proficiency with Figma\*\* (prototyping, components, design systems, developer handoff) and \*\*Claude Design\*\* for rapid concepting, mockups, and iteration using our design systems. \- Solid understanding of web development technologies relevant to design handoff/ \- Strong grounding in UX/UI principles — information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, and accessibility (WCAG) and a11y based design frameworks. \- Awareness of performance, security, and scalability considerations as they intersect with design decisions. \#\# Requirements \- Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role with significant design ownership. \- Demonstrated portfolio or work history showing hands\-on use of Figma; familiarity with AI\-assisted design tools (Claude Design or similar) is a strong plus. \- Strong written and verbal communication skills for translating design intent across technical and non\-technical audiences. \- Based in or willing to work from our \*\*Denver, CO\*\* office during normal business hours. \#\# Nice to Have \- Background in real estate technology, MLS platforms, or B2B SaaS. \- Experience with design systems and Figma component libraries at scale. \- Familiarity with agile/Scrum ceremonies and backlog tools, or any experience in a software factory / high speed prototype to launch enterprise. Pay: $67,193\.00 \- $73,248\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Experience: * Product Ownership: 2 years (Required) * Product Design: 3 years (Required) Ability to Commute: * Denver, CO 80222 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Environmental Program Lead
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** We have an immediate opportunity for an Environmental Program Lead to support our growing government and private\-sector environmental consulting business in California. This seller\-doer role will lead strategy development, capture, and execution of environmental projects focusing on the Golden State. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in environmental services, such as due diligence and property transaction advisory services; site investigation, risk assessment, and remediation; environmental compliance (permitting, reporting, and auditing); and communication and negotiation with federal, state, and local regulatory agencies. The candidate will have a proven business development track record, including developing and winning new projects and clients. **Why Tetra Tech:** At Tetra Tech, we are *Leading with Science* to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry\-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting\-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Infrequent lifting of up to 25 lbs. * Requires use of hands for typing, handling materials, and operating office equipment. * Vision abilities include close vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. * Occasional field oversight may be needed which entails the ability to walk across uneven terrain in variable weather conditions and environmental factors. This arrangement is subject to review and may changes at the company's discretion. * Office work will include extended periods sitting or standing at a desk and using a computer and other office equipment. * Ability to travel in\-state and out\-of\-state for field oversight and attending meetings (approx. 25% travel required). **Additional Information:** * Full time, Monday \- Friday work schedule (40 hours). Occasionally extended work hours may be required based on project and/or client needs. * Work will be performed primarily in an office setting and occasionally in a field setting. **Target salary range: $175,000 to $200,000\.** Please note that Tetra Tech considers various factors in determining pay, including but not limited to: education, relevant and demonstrated work experience in the role, skills, geographic location, qualifications, certifications, and other competencies relevant to the needs of the business. **Life at Tetra Tech:** The perks of working at Tetra Tech include: * Comprehensive and market\-competitive benefits. * Tetra Tech offers the following optional benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Accidental Death \& Dismemberment, Long \& Short\-Term Disability, Health \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending. Financial Benefits: Group Term Life, Optional Group Term Life Insurance, Business Travel Accident Insurance, Health Savings Account, 401K, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Time Off with Pay, Employee Assistance Program, Adoption Assistance, Leaves of Absence. * Merit\-based financial rewards. * Flexibility and company\-wide commitment to work/life balance. * Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees. * Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth. **About Tetra Tech:** Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high\-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. This position plays a critical role in supporting the Texas Integrated Eligibility Redesign System (TIERS) and related technologies that help deliver more than 60 types of essential assistance services to Texans. **Essential Job Functions (EJFs):** Cloud Infrastructure Automation and Architecture (40%) Design, build, and maintain reusable AWS infrastructure modules using Terraform Enterprise. Develop secure, scalable, and automated cloud solutions that enable developers to provision and deprovision infrastructure efficiently. Promote infrastructure standardization, resiliency, and operational reliability across enterprise platforms. Robotic Process Automation Development (35%) Design, develop, implement, and enhance enterprise RPA capabilities. Build advanced automation solutions using UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate to improve agency workflows and reduce manual effort. Support governance, maintainability, and scalability of RPA implementations across the organization. AI Integration and Core Programming (20%) Design and implement adaptive, AI\-enabled workflows, including agentic automation use cases where appropriate. Develop integrations, scripts, and custom solutions using Python and RESTful APIs to improve interoperability across systems and platforms. Evaluate and apply emerging AI and automation technologies to enhance business and technical operations. Mission\-Critical System Support and Oversight (5%) Provide technical support for the TIERS portfolio and Eligibility Supporting Technologies. Help ensure high availability, reliability, and supportability for systems that process nutrition, cash, medical, and community care assistance programs. Participate in troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement efforts for mission\-critical services. **Knowledge,** **Skills** **and Abilities (KSAs):** Knowledge of: AWS cloud architecture, services, and infrastructure design principles. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts and Terraform Enterprise practices. Robotic Process Automation platforms, implementation methods, and governance frameworks. Python programming, API development, and RESTful integration patterns. Emerging AI technologies, including large language model (LLM) integrations and agentic workflow orchestration. Skill in: Designing, testing, and maintaining reusable infrastructure modules for enterprise\-scale development environments. Developing complex automation scripts, integrations, and API\-based solutions using Python. Building and deploying automated business processes using UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate. Troubleshooting complex cloud infrastructure issues, automation failures, and integration defects. Producing technical analysis, architecture documentation, and operational support materials for enterprise systems. Ability to: Work with minimal supervision while exercising sound judgment, initiative, and accountability. Analyze complex operational and technical problems and design effective automation\-based solutions. Manage multiple priorities and deliver high\-quality solutions in a fast\-paced enterprise environment. Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Registrations, Licensure Requirements or Certifications:** Preferred Certifications AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional. AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional. UiPath Certified Advanced RPA Developer (ARD), or Microsoft Certified: Power Automate RPA Developer Associate. **Initial Screening Criteria:** At least five (5\) years of progressive, hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure automation and deployment. At least three (3\) years of experience developing automation solutions using Python and RESTful APIs. At least one (2\) year of experience developing automation workflows or scripts using enterprise RPA platforms such as UiPath or Microsoft Power Automate. Experience designing reusable infrastructure modules, automation frameworks, or shared platform services in a large enterprise environment is preferred. Experience supporting public sector, healthcare, or human services systems is preferred. **Additional Information:** N/A Review our Tips for Success when applying for jobs at DFPS, DSHS and HHSC. **Active Duty, Military, Reservists, Guardsmen, and Veterans**: Military occupation(s) that relate to the initial selection criteria and registration or licensure requirements for this position may include, but not limited to those listed in this posting. All active\-duty military, reservists, guardsmen, and veterans are encouraged to apply if qualified to fill this position. For more information please see the Texas State Auditor’s Job Descriptions, Military Crosswalk and Military Crosswalk Guide at Texas State Auditor's Office \- Job Descriptions. **ADA Accommodations:** In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), HHSC and DSHS agencies will provide reasonable accommodation during the hiring and selection process for qualified individuals with a disability. If you need assistance completing the on\-line application, contact the HHS Employee Service Center at 1\-888\-894\-4747\. If you are contacted for an interview and need accommodation to participate in the interview process, please notify the person scheduling the interview. **Pre\-Employment Checks and Work Eligibility:** Depending on the program area and position requirements, applicants selected for hire may be required to pass background and other due diligence checks. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Ditch Witch
jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Ditch Witch is a premier division of The Toro Company. At Ditch Witch in Perry, Oklahoma we pride ourselves on being the leading manufacturer in the underground pipe and cable market. Our plant in Perry stands out because it's a place for people to learn and thrive. We enjoy coming to work because our plant is our community, we see our teammates not only as co\-workers but as neighbors and family members. All of our locations build the intricate network of machinery that contributes to The Toro Company. We contribute to building communities, cities, and the world. We invite you to apply and join a team of highly skilled, and highly passionate people. **Sponsorship:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. **Mechanical Engineer at Ditch Witch:** This employee researches and designs components and mechanical systems for Ditch Witch® products. He or she uses CAD equipment to create or modify model files of machine components and systems and works closely with various component suppliers and other engineers that have mechanical, electrical, and/or hydraulic responsibilities. This employee directs the work of drafters/illustrators, layout personnel, and technicians, and performs other duties as assigned. **What Will You Do?** * Analyze product specifications and performance requirements to determine designs which provide a good balance of performance, functionality, cost and ease of manufacture. * Direct and physically participate when needed in the construction \& testing of prototypes to evaluate the design \& functionality of the product. * Solicit and evaluate input from various sources concerning product design and functionality to meet project and customer requirements and manufacturability of product designs. * Review product design for compliance with standard engineering practices, company and industry standards, customer contact requirements, and related specifications. * Create, maintain, and/or direct the creation/maintenance of essential design information and documentation including models, drafts, schematics, and purchased part documentation as well as supporting technical publications. * Provide solutions to complex and challenging issues while balancing workload among multiple projects and priorities. ***Note:*** *The responsibilities and tasks outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may change as determined by the needs of the company.* **What Do You Need?** * Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or closely related engineering field. * Engineer III, minimum of 5\+ years of experience in a product design or related engineering role. * Engineer II, minimum 2\-4 years of experience. * Engineer I, 0\-2 years of experience. * Experience with CAD software and solid modeling. * Interest in mobile equipment design and operations. **Work Environment****:** * Office environment most of the time with regular trips to the shop and outside work. * Shop and outdoor environments include physical hazards such as utilities (typically gas, electric, and water lines), powered vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian traffic, sharp objects, and moving machinery. Outdoor environment includes work in all kinds of weather while operating and demonstrating machinery and construction site conditions such as open excavations, unimproved land, uncompleted structures, etc. * Working with hazardous materials, including fuels, lubricants, solvents, and batteries. * Normal 9 hour work day, occasional workdays or up to 10 hours or more. * Occasional overnight travel. * Rapidly changing workload, priorities, demands, schedules, and deadlines. * Regular, continuous use of a computer. **What Can We Give You?** At Ditch Witch, we are always working to make sure our employees know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive salary, an affordable and top tier medical/dental/vision plan, 401k, and many other great benefits – Ditch Witch offers employees at our Perry, OK location a variety of perks, including: * ***Dress for your day*** \- We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, office\-plant blended environment. * ***Wellness*** \- In addition to physical wellbeing, TTC offers a variety of mental health, financial health, and other types of resources to every full\-time employee. * ***Growth Opportunities*** *–* TTC prides itself on giving our employees the chance to grow their careers. Tuition reimbursement, opportunities to move into new areas of interest, and promotion opportunities are a few examples. * ***Competitive Salary***– The pay range takes into account skills, experience, education, and location. It is not common to be hired at or near the top of the range; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the annual pay range is between $68,200\-$110,000\. Cash compensation is one piece of our competitive total rewards package. You may be eligible to participate in an incentive program, which rewards employees based on individual and organizational performance. Eligibility and award amounts are determined by company policy and performance metrics. If you need to, you can access your pay early with the dailypay app. *The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non\-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.*

jobs.title: Research Programmer / Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Number of Positions In Requisition** 1\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **Job Details** A Research Programmer / Software Engineer position is available in the laboratory of Dr. Noa Herz in the Department of Neurology and Neuroscience at Thomas Jefferson University. Research in the Herz Lab focuses on the neural mechanisms underlying human episodic memory. We use direct brain recordings and electrical stimulation collected from neurosurgical patients with implanted electrodes undergoing seizure monitoring. Our work aims to characterize memory processes and memory dysfunction in neurological and psychiatric conditions and to develop novel brain stimulation approaches to improve human memory function. We are seeking a motivated, independent, and technically skilled programmer/software engineer to develop, maintain, and improve software tools for human memory experiments, intracranial EEG (iEEG) data processing, and scientific analysis. The successful candidate will work closely with neuroscientists and clinicians to develop new experimental paradigms, improve existing analysis pipelines, and provide technical expertise for ongoing cognitive neuroscience studies. **Job Description** This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving challenging technical problems, rapidly developing new tools, and working at the interface of software engineering, neuroscience, and medicine. Projects may involve: * Rapid development and implementation of new behavioral experiments in human memory. * Building and optimizing software tools for direct brain stimulation studies. * Developing reproducible preprocessing and analysis pipelines for intracranial EEG data. * Supporting computational analyses on high\-performance computing clusters. * Designing software systems, testing procedures, and reproducible workflows. * Preparing software releases and maintaining code documentation. * Troubleshooting computing infrastructure, including servers, file systems, and cluster environments. * Contributing to the design and implementation of novel neuroscience experiments and analysis methods. This position provides a unique opportunity to apply software engineering skills to cutting\-edge research in human neuroscience, epilepsy, and brain stimulation. Depending on the candidate's interests and qualifications, there will be opportunities for substantial scientific involvement, including co\-authorship on publications and participation in study design and data analysis. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field. * Strong programming skills in Python. * Experience with C\+\+, or willingness to work with and extend existing C\+\+ code. * Experience working in Linux/Unix computing environments. * Experience with version control and software environment management tools (e.g., Git, conda, pip). * Demonstrated experience completing technical projects or contributing to larger codebases. * Ability to write clean, well\-documented, maintainable, and reusable code. * Strong independent problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate within multidisciplinary teams. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with neuroscience, psychology, biomedical research, or human subjects research. * Experience with EEG, intracranial EEG, neural time\-series analysis, or physiological data. * Experience with MATLAB, R, JavaScript, Unity, PsychoPy, Psychtoolbox, Qt, or related tools. * Experience with scientific Python libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, MNE, matplotlib, or scikit\-learn. * Experience with software testing, deployment, or collaborative software development. * Experience with high\-performance computing, SLURM, server\-based workflows, or scientific data management. * Experience with computational modeling, simulations, or large\-scale data analysis. * Experience with hardware, electronics, or experimental systems integration. * Interest in memory research, epilepsy, brain stimulation, clinical neuroscience, or computational neuroscience. **Work Shift** Workday Day (United States of America) **Worker Sub Type** Regular **Employee Entity** Thomas Jefferson University **Primary Location Address** 1015 Walnut Street, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States of America Nationally ranked, Jefferson, which is principally located in the greater Philadelphia region, Lehigh Valley and Northeastern Pennsylvania and southern New Jersey, is reimagining health care and higher education to create unparalleled value. Jefferson is more than 65,000 people strong, dedicated to providing the highest\-quality, compassionate clinical care for patients; making our communities healthier and stronger; preparing tomorrow's professional leaders for 21st\-century careers; and creating new knowledge through basic/programmatic, clinical and applied research. Thomas Jefferson University , home of Sidney Kimmel Medical College, Jefferson College of Nursing, and the Kanbar College of Design, Engineering and Commerce, dates back to 1824 and today comprises 10 colleges and three schools offering 200\+ undergraduate and graduate programs to more than 8,300 students. Jefferson Health , nationally ranked as one of the top 15 not\-for\-profit health care systems in the country and the largest provider in the Philadelphia and Lehigh Valley areas, serves patients through millions of encounters each year at 32 hospitals campuses and more than 700 outpatient and urgent care locations throughout the region. Jefferson Health Plans is a not\-for\-profit managed health care organization providing a broad range of health coverage options in Pennsylvania and New Jersey for more than 35 years. Jefferson is committed to providing equal educational and employment opportunities for all persons without regard to age, race, color, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, military status, veteran status, handicap or disability or any other protected group or status. **Benefits** Jefferson offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full\-time and part\-time colleagues, including medical (including prescription), supplemental insurance, dental, vision, life and AD\&D insurance, short\- and long\-term disability, flexible spending accounts, retirement plans, tuition assistance, as well as voluntary benefits, which provide colleagues with access to group rates on insurance and discounts. Colleagues have access to tuition discounts at Thomas Jefferson University after one year of full time service or two years of part time service. All colleagues, including those who work less than part\-time (including per diem colleagues, adjunct faculty, and Jeff Temps ), have access to medical (including prescription) insurance.

Ready to make an impact? Come join Threekit and let’s build the future of buying together. **What We Value** At Threekit, our core values are summed up with the acronym **GRIT**: * **Getting Things Done**: We’re the drivers of Threekit’s success. * **Revenue**: Being revenue\-focused allows us to be customer\-focused. * **Innovation**: We’re risk takers. * **Team**: We point the finger at the problem, not the person. These principles guide our actions and decisions, shaping the way we work and interact with each other and our customers. At Threekit, GRIT is more than just an acronym \- it is the driving force behind our success and growth. **What You'll Do** * Drive and execute projects, including delivering project outcomes, finding innovative solutions, managing client expectations, and managing internal project resources. * Create and execute project plans; monitor and review project progress and timelines; adjust schedules and plans as needed; and identify and resolve issues to ensure project success. * Oversee project delivery process with key contributors to help manage scope and prepare change requests \- including tasks, deliverables, milestones, resources, and estimated costs. Translate findings into user stories, wireframes, and/or architecture diagrams or prototypes using Figma, Cursor, or Copilot. * Understand and synthesize prospect requirements and constraints to creatively design and demonstrate solution visions—through prototypes, demos, or decks—that unlock tangible value for prospects, utilizing applied AI. **What Catches Our Eye** * 8\+ years of experience working in a client\-facing Implementation Consultant role with 3\+ years of hands\-on experience managing complex software or SaaS implementation projects, from scoping through to execution and delivery with a focus on implementation. * Ability to prototype in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, or using AI‑augmented IDEs (Cursor, Copilot). * Excellent client‑facing communication, facilitation, and presentation skills. * Working basic knowledge of modern AI systems (model training \& inference basics, prompt engineering, data considerations). * Eye for UX/UI and product aesthetics; comfortable iterating in Figma or working with designers toward a vision. * Confident and positive attitude, and adaptable to change in a fast\-paced environment. * Proficiency in English. * Availability to travel as needed. **Preferred Skills** * Consulting or solution‑architecture experience in B2B SaaS, including participation in sales cycles. * Experience as a pre\-sales consultant or solution engineer. * Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, or equivalent. **Preferred Education** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. **Who You'll Report To** This position reports to the RVP Consulting North America. **What You Can Expect From Threekit** * A transparent recruitment process that includes an initial Cognitive Assessment and discussions with key stakeholders. Looking to move quickly? So are we! * We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance. Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Spending Account, and Commuter Benefits. * A 401K plan plus an employer match. * Unlimited PTO as well as paid holidays so you can relax and recharge when needed. * Long\-term incentive (e.g., stock options). * A hybrid work model that allows you to work in a manner that is best for you. * In\-office lunches and snacks. * Home wifi stipend. * Reimbursement of approved tuition and training. * A positive culture that embraces employee input. **The successful candidate must reside within a reasonable daily commuting distance of our Chicago office and be present in the office two days a week. Interested? Apply now!** * **Threekit's salary ranges are determined based on market data for our industry and company size, and take into account work location, skills, experience, and education/certifications.** **We use AI\-powered tools (such as Metaview, Firefiles.Ai, and ChatGPT) to support certain administrative aspects of our recruitment process, such as interview note\-taking, transcription, and summarization. These tools are used to improve efficiency and consistency. All AI\-generated outputs are reviewed by a qualified recruiting professional, and all hiring decisions are made by humans. We do not use AI for selection purposes, but do utilize AI\-powered search functions (Metaview/Google) to help identify candidates.**

jobs.title: Product Manager (AI Agents)
jobs.description: **About Traba** =============== Traba is building the AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain. We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships. But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale. We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to join as a founding member of the Agents team and help us build the next layer of Traba's product, an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. Think Claude, but for Light Industrial businesses. You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agents that understand context, reason through ambiguity, make decisions, and execute work on behalf of users. This is a true 0\-to\-1 product role operating at the frontier of applied AI. You will work directly with founders, product engineers, ML teams, and early design partners to define workflows, shape product strategy, and build products while the underlying model ecosystem continues changing beneath us. The assumptions, capabilities, and constraints will evolve rapidly and the product will evolve with them. This role reports directly to our VP of Product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Architect and steward product strategy for Traba’s AI agent platform * Solve complex customer problems by balancing user needs, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities * Write detailed product requirements and partner deeply with product engineers and ML teams * Rapidly validate and prototype ideas alongside customers and design partners * Design agent systems that reason through workflows, orchestrate tools, maintain context, and execute meaningful work * Define product behavior, evaluation systems, and quality frameworks that improve reliability and performance * Use data to uncover patterns and answer key product and system questions * Evolve our AI product portfolio with a deep understanding of model capabilities and system architecture * Visualize and communicate complex concepts from system behavior and evaluations to user experiences and business impact * Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- **Real agent builder.** You have launched customer\-facing AI products where the system took meaningful actions on behalf of users. We are intentionally setting a high bar here. Shipping AI features, copilots, chat interfaces, wrappers, or lightweight LLM integrations alone is not enough. You understand agents that execute workflows, orchestrate systems, use tools, maintain context, and perform work autonomously. **0\-to\-1 operator.** You have built products from scratch with real customers and understand the realities of finding product market fit. You have launched, rebuilt, changed direction, killed ideas, and iterated toward signals. You are comfortable creating structures where no playbook exists. **AI\-native problem solver.** You move quickly in environments where models evolve constantly and assumptions regularly break. You understand that building AI products often means navigating prompt rewrites, model shifts, reliability tradeoffs, and capability cliffs. **First\-principles thinker.** You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks. **Customer\-embedded builder.** You believe the best products are built shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers. You have experience deeply embedding with early customers, understanding workflows firsthand, and rapidly shipping based on direct feedback loops. Experience with forward deployed environments or customer\-embedded product development models is highly valued. **Technical depth.** You are comfortable operating alongside ML engineers and highly technical teams as peers. You can understand evaluations, reason through system tradeoffs, prototype ideas, and participate deeply in technical conversations. You do not need to be an ex\-engineer, but you should have strong technical instincts and enjoy getting into the details. **Builder mentality.** Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process. **Deeply collaborative.** You work seamlessly across engineering, ML, operations, design, leadership, and customers to bring new products to life. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * 3 – 5 years of experience as a Product Manager * Evidence of launching products from scratch and driving meaningful customer outcomes * Experience building AI\-native products or customer\-facing agent systems * Strong technical abilities with the ability to work deeply with engineering and ML teams * Ability to read evaluations, reason through system performance, and prototype ideas * Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles * Deep familiarity with AI tools and hands\-on experience building with modern AI systems * Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area * A strong work ethic and desire to build a category\-defining company **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via Grubhub \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Team building events * Gympass Benefit * Flexible PTO * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $150,000 and $190,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long\-term success and upside of the business. The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high\-performing team in a fast\-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real\-time decision\-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem\-solving that drives meaningful impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long\-term value for short\-term results. **Olympian’s Work Ethic \-** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field. **Growth Mindset \-** We confront the toughest challenges head\-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience. **Customer Obsession \-** We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high\-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems Privacy Notice for CA Applicants Compensation Range: $150K \- $190K
